en_def: the top inside surface of a room, above your head
hi_def: छत (कमरे के अंदर की ऊपरी सतह)
hi_nuance: Hindi uses one word 'छत' for both the inside top of a room and the outside top of a building. In English, 'ceiling' is only the inside surface; the outside top is the 'roof'. Saying 'I sat on the ceiling' sounds like a joke.

examples.en: The ceiling fan makes a strange noise at night.
examples.hi: छत का पंखा रात में अजीब आवाज़ करता है।

examples.en: There is a water stain on the bedroom ceiling.
examples.hi: बेडरूम की छत पर पानी का दाग़ है।

examples.en: The office has very high ceilings, so it feels bigger.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस की छतें बहुत ऊँची हैं, इसलिए वह बड़ा लगता है।

examples.en: We painted the ceiling white and the walls light blue.
examples.hi: हमने छत को सफ़ेद और दीवारों को हल्का नीला रंगा।

examples.en: The security cameras are fixed to the ceiling near the door.
examples.hi: सुरक्षा कैमरे दरवाज़े के पास छत पर लगे हैं।

examples.en: He is so tall that his head almost touches the ceiling.
examples.hi: वह इतना लंबा है कि उसका सिर लगभग छत को छूता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We dried the clothes on the ceiling.
common_mistake.right: We dried the clothes on the roof.
common_mistake.why: 'ceiling' is inside the room above your head; the outside top of a building where you walk is the 'roof'. Hindi 'छत' covers both, English does not.

cloze.sentence: The fan hangs from the ____ in the middle of the room.

en_def: a long narrow passage inside a building with doors to rooms on one or both sides
hi_def: गलियारा, बरामदा (इमारत के अंदर का लंबा रास्ता)
hi_nuance: Indian English often uses 'passage' or 'gallery' for this. 'Corridor' is the standard word for an indoor passage in a school, office or hotel; 'hallway' is common in American English. 'Gallery' in English means an art exhibition space.

examples.en: The meeting room is at the end of the corridor.
examples.hi: मीटिंग रूम गलियारे के अंत में है।

examples.en: Please don't run in the corridor.
examples.hi: कृपया गलियारे में मत दौड़ो।

examples.en: The hotel corridor was dark and quiet at midnight.
examples.hi: आधी रात को होटल का गलियारा अंधेरा और शांत था।

examples.en: Every door in the corridor needs an access card.
examples.hi: गलियारे के हर दरवाज़े के लिए एक्सेस कार्ड चाहिए।

examples.en: I met my manager in the corridor and we talked for a minute.
examples.hi: मैं गलियारे में अपने मैनेजर से मिला और हमने एक मिनट बात की।

examples.en: The server room is down this corridor, on the left.
examples.hi: सर्वर रूम इसी गलियारे में आगे, बाईं ओर है।

common_mistake.wrong: The printer is kept in the gallery outside our room.
common_mistake.right: The printer is kept in the corridor outside our room.
common_mistake.why: In standard English a 'gallery' is a place for art; the indoor passage between rooms is a 'corridor' (or 'hallway').

cloze.sentence: Walk down the ____ and the lift is on your right.

en_def: a set of steps that lead from one floor of a building to another
hi_nuance: Hindi 'सीढ़ी' is singular, so learners say 'the stair'. In English the set is almost always plural: 'the stairs'. One step is 'a step' or 'a stair'; a movable ladder is 'a ladder', not stairs. 'Upstairs' and 'downstairs' are single adverbs.

examples.en: I take the stairs instead of the lift to stay fit.
examples.hi: फ़िट रहने के लिए मैं लिफ़्ट की जगह सीढ़ियाँ लेता हूँ।

examples.en: Be careful, the stairs are wet.
examples.hi: सावधान, सीढ़ियाँ गीली हैं।

examples.en: She ran up the stairs to answer the phone.
examples.hi: वह फ़ोन उठाने के लिए सीढ़ियाँ चढ़कर भागी।

examples.en: The fire exit is at the bottom of the stairs.
examples.hi: फ़ायर एग्ज़िट सीढ़ियों के नीचे है।

examples.en: My grandmother finds the stairs difficult now.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी को अब सीढ़ियाँ चढ़ना मुश्किल लगता है।

examples.en: There are twenty stairs between the two floors.
examples.hi: दोनों मंज़िलों के बीच बीस सीढ़ियाँ हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: The lift is not working, so please use the stair.
common_mistake.right: The lift is not working, so please use the stairs.
common_mistake.why: A set of steps is plural in English: 'the stairs'. 'Stair' on its own means just one step and is rarely used.

cloze.sentence: He fell down the ____ and hurt his knee.

en_def: a warm knitted piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear on the top half of your body
hi_nuance: The word is already used in Hindi, but note the pronunciation: /ˈswetə/ with a short 'e' as in 'wet', not 'sweeter'. British English also says 'jumper' or 'pullover' for the same thing; a 'cardigan' opens at the front with buttons.

examples.en: It's cold in the office, so I always keep a sweater at my desk.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस में ठंड रहती है, इसलिए मैं हमेशा अपनी डेस्क पर एक स्वेटर रखता हूँ।

examples.en: My mother knitted this sweater for me.
examples.hi: मेरी माँ ने मेरे लिए यह स्वेटर बुना था।

examples.en: Take a sweater, it gets cold in Shimla at night.
examples.hi: स्वेटर ले लो, शिमला में रात को ठंड हो जाती है।

examples.en: He wore a grey sweater over his shirt.
examples.hi: उसने अपनी शर्ट के ऊपर ग्रे स्वेटर पहना था।

examples.en: This sweater is too small for me now.
examples.hi: यह स्वेटर अब मुझे छोटा हो गया है।

examples.en: Wash the sweater in cold water so it doesn't shrink.
examples.hi: स्वेटर को ठंडे पानी में धोओ ताकि वह सिकुड़े नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I am wearing sweater today because it is cold.
common_mistake.right: I am wearing a sweater today because it is cold.
common_mistake.why: 'sweater' is a countable noun, so it needs 'a' or 'my' before it in the singular.

cloze.sentence: It's chilly this morning; you should put on a ____.

en_def: clothes and sheets that need to be washed, or have just been washed; also the place where they are washed
hi_def: धुलाई के कपड़े; कपड़े धोने की जगह
hi_nuance: 'Laundry' is uncountable: 'a lot of laundry', never 'laundries'. The common phrase is 'do the laundry' (Hindi 'कपड़े धोना'). A 'laundry' can also be a shop or service, like a dhobi, but a 'dry cleaner' handles special clothes.

examples.en: I do the laundry every Sunday morning.
examples.hi: मैं हर रविवार सुबह कपड़े धोता हूँ।

examples.en: There's a pile of dirty laundry in the corner.
examples.hi: कोने में गंदे कपड़ों का ढेर पड़ा है।

examples.en: The hotel has a laundry service on every floor.
examples.hi: होटल में हर मंज़िल पर लॉन्ड्री सेवा है।

examples.en: Please hang the laundry on the balcony to dry.
examples.hi: कृपया धुले कपड़े सूखने के लिए बालकनी में टाँग दो।

examples.en: Can you put the laundry in the machine before you leave?
examples.hi: क्या तुम जाने से पहले कपड़े मशीन में डाल सकते हो?

examples.en: Working from home means I can do laundry between meetings.
examples.hi: घर से काम करने का मतलब है कि मैं मीटिंगों के बीच कपड़े धो सकता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I have many laundries to do today.
common_mistake.right: I have a lot of laundry to do today.
common_mistake.why: 'laundry' is uncountable; use 'a lot of' or 'some', and never add -s.

cloze.sentence: The ____ basket is full; I need to wash clothes tonight.

en_def: to speak very quietly, using your breath rather than your voice, so that only a person near you can hear
hi_nuance: Hindi 'धीरे बोलना' covers both 'speak softly' and 'whisper'. In English, 'whisper' means almost no voice at all; 'speak quietly' or 'lower your voice' is a normal low voice. You 'whisper something to someone' or 'whisper in someone's ear'.

examples.en: She whispered the password to me so nobody else could hear.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे पासवर्ड फुसफुसाकर बताया ताकि कोई और न सुन सके।

examples.en: The baby is asleep, so please whisper.
examples.hi: बच्चा सो रहा है, इसलिए कृपया फुसफुसाकर बोलो।

examples.en: He whispered something in her ear and she laughed.
examples.hi: उसने उसके कान में कुछ फुसफुसाया और वह हँस पड़ी।

examples.en: Stop whispering at the back of the class!
examples.hi: क्लास के पीछे कानाफूसी करना बंद करो!

examples.en: They whispered about the new manager during the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग के दौरान वे नए मैनेजर के बारे में फुसफुसाते रहे।

examples.en: "Don't look now," he whispered.
examples.hi: "अभी मत देखो," उसने फुसफुसाकर कहा।

common_mistake.wrong: She whispered me the answer.
common_mistake.right: She whispered the answer to me.
common_mistake.why: 'whisper' does not take two objects like 'tell'; the listener needs 'to': whisper something to someone.

cloze.sentence: The library was silent, so we had to ____ to each other.

en_def: not sensible or serious; a little foolish, often in a harmless or funny way
hi_nuance: 'Silly' is much softer than 'stupid' or Hindi 'बेवकूफ़'. It is often friendly or playful: 'Don't be silly' is a warm way to say 'don't worry about that'. Calling a colleague 'stupid' is rude; 'that was a silly mistake' is acceptable.

examples.en: I made a silly mistake and typed the wrong email address.
examples.hi: मैंने एक छोटी-सी बेवकूफ़ी की और ग़लत ईमेल पता टाइप कर दिया।

examples.en: Don't be silly, of course you can come with us.
examples.hi: बेवकूफ़ मत बनो, बिल्कुल तुम हमारे साथ आ सकते हो।

examples.en: The children were being silly and laughing at everything.
examples.hi: बच्चे मस्ती कर रहे थे और हर बात पर हँस रहे थे।

examples.en: It's a silly question, but where is the on switch?
examples.hi: यह थोड़ा बेवकूफ़ी भरा सवाल है, पर ऑन बटन कहाँ है?

examples.en: Using 'password123' as a password is just silly.
examples.hi: 'password123' को पासवर्ड बनाना सरासर बेवकूफ़ी है।

examples.en: I felt silly when I realised the meeting was tomorrow, not today.
examples.hi: जब मुझे पता चला कि मीटिंग आज नहीं कल है, तो मुझे बड़ा अजीब लगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Sorry, I am asking a stupid doubt.
common_mistake.right: Sorry, this might be a silly question.
common_mistake.why: 'stupid' sounds harsh about yourself or others, and 'doubt' in Indian English means 'question'. 'Silly question' is the natural, softer phrase.

cloze.sentence: It was a ____ idea to leave the laptop unlocked in the cafe.

en_def: to reach a place at the end of a journey
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers often say 'reach to' or 'arrive to'. Use 'arrive at' (a building/event) or 'arrive in' (a city/country); 'reach' takes no preposition.

examples.en: The train arrived at the station ten minutes late.
examples.hi: ट्रेन स्टेशन पर दस मिनट देर से पहुँची।

examples.en: We arrived in Mumbai just before midnight.
examples.hi: हम आधी रात से ठीक पहले मुंबई पहुँचे।

examples.en: Please call me when you arrive.
examples.hi: जब आप पहुँच जाएँ तो मुझे फ़ोन करें।

examples.en: My parcel hasn't arrived yet.
examples.hi: मेरा पार्सल अभी तक नहीं पहुँचा है।

examples.en: She always arrives early for meetings.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा मीटिंग के लिए जल्दी पहुँचती है।

examples.en: The guests arrived one by one.
examples.hi: मेहमान एक-एक करके पहुँचे।

common_mistake.wrong: We arrived to the office at nine.
common_mistake.right: We arrived at the office at nine.
common_mistake.why: 'arrive' takes 'at' or 'in', never 'to'.

cloze.sentence: The flight ____ in Delhi at 6 a.m.

en_def: to choose something after thinking about it
hi_nuance: Indian English often says 'take a decision'; British/American English prefers 'make a decision'. Also, 'decide' is followed by 'to + verb', not 'for + -ing'.

examples.en: We decided to leave early because of the rain.
examples.hi: बारिश की वजह से हमने जल्दी निकलने का फ़ैसला किया।

examples.en: I can't decide which laptop to buy.
examples.hi: मैं तय नहीं कर पा रहा कि कौन-सा लैपटॉप खरीदूँ।

examples.en: She decided against moving to Pune.
examples.hi: उसने पुणे जाने के खिलाफ़ फ़ैसला किया।

examples.en: Have you decided what to cook tonight?
examples.hi: क्या आपने तय कर लिया कि आज रात क्या बनाना है?

examples.en: They decided on the blue paint for the bedroom.
examples.hi: उन्होंने बेडरूम के लिए नीले रंग का पेंट चुना।

examples.en: It was hard to decide between the two jobs.
examples.hi: दो नौकरियों में से एक चुनना मुश्किल था।

common_mistake.wrong: I decided for going to Goa.
common_mistake.right: I decided to go to Goa.
common_mistake.why: 'decide' is followed by a to-infinitive, not 'for + -ing'.

cloze.sentence: They ____ to cancel the meeting.

en_def: to be unable to remember something, or to not do something you should do
hi_nuance: Don't say 'I forgot my keys at home' when you mean 'I left my keys at home'. Use 'leave' when you mention the place; use 'forget' without a place.

examples.en: I forgot to charge my phone last night.
examples.hi: मैं कल रात अपना फ़ोन चार्ज करना भूल गया।

examples.en: Don't forget your umbrella; it might rain.
examples.hi: अपना छाता मत भूलना; बारिश हो सकती है।

examples.en: She forgot his name as soon as he left.
examples.hi: जैसे ही वह गया, वह उसका नाम भूल गई।

examples.en: I'll never forget that trip to Kerala.
examples.hi: मैं केरल की वह यात्रा कभी नहीं भूलूँगा।

examples.en: He keeps forgetting where he put his glasses.
examples.hi: वह बार-बार भूल जाता है कि उसने चश्मा कहाँ रखा।

examples.en: Sorry, I completely forgot about our meeting.
examples.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, मैं हमारी मीटिंग के बारे में पूरी तरह भूल गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I forgot my charger at the office.
common_mistake.right: I left my charger at the office.
common_mistake.why: When you mention the place, English uses 'leave', not 'forget'.

cloze.sentence: I ____ to bring my ID card this morning.

en_def: to take and use something that belongs to someone else, planning to give it back
hi_nuance: Hindi 'उधार' is used for both directions, so learners confuse 'borrow' (take) and 'lend' (give). You borrow FROM someone; someone lends TO you.

examples.en: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
examples.hi: क्या मैं एक मिनट के लिए आपका पेन ले सकता हूँ?

examples.en: He borrowed money from his uncle to start the shop.
examples.hi: उसने दुकान शुरू करने के लिए अपने चाचा से पैसे उधार लिए।

examples.en: I borrowed three books from the library.
examples.hi: मैंने पुस्तकालय से तीन किताबें लीं।

examples.en: She never returns the things she borrows.
examples.hi: वह उधार ली हुई चीज़ें कभी वापस नहीं करती।

examples.en: We had to borrow a ladder from the neighbours.
examples.hi: हमें पड़ोसियों से सीढ़ी उधार लेनी पड़ी।

common_mistake.wrong: Can you borrow me your charger?
common_mistake.right: Can you lend me your charger? / Can I borrow your charger?
common_mistake.why: 'borrow' means take; 'lend' means give. The person giving lends.

cloze.sentence: May I ____ your notes for tonight?

en_def: to give something to someone for a short time, expecting it back
hi_nuance: The opposite of 'borrow'. Pattern: lend someone something / lend something to someone. Past tense is 'lent', not 'lended'.

examples.en: Could you lend me five hundred rupees until Friday?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे शुक्रवार तक पाँच सौ रुपये उधार दे सकते हैं?

examples.en: I lent him my bike and he returned it with a flat tyre.
examples.hi: मैंने उसे अपनी साइकिल दी और उसने उसे पंक्चर टायर के साथ लौटाया।

examples.en: The bank lends money to small businesses.
examples.hi: बैंक छोटे व्यवसायों को पैसे उधार देता है।

examples.en: She lent me her jacket because I was cold.
examples.hi: मुझे ठंड लग रही थी इसलिए उसने मुझे अपनी जैकेट दी।

examples.en: I don't lend my books to anyone anymore.
examples.hi: मैं अब किसी को अपनी किताबें उधार नहीं देता।

common_mistake.wrong: He lended me his car yesterday.
common_mistake.right: He lent me his car yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'lend' is irregular: lend – lent – lent.

cloze.sentence: My brother ____ me his laptop for the exam.

en_def: to go from one place to another, especially over a long distance
hi_nuance: 'travel' is usually a verb or an uncountable noun. For one specific journey say 'a trip' or 'a journey', not 'a travel'. 'travelling' (UK) has two Ls; 'traveling' (US) has one.

examples.en: I travel to Bangalore twice a month for work.
examples.hi: मैं काम के लिए महीने में दो बार बैंगलोर जाता हूँ।

examples.en: She loves travelling by train.
examples.hi: उसे ट्रेन से यात्रा करना बहुत पसंद है।

examples.en: We travelled across Rajasthan last winter.
examples.hi: पिछली सर्दियों में हमने पूरे राजस्थान की यात्रा की।

examples.en: Light travels faster than sound.
examples.hi: प्रकाश ध्वनि से तेज़ चलता है।

examples.en: He has travelled to more than twenty countries.
examples.hi: उसने बीस से ज़्यादा देशों की यात्रा की है।

examples.en: Do you prefer to travel alone or with friends?
examples.hi: क्या आप अकेले यात्रा करना पसंद करते हैं या दोस्तों के साथ?

common_mistake.wrong: We had a wonderful travel to Shimla.
common_mistake.right: We had a wonderful trip to Shimla.
common_mistake.why: 'travel' is not used for one countable journey; use 'trip' or 'journey'.

cloze.sentence: I usually ____ to work by metro.

en_def: to go to see a person or a place for a short time
hi_nuance: 'visit' takes a direct object: 'visit my aunt', not 'visit to my aunt'. As a noun you 'pay a visit' or 'make a visit'.

examples.en: We visited my grandparents in the village.
examples.hi: हम गाँव में अपने दादा-दादी से मिलने गए।

examples.en: Thousands of tourists visit the Taj Mahal every day.
examples.hi: हर दिन हज़ारों पर्यटक ताजमहल देखने आते हैं।

examples.en: The doctor will visit the patient tomorrow morning.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर कल सुबह मरीज़ को देखने आएँगे।

examples.en: Please visit our website for more details.
examples.hi: अधिक जानकारी के लिए कृपया हमारी वेबसाइट देखें।

examples.en: I haven't visited Kolkata since 2019.
examples.hi: मैं 2019 से कोलकाता नहीं गया हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I will visit to my cousin on Sunday.
common_mistake.right: I will visit my cousin on Sunday.
common_mistake.why: 'visit' takes a direct object; no 'to'.

cloze.sentence: Many people ____ Goa in December.

en_def: to go back to a place, or to give something back
hi_nuance: Indian English says 'return back'; this is redundant because 'return' already means 'go back'. Say 'return' or 'come back', never both.

examples.en: He returned home late last night.
examples.hi: वह कल रात देर से घर लौटा।

examples.en: Please return the book by Monday.
examples.hi: कृपया किताब सोमवार तक लौटा दें।

examples.en: She returned to work after her holiday.
examples.hi: छुट्टी के बाद वह काम पर लौट आई।

examples.en: I'll return your call in ten minutes.
examples.hi: मैं दस मिनट में आपको वापस फ़ोन करूँगा।

examples.en: The shop lets you return items within thirty days.
examples.hi: दुकान आपको तीस दिनों के भीतर सामान लौटाने देती है।

examples.en: When did you return from Dubai?
examples.hi: आप दुबई से कब लौटे?

common_mistake.wrong: I will return back on Tuesday.
common_mistake.right: I will return on Tuesday. / I will be back on Tuesday.
common_mistake.why: 'return' already means 'come back'; 'return back' repeats the idea.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ the keys to reception.

en_def: to make something clear by describing it or giving reasons
hi_nuance: 'explain' is never followed directly by a person. Say 'explain something to me' or 'explain to me why', not 'explain me'.

examples.en: Can you explain this rule to me again?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे यह नियम फिर से समझा सकते हैं?

examples.en: The teacher explained the problem very clearly.
examples.hi: शिक्षक ने समस्या को बहुत स्पष्ट रूप से समझाया।

examples.en: He explained why he was late.
examples.hi: उसने बताया कि वह देर से क्यों आया।

examples.en: Let me explain how the app works.
examples.hi: मैं समझाता हूँ कि यह ऐप कैसे काम करता है।

examples.en: She couldn't explain what had happened.
examples.hi: वह नहीं समझा पाई कि क्या हुआ था।

common_mistake.wrong: Please explain me the process.
common_mistake.right: Please explain the process to me.
common_mistake.why: 'explain' cannot take a person as its direct object; use 'to + person'.

cloze.sentence: Could you ____ the difference between these two words?

en_def: to say what someone or something is like
hi_nuance: Like 'explain', 'describe' is followed by the thing, then 'to + person': 'describe the man to the police'. Don't say 'describe about'.

examples.en: Can you describe the person who took your bag?
examples.hi: क्या आप उस व्यक्ति का वर्णन कर सकते हैं जिसने आपका बैग लिया?

examples.en: She described the hotel as small but clean.
examples.hi: उसने होटल को छोटा लेकिन साफ़ बताया।

examples.en: Describe your daily routine in five sentences.
examples.hi: अपनी दिनचर्या का पाँच वाक्यों में वर्णन करें।

examples.en: Words cannot describe how happy I was.
examples.hi: शब्द बयान नहीं कर सकते कि मैं कितना खुश था।

examples.en: He described the accident to the doctor.
examples.hi: उसने डॉक्टर को दुर्घटना के बारे में बताया।

common_mistake.wrong: Describe about your city.
common_mistake.right: Describe your city.
common_mistake.why: 'describe' takes a direct object; 'about' is not used.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ the symptoms to the doctor.

en_def: to make something ready, or to make yourself ready
hi_nuance: 'prepare for an exam' (get ready) vs 'prepare a meal' (make). Indian English often uses 'prepare' where 'cook' or 'make' sounds more natural: 'make tea', not 'prepare tea'.

examples.en: I need to prepare for tomorrow's interview.
examples.hi: मुझे कल के इंटरव्यू की तैयारी करनी है।

examples.en: She prepared a wonderful dinner for us.
examples.hi: उसने हमारे लिए शानदार रात का खाना बनाया।

examples.en: The team is preparing the report for the client.
examples.hi: टीम क्लाइंट के लिए रिपोर्ट तैयार कर रही है।

examples.en: Prepare yourself for some bad news.
examples.hi: कुछ बुरी खबर के लिए खुद को तैयार कर लो।

examples.en: He prepared the room before the guests arrived.
examples.hi: मेहमानों के आने से पहले उसने कमरा तैयार किया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am preparing for going abroad.
common_mistake.right: I am preparing to go abroad.
common_mistake.why: 'prepare' + to-infinitive for an action; 'prepare for' + noun.

cloze.sentence: We must ____ the slides before the meeting.

en_def: to become better or to make something better
hi_nuance: 'improve' is both transitive and intransitive: 'My English improved' and 'I improved my English'. Don't say 'improve up' or 'improvise' (which means to invent on the spot).

examples.en: Your pronunciation has improved a lot.
examples.hi: आपका उच्चारण बहुत सुधर गया है।

examples.en: I want to improve my writing skills.
examples.hi: मैं अपने लेखन कौशल को सुधारना चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: The weather should improve by the weekend.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत तक मौसम बेहतर हो जाना चाहिए।

examples.en: They improved the road last year.
examples.hi: उन्होंने पिछले साल सड़क को बेहतर बनाया।

examples.en: Her health is improving slowly.
examples.hi: उसकी सेहत धीरे-धीरे सुधर रही है।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to improvise my English.
common_mistake.right: I want to improve my English.
common_mistake.why: 'improvise' means to do something without planning; 'improve' means make better.

cloze.sentence: Reading every day will ____ your vocabulary.

en_def: to do an activity regularly in order to get better at it
hi_nuance: In British English the verb is 'practise' (s) and the noun is 'practice' (c). American English uses 'practice' for both. Pattern: 'practise speaking', not 'practise to speak'.

examples.en: I practise English with my colleagues every lunch break.
examples.hi: मैं हर लंच ब्रेक में अपने सहकर्मियों के साथ अंग्रेज़ी का अभ्यास करता हूँ।

examples.en: She practises the piano for an hour a day.
examples.hi: वह दिन में एक घंटा पियानो का अभ्यास करती है।

examples.en: You need to practise speaking, not just reading.
examples.hi: आपको सिर्फ़ पढ़ने का नहीं, बोलने का अभ्यास करना होगा।

examples.en: The team practised hard before the final.
examples.hi: फ़ाइनल से पहले टीम ने कड़ी मेहनत से अभ्यास किया।

examples.en: Practise this sound in front of a mirror.
examples.hi: इस ध्वनि का अभ्यास शीशे के सामने करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I practise to speak English daily.
common_mistake.right: I practise speaking English daily.
common_mistake.why: 'practise' is followed by the -ing form.

cloze.sentence: You should ____ the new words out loud.

en_def: to get something that is sent or given to you
hi_nuance: Hindi 'मिलना' covers 'get', 'meet' and 'receive'. Use 'receive' for things sent to you (mail, calls, payments); use 'meet' for people. Spelling: 'i before e except after c' — receive.

examples.en: I received your email this morning.
examples.hi: मुझे आज सुबह आपका ईमेल मिला।

examples.en: She received a gift from her manager.
examples.hi: उसे अपने मैनेजर से एक उपहार मिला।

examples.en: Did you receive the payment?
examples.hi: क्या आपको भुगतान मिल गया?

examples.en: He received a warm welcome at the airport.
examples.hi: हवाई अड्डे पर उसका गर्मजोशी से स्वागत हुआ।

examples.en: We haven't received any reply yet.
examples.hi: हमें अभी तक कोई जवाब नहीं मिला है।

common_mistake.wrong: I recieved the parcel yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I received the parcel yesterday.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: 'ei' after 'c' — receive.

cloze.sentence: Did you ____ my message last night?

en_def: to agree to take something that is offered, or to agree that something is true
hi_nuance: Don't confuse 'accept' (agree to take) with 'except' (not including). They sound similar but 'except' is a preposition.

examples.en: She accepted the job offer immediately.
examples.hi: उसने नौकरी की पेशकश तुरंत स्वीकार कर ली।

examples.en: We don't accept credit cards, only cash.
examples.hi: हम क्रेडिट कार्ड नहीं लेते, केवल नकद।

examples.en: He finally accepted that he was wrong.
examples.hi: उसने आखिरकार मान लिया कि वह गलत था।

examples.en: Please accept my apologies for the delay.
examples.hi: देरी के लिए कृपया मेरी क्षमा-याचना स्वीकार करें।

examples.en: The university accepted her application.
examples.hi: विश्वविद्यालय ने उसका आवेदन स्वीकार कर लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Everyone came except he accepted the invitation late.
common_mistake.right: Everyone came; he accepted the invitation late.
common_mistake.why: Keep 'accept' (verb: agree to take) separate from 'except' (preposition: not including).

cloze.sentence: I'm happy to ____ your invitation.

en_def: to say that you will not do or accept something
hi_nuance: 'refuse to do', never 'refuse doing'. 'deny' is different: you deny a fact ('I didn't do it'), you refuse an offer or request.

examples.en: He refused to sign the contract.
examples.hi: उसने अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर करने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: She refused my offer of help.
examples.hi: उसने मेरी मदद की पेशकश ठुकरा दी।

examples.en: The child refused to eat his vegetables.
examples.hi: बच्चे ने सब्ज़ियाँ खाने से मना कर दिया।

examples.en: They refused to give us a refund.
examples.hi: उन्होंने हमें पैसे वापस देने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: I can't refuse such a kind invitation.
examples.hi: मैं इतना दयालु निमंत्रण ठुकरा नहीं सकता।

common_mistake.wrong: He refused that he took the money.
common_mistake.right: He denied that he took the money.
common_mistake.why: You 'deny' a fact; you 'refuse' a request or offer.

cloze.sentence: The manager ____ to approve my leave.

en_def: to say that you are unhappy or not satisfied about something
hi_nuance: Pattern: 'complain to someone about something'. The noun is 'complaint' (with a t). Don't say 'do a complaint'; say 'make a complaint'.

examples.en: The customer complained about the slow service.
examples.hi: ग्राहक ने धीमी सेवा के बारे में शिकायत की।

examples.en: He is always complaining about the weather.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा मौसम के बारे में शिकायत करता रहता है।

examples.en: I complained to the manager and got a refund.
examples.hi: मैंने मैनेजर से शिकायत की और मुझे पैसे वापस मिले।

examples.en: Stop complaining and start working.
examples.hi: शिकायत करना बंद करो और काम शुरू करो।

examples.en: She complained that the room was too cold.
examples.hi: उसने शिकायत की कि कमरा बहुत ठंडा था।

common_mistake.wrong: I complained the manager about the bill.
common_mistake.right: I complained to the manager about the bill.
common_mistake.why: 'complain' needs 'to' before the person and 'about' before the problem.

cloze.sentence: Several guests ____ about the noise last night.

en_def: to say that you are sorry for something you have done
hi_nuance: Pattern: 'apologise to someone for something'. Indian English often says 'sorry for the inconvenience caused'; native English usually drops 'caused'. Spelling: 'apologize' in US English.

examples.en: I apologise for the late reply.
examples.hi: देर से जवाब देने के लिए मैं माफ़ी चाहता हूँ।

examples.en: He apologised to her for shouting.
examples.hi: उसने चिल्लाने के लिए उससे माफ़ी माँगी।

examples.en: You should apologise to your sister.
examples.hi: तुम्हें अपनी बहन से माफ़ी माँगनी चाहिए।

examples.en: The airline apologised for the delay.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने देरी के लिए माफ़ी माँगी।

examples.en: She never apologises, even when she's wrong.
examples.hi: वह कभी माफ़ी नहीं माँगती, तब भी नहीं जब वह गलत हो।

common_mistake.wrong: I apologise you for the mistake.
common_mistake.right: I apologise to you for the mistake.
common_mistake.why: 'apologise' needs 'to' before the person.

cloze.sentence: He ____ for forgetting my birthday.

en_def: to tell someone that you will certainly do something
hi_nuance: Use 'promise to do' or 'promise (that)'. Indian English often says 'I promise you that I will' which is fine, but 'I promise for' is wrong. Noun: 'make/keep/break a promise'.

examples.en: I promise to call you every evening.
examples.hi: मैं वादा करता हूँ कि हर शाम तुम्हें फ़ोन करूँगा।

examples.en: She promised that she would come.
examples.hi: उसने वादा किया कि वह आएगी।

examples.en: He promised me a new phone for my birthday.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे मेरे जन्मदिन पर नया फ़ोन देने का वादा किया।

examples.en: You promised, so you have to keep your word.
examples.hi: तुमने वादा किया था, इसलिए तुम्हें अपनी बात रखनी होगी।

examples.en: The company promises delivery within two days.
examples.hi: कंपनी दो दिनों के भीतर डिलीवरी का वादा करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: He promised for coming on time.
common_mistake.right: He promised to come on time.
common_mistake.why: 'promise' + to-infinitive, not 'for + -ing'.

cloze.sentence: Dad ____ to take us to the zoo on Sunday.

en_def: to mention an idea or plan for someone to think about
hi_nuance: Very common error: 'suggest me'. Say 'suggest something to me' or 'suggest that I ...' or 'suggest doing'. Never 'suggest to do'.

examples.en: I suggest taking the early train.
examples.hi: मेरा सुझाव है कि सुबह वाली ट्रेन लें।

examples.en: She suggested that we meet at the café.
examples.hi: उसने सुझाव दिया कि हम कैफ़े में मिलें।

examples.en: Can you suggest a good restaurant near here?
examples.hi: क्या आप यहाँ पास में कोई अच्छा रेस्तराँ सुझा सकते हैं?

examples.en: The doctor suggested more exercise.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने ज़्यादा व्यायाम करने का सुझाव दिया।

examples.en: He suggested a few changes to the plan.
examples.hi: उसने योजना में कुछ बदलावों का सुझाव दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: Can you suggest me a good book?
common_mistake.right: Can you suggest a good book (to me)?
common_mistake.why: 'suggest' cannot take a person as its direct object.

cloze.sentence: I ____ we start the meeting at ten.

en_def: to say that something is good and worth choosing, or advise someone to do something
hi_nuance: Same grammar as 'suggest': 'recommend doing', 'recommend that', 'recommend something to someone'. Not 'recommend me' and not 'recommend to do'. Spelling: one c, two m's.

examples.en: I recommend this hotel to anyone visiting Jaipur.
examples.hi: जयपुर आने वाले किसी भी व्यक्ति को मैं इस होटल की सिफ़ारिश करता हूँ।

examples.en: My doctor recommended drinking more water.
examples.hi: मेरे डॉक्टर ने ज़्यादा पानी पीने की सलाह दी।

examples.en: Which phone would you recommend?
examples.hi: आप कौन-सा फ़ोन सुझाएँगे?

examples.en: She recommended that I apply for the course.
examples.hi: उसने सिफ़ारिश की कि मैं कोर्स के लिए आवेदन करूँ।

examples.en: This film is highly recommended.
examples.hi: इस फ़िल्म की बहुत सिफ़ारिश की जाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please recommend me a good dentist.
common_mistake.right: Please recommend a good dentist (to me).
common_mistake.why: 'recommend' cannot take a person as its direct object.

cloze.sentence: I'd ____ the fish curry; it's excellent.

en_def: to have the same opinion as someone, or to say yes to a plan
hi_nuance: In English you 'agree' (verb), you are not 'agree' (adjective). 'I am agree' is a very common Indian-English error. Also 'agree with a person', 'agree to a plan', 'agree on a decision'.

examples.en: I agree with you completely.
examples.hi: मैं आपसे पूरी तरह सहमत हूँ।

examples.en: They agreed to meet again next week.
examples.hi: वे अगले हफ़्ते फिर मिलने पर राज़ी हो गए।

examples.en: We couldn't agree on a name for the baby.
examples.hi: हम बच्चे के नाम पर सहमत नहीं हो सके।

examples.en: Do you agree that the price is too high?
examples.hi: क्या आप मानते हैं कि कीमत बहुत ज़्यादा है?

examples.en: Everyone agreed with the new plan.
examples.hi: सभी नई योजना से सहमत थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am agree with you.
common_mistake.right: I agree with you.
common_mistake.why: 'agree' is a verb, so it does not need 'am/is/are' before it.

cloze.sentence: I don't ____ with his decision.

en_def: to speak angrily because you disagree, or to give reasons for an opinion
hi_nuance: Hindi 'बहस' usually means an angry fight, but 'argue' can also be calm: 'She argued that we should wait.' 'argue with a person', 'argue about a topic'.

examples.en: My parents never argue in front of us.
examples.hi: मेरे माता-पिता हमारे सामने कभी बहस नहीं करते।

examples.en: They argued about money all the time.
examples.hi: वे हर समय पैसों को लेकर बहस करते थे।

examples.en: He argued that the plan was too expensive.
examples.hi: उसने तर्क दिया कि योजना बहुत महँगी थी।

examples.en: Don't argue with the referee.
examples.hi: रेफ़री से बहस मत करो।

examples.en: I could argue either side of this question.
examples.hi: मैं इस सवाल के दोनों पक्षों में तर्क दे सकता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: They argued on the bill.
common_mistake.right: They argued about the bill.
common_mistake.why: Use 'about' for the topic of an argument.

cloze.sentence: Please don't ____ with your brother over small things.

en_def: to talk about something with other people, especially to make a decision
hi_nuance: Mistake number one for Hindi speakers: 'discuss about'. 'discuss' already contains 'about'. Say 'discuss the plan'. The noun is 'discussion about/on'.

examples.en: Let's discuss the budget in tomorrow's meeting.
examples.hi: चलिए कल की मीटिंग में बजट पर चर्चा करते हैं।

examples.en: We discussed the problem for two hours.
examples.hi: हमने दो घंटे तक समस्या पर चर्चा की।

examples.en: I'd like to discuss your progress.
examples.hi: मैं आपकी प्रगति पर बात करना चाहूँगा।

examples.en: They refused to discuss the matter.
examples.hi: उन्होंने मामले पर चर्चा करने से इनकार कर दिया।

examples.en: Have you discussed this with your family?
examples.hi: क्या आपने इस बारे में अपने परिवार से बात की है?

common_mistake.wrong: We will discuss about the project tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: We will discuss the project tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'discuss' takes a direct object; 'about' is never used with the verb.

cloze.sentence: Can we ____ the schedule after lunch?

en_def: to speak or write about something briefly
hi_nuance: 'mention something to someone', not 'mention about'. 'Don't mention it' is a polite reply to 'thank you'.

examples.en: She mentioned that she was leaving the company.
examples.hi: उसने ज़िक्र किया कि वह कंपनी छोड़ रही है।

examples.en: He didn't mention the price.
examples.hi: उसने कीमत का ज़िक्र नहीं किया।

examples.en: Did I mention that I got the job?
examples.hi: क्या मैंने बताया कि मुझे नौकरी मिल गई?

examples.en: Please mention your order number in the email.
examples.hi: कृपया ईमेल में अपना ऑर्डर नंबर लिखें।

examples.en: Thanks for the lift! — Don't mention it.
examples.hi: लिफ़्ट के लिए धन्यवाद! — कोई बात नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: He mentioned about the meeting.
common_mistake.right: He mentioned the meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'mention' takes a direct object; no 'about'.

cloze.sentence: She didn't ____ anything about the delay.

en_def: to see or become aware of something
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes use 'notice' for a written sign ('a notice on the board' is correct) but overuse 'noticed' to mean 'observed carefully'. 'notice' is usually sudden and not planned; 'observe' or 'watch' is deliberate.

examples.en: I noticed a small crack in the wall.
examples.hi: मैंने दीवार में एक छोटी दरार देखी।

examples.en: Did you notice how tired she looked?
examples.hi: क्या आपने गौर किया कि वह कितनी थकी हुई लग रही थी?

examples.en: Nobody noticed that he had left.
examples.hi: किसी ने ध्यान नहीं दिया कि वह चला गया था।

examples.en: You'll notice a big difference after a week.
examples.hi: एक हफ़्ते बाद आपको बड़ा फ़र्क़ दिखेगा।

examples.en: He noticed me and waved.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे देखा और हाथ हिलाया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am noticing that you look upset.
common_mistake.right: I notice that you look upset.
common_mistake.why: 'notice' describes perception and is normally used in the simple form, not continuous.

cloze.sentence: Did you ____ the new sign outside the office?

en_def: to understand or become aware of something suddenly
hi_nuance: Hindi speakers sometimes say 'I got to know' where 'I realised' fits better. 'realise' is a mental change, not learning a fact from someone. Not used in continuous form. US spelling: realize.

examples.en: I suddenly realised I had left my wallet at home.
examples.hi: मुझे अचानक एहसास हुआ कि मैं अपना बटुआ घर पर छोड़ आया था।

examples.en: She didn't realise how late it was.
examples.hi: उसे एहसास नहीं हुआ कि कितनी देर हो गई थी।

examples.en: Do you realise what you've done?
examples.hi: क्या तुम्हें एहसास है कि तुमने क्या किया है?

examples.en: He realised that he was on the wrong bus.
examples.hi: उसे समझ आया कि वह गलत बस में था।

examples.en: I realise this is difficult for you.
examples.hi: मैं समझता हूँ कि यह आपके लिए मुश्किल है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am realising my mistake now.
common_mistake.right: I realise my mistake now.
common_mistake.why: 'realise' is a state of understanding; the simple form is natural.

cloze.sentence: He ____ too late that the shop was closed.

en_def: to think that something will probably happen
hi_nuance: Hindi 'उम्मीद' translates as both 'hope' and 'expect'. 'expect' means you think it WILL happen; 'hope' means you WANT it to. 'I expect a call' (it is planned) vs 'I hope he calls' (I wish).

examples.en: I expect the parcel to arrive by Thursday.
examples.hi: मुझे उम्मीद है कि पार्सल गुरुवार तक पहुँच जाएगा।

examples.en: We're expecting about fifty guests.
examples.hi: हम लगभग पचास मेहमानों की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: She didn't expect to win the competition.
examples.hi: उसे प्रतियोगिता जीतने की उम्मीद नहीं थी।

examples.en: The boss expects everyone to be on time.
examples.hi: बॉस को उम्मीद है कि सब समय पर आएँगे।

examples.en: It's colder than I expected.
examples.hi: जितना मैंने सोचा था, उससे ज़्यादा ठंड है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am expecting that you will help me.
common_mistake.right: I expect you to help me. / I hope you can help me.
common_mistake.why: 'expect' + object + to-infinitive is the natural pattern; continuous 'am expecting' means 'waiting for' (or pregnancy).

cloze.sentence: We ____ the results next week.

en_def: to want something to happen and think it is possible
hi_nuance: 'hope to do' or 'hope (that)'. Indian English often says 'hope so' correctly but overuses 'hopefully' at the start of formal emails. 'I hope this email finds you well' is fine but very formulaic.

examples.en: I hope you feel better soon.
examples.hi: मुझे उम्मीद है कि आप जल्द ठीक हो जाएँगे।

examples.en: We're hoping to move house in June.
examples.hi: हम जून में घर बदलने की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: She hopes to become a doctor.
examples.hi: वह डॉक्टर बनने की आशा रखती है।

examples.en: I hope it doesn't rain on Saturday.
examples.hi: मुझे आशा है कि शनिवार को बारिश नहीं होगी।

examples.en: Let's hope for the best.
examples.hi: चलो सबसे अच्छे की उम्मीद करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I hope for meeting you soon.
common_mistake.right: I hope to meet you soon.
common_mistake.why: 'hope' + to-infinitive for an action; 'hope for' + noun.

cloze.sentence: I ____ the interview goes well.

en_def: to feel anxious or think about problems that might happen
hi_nuance: 'worry about', 'be worried about'. Hindi speakers sometimes say 'take tension' or 'don't take tension'; the natural phrase is 'don't worry' or 'don't stress'.

examples.en: Don't worry, I'll be there on time.
examples.hi: चिंता मत करो, मैं समय पर वहाँ पहुँच जाऊँगा।

examples.en: She worries about her son's exams.
examples.hi: वह अपने बेटे की परीक्षाओं को लेकर चिंतित रहती है।

examples.en: There's nothing to worry about.
examples.hi: चिंता करने की कोई बात नहीं है।

examples.en: I was worried when you didn't answer the phone.
examples.hi: जब तुमने फ़ोन नहीं उठाया तो मैं चिंतित हो गया।

examples.en: He worries too much about small things.
examples.hi: वह छोटी-छोटी बातों की बहुत चिंता करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Don't take tension about the result.
common_mistake.right: Don't worry about the result.
common_mistake.why: 'take tension' is Indian English; native speakers say 'worry' or 'stress'.

cloze.sentence: My mother always ____ when I travel alone.

en_def: to rest and stop worrying or working
hi_nuance: 'relax' is a verb; the adjective is 'relaxed', the noun is 'relaxation'. Don't say 'I feel relax'. 'Take rest' is Indian English; say 'get some rest' or 'relax'.

examples.en: I like to relax with a book on Sundays.
examples.hi: मुझे रविवार को किताब के साथ आराम करना पसंद है।

examples.en: Relax! The exam isn't until next month.
examples.hi: आराम से! परीक्षा अगले महीने तक नहीं है।

examples.en: A warm bath helps me relax.
examples.hi: गर्म पानी से नहाना मुझे तनावमुक्त करने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: She relaxed once the guests had gone.
examples.hi: मेहमानों के जाने के बाद उसने चैन की साँस ली।

examples.en: Try to relax your shoulders.
examples.hi: अपने कंधों को ढीला छोड़ने की कोशिश करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I feel very relax today.
common_mistake.right: I feel very relaxed today.
common_mistake.why: After 'feel' you need the adjective 'relaxed', not the verb 'relax'.

cloze.sentence: After work I just want to ____ and watch TV.

en_def: to get pleasure from something
hi_nuance: 'enjoy' must have an object: 'enjoy the party', 'enjoy yourself', 'enjoy doing'. 'I enjoyed' with nothing after it is incomplete. Never 'enjoy to do'.

examples.en: I really enjoyed the film last night.
examples.hi: मुझे कल रात की फ़िल्म सचमुच बहुत पसंद आई।

examples.en: She enjoys cooking for her friends.
examples.hi: उसे अपने दोस्तों के लिए खाना बनाने में मज़ा आता है।

examples.en: Did you enjoy your holiday?
examples.hi: क्या आपको अपनी छुट्टियों में मज़ा आया?

examples.en: Enjoy yourselves at the party!
examples.hi: पार्टी में खूब मज़े करना!

examples.en: We enjoyed every minute of the trip.
examples.hi: हमने यात्रा के हर पल का आनंद लिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I enjoy to play cricket.
common_mistake.right: I enjoy playing cricket.
common_mistake.why: 'enjoy' is always followed by the -ing form.

cloze.sentence: We ____ the concert very much.

en_def: to like one thing more than another
hi_nuance: 'prefer X to Y', not 'prefer X than Y'. 'would prefer to do' or 'would rather do'. Not used in continuous: 'I am preferring' is wrong.

examples.en: I prefer tea to coffee.
examples.hi: मुझे कॉफ़ी से ज़्यादा चाय पसंद है।

examples.en: She prefers working from home.
examples.hi: वह घर से काम करना ज़्यादा पसंद करती है।

examples.en: Would you prefer to sit inside or outside?
examples.hi: क्या आप अंदर बैठना पसंद करेंगे या बाहर?

examples.en: Most people prefer the morning flight.
examples.hi: ज़्यादातर लोग सुबह की उड़ान पसंद करते हैं।

examples.en: I'd prefer not to talk about it.
examples.hi: मैं इस बारे में बात न करना बेहतर समझूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: I prefer trains than buses.
common_mistake.right: I prefer trains to buses.
common_mistake.why: 'prefer' is followed by 'to', not 'than'.

cloze.sentence: Do you ____ window or aisle seats?

en_def: to stay away from something, or to stop something from happening
hi_nuance: 'avoid' + -ing, never 'avoid to do'. Hindi speakers sometimes use 'avoid' for people rudely ('he avoided me' is fine), but 'ignore' means you saw them and paid no attention.

examples.en: I avoid driving in the city during rush hour.
examples.hi: मैं भीड़ के समय शहर में गाड़ी चलाने से बचता हूँ।

examples.en: She avoided answering the question.
examples.hi: उसने सवाल का जवाब देने से बचने की कोशिश की।

examples.en: Try to avoid sugary drinks.
examples.hi: मीठे पेय पदार्थों से बचने की कोशिश करें।

examples.en: We took the back road to avoid the traffic.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक से बचने के लिए हमने पीछे वाली सड़क ली।

examples.en: He's been avoiding me since the argument.
examples.hi: बहस के बाद से वह मुझसे बच रहा है।

common_mistake.wrong: You should avoid to eat late at night.
common_mistake.right: You should avoid eating late at night.
common_mistake.why: 'avoid' is always followed by the -ing form.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ using your phone during the lecture.

en_def: to let someone do something; to give permission
hi_nuance: Pattern: 'allow someone to do' or 'be allowed to do'. Not 'allow to do' without an object and not 'allow doing something' unless there is no person mentioned ('They don't allow smoking').

examples.en: My parents don't allow me to stay out late.
examples.hi: मेरे माता-पिता मुझे देर तक बाहर रहने की इजाज़त नहीं देते।

examples.en: Photography is not allowed inside the temple.
examples.hi: मंदिर के अंदर फ़ोटो खींचने की अनुमति नहीं है।

examples.en: The teacher allowed us to use a dictionary.
examples.hi: शिक्षक ने हमें शब्दकोश इस्तेमाल करने की अनुमति दी।

examples.en: Are we allowed to park here?
examples.hi: क्या हमें यहाँ गाड़ी खड़ी करने की इजाज़त है?

examples.en: Please allow two days for delivery.
examples.hi: कृपया डिलीवरी के लिए दो दिन का समय दें।

common_mistake.wrong: They didn't allow to enter the hall.
common_mistake.right: They didn't allow us to enter the hall.
common_mistake.why: 'allow' needs an object (the person) before 'to + verb'.

cloze.sentence: Visitors are not ____ to feed the animals.

en_def: to be owned by someone, or to be a member of a group or in the right place
hi_nuance: 'belong to' + owner. Indian English uses 'I belong to Gujarat' to mean 'I am from Gujarat'; native speakers say 'I'm from Gujarat'. 'belong' is not used in continuous form.

examples.en: This bag belongs to my sister.
examples.hi: यह बैग मेरी बहन का है।

examples.en: Who does this umbrella belong to?
examples.hi: यह छाता किसका है?

examples.en: These plates belong in the top cupboard.
examples.hi: ये प्लेटें ऊपर वाली अलमारी में रखी जाती हैं।

examples.en: He belongs to a local cricket club.
examples.hi: वह एक स्थानीय क्रिकेट क्लब का सदस्य है।

examples.en: I felt I didn't belong at the party.
examples.hi: मुझे लगा कि मैं पार्टी में फिट नहीं बैठता।

common_mistake.wrong: I belong to Ahmedabad.
common_mistake.right: I'm from Ahmedabad.
common_mistake.why: 'belong to' is for ownership or membership; for your hometown say 'I'm from'.

cloze.sentence: That red car ____ to our neighbour.

en_def: to need someone or something, or to be decided by something else
hi_nuance: Always 'depend on', never 'depend upon' in casual speech (it's fine but formal) and never 'depend of' or 'depend from'. 'It depends' can stand alone as a reply.

examples.en: The price depends on the size of the room.
examples.hi: कीमत कमरे के आकार पर निर्भर करती है।

examples.en: Children depend on their parents for everything.
examples.hi: बच्चे हर चीज़ के लिए अपने माता-पिता पर निर्भर रहते हैं।

examples.en: Are you coming tonight? — It depends.
examples.hi: क्या तुम आज रात आ रहे हो? — देखते हैं, निर्भर करता है।

examples.en: You can depend on him to be honest.
examples.hi: आप उस पर ईमानदार होने के लिए भरोसा कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: Whether we go depends on the weather.
examples.hi: हम जाएँगे या नहीं, यह मौसम पर निर्भर है।

common_mistake.wrong: It depends of the weather.
common_mistake.right: It depends on the weather.
common_mistake.why: 'depend' is followed by 'on' (or formal 'upon'), never 'of'.

cloze.sentence: Success ____ on hard work and a bit of luck.

en_def: to have something inside
hi_nuance: 'contain' is what a box or document has inside; 'include' is one part of a larger whole. 'This bottle contains water' but 'The price includes tax'. Not used in continuous form.

examples.en: This bottle contains one litre of water.
examples.hi: इस बोतल में एक लीटर पानी है।

examples.en: The file contains all the customer details.
examples.hi: फ़ाइल में ग्राहकों का सारा विवरण है।

examples.en: Does this dish contain nuts?
examples.hi: क्या इस व्यंजन में मेवे हैं?

examples.en: The letter contained some bad news.
examples.hi: पत्र में कुछ बुरी खबर थी।

examples.en: Each box contains twelve pens.
examples.hi: हर डिब्बे में बारह पेन हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This box is containing old photos.
common_mistake.right: This box contains old photos.
common_mistake.why: 'contain' is a state verb and is not used in the continuous form.

cloze.sentence: The report ____ several errors.

en_def: to make or grow something
hi_nuance: Stress changes meaning: proDUCE (verb) vs PROduce (noun: fruit and vegetables). Indian English sometimes says 'produce a document' formally meaning 'show', which is correct but formal.

examples.en: This factory produces two thousand cars a month.
examples.hi: यह फ़ैक्टरी महीने में दो हज़ार कारें बनाती है।

examples.en: India produces a lot of rice and wheat.
examples.hi: भारत बहुत सारा चावल और गेहूँ पैदा करता है।

examples.en: The new policy produced good results.
examples.hi: नई नीति से अच्छे परिणाम मिले।

examples.en: Bees produce honey.
examples.hi: मधुमक्खियाँ शहद बनाती हैं।

examples.en: She produced her ID card at the gate.
examples.hi: उसने गेट पर अपना पहचान पत्र दिखाया।

common_mistake.wrong: The company produce mobile phones.
common_mistake.right: The company produces mobile phones.
common_mistake.why: 'company' is singular, so the verb needs third-person -s.

cloze.sentence: Solar panels ____ electricity from sunlight.

en_def: to take goods or letters to a place, or to give a speech
hi_nuance: 'deliver something to someone'. The noun is 'delivery'. 'deliver a speech' means give a speech. Don't say 'deliver me the parcel' — say 'deliver the parcel to me'.

examples.en: They deliver groceries within an hour.
examples.hi: वे एक घंटे के भीतर किराने का सामान पहुँचा देते हैं।

examples.en: The postman delivered the letter this morning.
examples.hi: डाकिया आज सुबह चिट्ठी दे गया।

examples.en: Can you deliver it to my office address?
examples.hi: क्या आप इसे मेरे ऑफ़िस के पते पर पहुँचा सकते हैं?

examples.en: She delivered an excellent speech.
examples.hi: उसने एक शानदार भाषण दिया।

examples.en: We promise to deliver on time.
examples.hi: हम समय पर डिलीवर करने का वादा करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please deliver me the package by Monday.
common_mistake.right: Please deliver the package to me by Monday.
common_mistake.why: 'deliver' takes the thing first, then 'to + person'.

cloze.sentence: The courier will ____ the documents tomorrow.

en_def: to ask for food, goods, or a service; or to tell someone to do something
hi_nuance: 'order food', 'order online', 'order someone to do'. The noun 'order' also means sequence ('in alphabetical order') and tidiness ('in order'). Not 'order for a pizza'.

examples.en: I ordered a pizza for dinner.
examples.hi: मैंने रात के खाने के लिए पिज़्ज़ा ऑर्डर किया।

examples.en: Have you ordered the new laptop yet?
examples.hi: क्या आपने नया लैपटॉप ऑर्डर कर दिया?

examples.en: The officer ordered them to leave.
examples.hi: अधिकारी ने उन्हें जाने का आदेश दिया।

examples.en: Are you ready to order, sir?
examples.hi: क्या आप ऑर्डर देने के लिए तैयार हैं, सर?

examples.en: We ordered too much food.
examples.hi: हमने बहुत ज़्यादा खाना ऑर्डर कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I ordered for two coffees.
common_mistake.right: I ordered two coffees.
common_mistake.why: 'order' takes a direct object; no 'for' before the thing you order.

cloze.sentence: Let's ____ some snacks before the film starts.

en_def: to decide that a planned event or arrangement will not happen
hi_nuance: British spelling doubles the L in 'cancelled'; US uses 'canceled'. Don't say 'the meeting is cancel' — you need 'cancelled' (past participle) after 'is'.

examples.en: The flight was cancelled because of fog.
examples.hi: कोहरे की वजह से उड़ान रद्द कर दी गई।

examples.en: I had to cancel my dentist appointment.
examples.hi: मुझे अपना डेंटिस्ट का अपॉइंटमेंट रद्द करना पड़ा।

examples.en: You can cancel the order within 24 hours.
examples.hi: आप 24 घंटे के भीतर ऑर्डर रद्द कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: They cancelled the match due to rain.
examples.hi: बारिश के कारण उन्होंने मैच रद्द कर दिया।

examples.en: Please cancel my subscription.
examples.hi: कृपया मेरी सदस्यता रद्द कर दें।

common_mistake.wrong: The class is cancel today.
common_mistake.right: The class is cancelled today.
common_mistake.why: After 'is', you need the past participle 'cancelled', not the base form.

cloze.sentence: We had to ____ the picnic because of the storm.

en_def: to bring things together, or to go and get someone or something
hi_nuance: In British English you 'collect' a parcel or a child from school (US: 'pick up'). Indian English often uses 'collect' for money ('collect the fees') which is correct.

examples.en: I'll collect the kids from school at three.
examples.hi: मैं तीन बजे बच्चों को स्कूल से ले आऊँगा।

examples.en: He collects old coins as a hobby.
examples.hi: वह शौक के तौर पर पुराने सिक्के इकट्ठा करता है।

examples.en: You can collect your parcel from the post office.
examples.hi: आप अपना पार्सल डाकघर से ले सकते हैं।

examples.en: We collected money for the flood victims.
examples.hi: हमने बाढ़ पीड़ितों के लिए पैसे इकट्ठा किए।

examples.en: The teacher collected the exam papers.
examples.hi: शिक्षक ने परीक्षा के पेपर इकट्ठा किए।

common_mistake.wrong: I will collect you from the station.
common_mistake.right: I will pick you up from the station. / I will collect you from the station.
common_mistake.why: Both are correct in British English; note 'collect' is used for people in UK English but 'pick up' is more common everywhere.

cloze.sentence: She ____ shells on the beach every summer.

en_def: to repair something, or to arrange a time or place
hi_nuance: Indian English uses 'fix' for making appointments ('fix a meeting') — this is fine but 'set up' or 'arrange' is more common. For repair, 'fix' is more casual than 'repair'.

examples.en: Can you fix my bike? The chain is broken.
examples.hi: क्या आप मेरी साइकिल ठीक कर सकते हैं? चेन टूट गई है।

examples.en: The plumber fixed the leaking tap.
examples.hi: प्लंबर ने टपकते नल को ठीक कर दिया।

examples.en: Let's fix a time for the call.
examples.hi: चलिए कॉल के लिए एक समय तय करते हैं।

examples.en: I fixed the bug in the code last night.
examples.hi: मैंने कल रात कोड की गड़बड़ी ठीक कर दी।

examples.en: The date for the wedding is fixed.
examples.hi: शादी की तारीख़ तय हो गई है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have to fix up a meeting with the client.
common_mistake.right: I have to set up a meeting with the client.
common_mistake.why: 'fix up' means to repair or decorate; for arranging meetings use 'set up' or 'arrange'.

cloze.sentence: My brother knows how to ____ almost anything.

en_def: to mend something that is broken or damaged
hi_nuance: 'repair' is slightly more formal than 'fix'. Indian English says 'give it for repairing'; native speakers say 'get it repaired' or 'take it to be repaired'.

examples.en: The mechanic repaired the engine in two hours.
examples.hi: मैकेनिक ने दो घंटे में इंजन की मरम्मत कर दी।

examples.en: We need to repair the roof before the monsoon.
examples.hi: हमें मानसून से पहले छत की मरम्मत करनी होगी।

examples.en: My phone screen is cracked; I must get it repaired.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़ोन की स्क्रीन टूट गई है; मुझे इसे ठीक करवाना होगा।

examples.en: The road was repaired last month.
examples.hi: पिछले महीने सड़क की मरम्मत की गई थी।

examples.en: It costs more to repair than to replace.
examples.hi: मरम्मत कराने में बदलने से ज़्यादा खर्च आता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave my laptop for repairing.
common_mistake.right: I took my laptop to be repaired. / I got my laptop repaired.
common_mistake.why: 'give for repairing' is Indian English; native speakers use 'get/have something repaired'.

cloze.sentence: The lift is under ____ until Friday.

en_def: to look carefully for something
hi_nuance: 'search FOR the thing you want' but 'search THE PLACE'. 'I searched my bag for the keys.' Don't say 'search the keys'. Online you 'search for' or 'google' something.

examples.en: I searched the whole house for my keys.
examples.hi: मैंने अपनी चाबियों के लिए पूरा घर छान मारा।

examples.en: Police searched the area for clues.
examples.hi: पुलिस ने सुराग के लिए इलाके की तलाशी ली।

examples.en: She searched online for a cheaper flight.
examples.hi: उसने सस्ती उड़ान के लिए ऑनलाइन खोज की।

examples.en: We searched everywhere but couldn't find it.
examples.hi: हमने हर जगह खोजा लेकिन वह नहीं मिला।

examples.en: Just search for the word in the app.
examples.hi: बस ऐप में उस शब्द को सर्च करो।

common_mistake.wrong: I am searching my glasses.
common_mistake.right: I am searching for my glasses.
common_mistake.why: You search FOR the thing you are looking for.

cloze.sentence: He ____ his pockets for some change.

en_def: to keep money for the future, or to stop someone or something from harm
hi_nuance: 'save money', 'save time', 'save a life', 'save a file'. 'save up for' means collect money for a goal. Don't confuse with 'safe' (adjective).

examples.en: I'm saving up for a new bike.
examples.hi: मैं नई बाइक के लिए पैसे बचा रहा हूँ।

examples.en: Taking the metro saves a lot of time.
examples.hi: मेट्रो लेने से बहुत समय बचता है।

examples.en: The doctors saved his life.
examples.hi: डॉक्टरों ने उसकी जान बचाई।

examples.en: Don't forget to save the document.
examples.hi: दस्तावेज़ सेव करना मत भूलना।

examples.en: She saves a little money every month.
examples.hi: वह हर महीने थोड़े पैसे बचाती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to safe some money.
common_mistake.right: I want to save some money.
common_mistake.why: 'safe' is an adjective; the verb is 'save'.

cloze.sentence: Buying in bulk can ____ you a lot of money.

en_def: to use something badly or use more than you need
hi_nuance: 'waste money/time on something' or 'waste time doing'. Don't confuse with 'waist' (part of the body). As a noun: 'a waste of time'.

examples.en: Don't waste water while brushing your teeth.
examples.hi: दाँत साफ़ करते समय पानी बर्बाद न करें।

examples.en: I wasted two hours waiting for the bus.
examples.hi: मैंने बस का इंतज़ार करते हुए दो घंटे बर्बाद कर दिए।

examples.en: That meeting was a complete waste of time.
examples.hi: वह मीटिंग समय की पूरी बर्बादी थी।

examples.en: He wastes money on things he never uses.
examples.hi: वह उन चीज़ों पर पैसे बर्बाद करता है जिनका वह कभी इस्तेमाल नहीं करता।

examples.en: Stop wasting your talent.
examples.hi: अपनी प्रतिभा बर्बाद करना बंद करो।

common_mistake.wrong: Don't waste your time for watching TV.
common_mistake.right: Don't waste your time watching TV.
common_mistake.why: 'waste time' is followed directly by the -ing form.

cloze.sentence: We ____ a lot of food at weddings.

en_def: to receive money for work that you do
hi_nuance: Indian English sometimes asks 'How much do you get?' or 'What is your package?'; natural is 'How much do you earn?' or 'What's your salary?'. 'earn' is also used for respect or a reputation.

examples.en: She earns a good salary at the bank.
examples.hi: वह बैंक में अच्छी तनख़्वाह कमाती है।

examples.en: How much do you earn a month?
examples.hi: आप महीने में कितना कमाते हैं?

examples.en: He earned extra money by teaching in the evenings.
examples.hi: उसने शाम को पढ़ाकर अतिरिक्त पैसे कमाए।

examples.en: You have to earn people's trust.
examples.hi: आपको लोगों का भरोसा जीतना पड़ता है।

examples.en: I started earning when I was twenty.
examples.hi: मैंने बीस साल की उम्र में कमाना शुरू किया।

common_mistake.wrong: What is your package per month?
common_mistake.right: How much do you earn a month?
common_mistake.why: 'package' is Indian corporate English; use 'earn' or 'salary'.

cloze.sentence: Doctors ____ more than teachers in most countries.

en_def: to have enough money or time to do or buy something
hi_nuance: Almost always used with 'can/can't/could': 'I can't afford it'. Followed by a noun or 'to + verb'. Don't say 'afford for'.

examples.en: I can't afford a new car right now.
examples.hi: मैं अभी नई कार का खर्च नहीं उठा सकता।

examples.en: We can't afford to lose this client.
examples.hi: हम इस क्लाइंट को खोने का जोखिम नहीं उठा सकते।

examples.en: Can you afford the rent in that area?
examples.hi: क्या आप उस इलाके का किराया दे पाएँगे?

examples.en: They could barely afford food.
examples.hi: वे मुश्किल से खाने का खर्च उठा पाते थे।

examples.en: I can afford to take a week off.
examples.hi: मैं एक हफ़्ते की छुट्टी ले सकता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I cannot afford for a holiday this year.
common_mistake.right: I cannot afford a holiday this year.
common_mistake.why: 'afford' takes a direct object; no 'for'.

cloze.sentence: We can't ____ to eat out every day.

en_def: to have a particular price
hi_nuance: 'How much does it cost?' is the natural question, not 'How much is its cost?' or 'What is the cost?'. Past and participle are both 'cost'.

examples.en: How much does this jacket cost?
examples.hi: इस जैकेट की कीमत कितनी है?

examples.en: The repairs cost more than we expected.
examples.hi: मरम्मत में हमारी उम्मीद से ज़्यादा खर्च आया।

examples.en: Tickets cost five hundred rupees each.
examples.hi: टिकट पाँच सौ रुपये प्रति व्यक्ति हैं।

examples.en: It didn't cost me anything; it was free.
examples.hi: इसमें मेरा कुछ खर्च नहीं हुआ; यह मुफ़्त था।

examples.en: That mistake cost him his job.
examples.hi: उस गलती की वजह से उसकी नौकरी चली गई।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the cost of this shirt?
common_mistake.right: How much does this shirt cost?
common_mistake.why: Both are grammatical, but 'How much does it cost?' is the natural everyday question.

cloze.sentence: A cup of coffee here ____ two hundred rupees!

en_def: to ask someone to pay an amount of money; to put electricity into a battery
hi_nuance: 'charge someone for something'. 'free of charge' means no cost. Don't say 'charge an amount from me'; say 'charge me an amount'.

examples.en: They charged me three hundred rupees for delivery.
examples.hi: उन्होंने मुझसे डिलीवरी के लिए तीन सौ रुपये लिए।

examples.en: How much do you charge per hour?
examples.hi: आप प्रति घंटे कितना शुल्क लेते हैं?

examples.en: I need to charge my phone before we leave.
examples.hi: जाने से पहले मुझे अपना फ़ोन चार्ज करना है।

examples.en: The museum doesn't charge for children.
examples.hi: संग्रहालय बच्चों से शुल्क नहीं लेता।

examples.en: Delivery is free of charge.
examples.hi: डिलीवरी मुफ़्त है।

common_mistake.wrong: They charged fifty rupees from me.
common_mistake.right: They charged me fifty rupees.
common_mistake.why: 'charge' takes the person as its object, not 'from + person'.

cloze.sentence: The taxi driver ____ us extra for the luggage.

en_def: to have or use something with other people, or to tell people something
hi_nuance: 'share something WITH someone'. Indian English says 'share me the file'; correct is 'share the file with me'. As a noun: 'shares' in a company, 'my share of the bill'.

examples.en: I share a flat with two friends.
examples.hi: मैं दो दोस्तों के साथ फ़्लैट शेयर करता हूँ।

examples.en: Can you share the document with me?
examples.hi: क्या आप मेरे साथ दस्तावेज़ साझा कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: We shared a pizza and a bottle of cola.
examples.hi: हमने एक पिज़्ज़ा और कोला की एक बोतल बाँटी।

examples.en: She shared her experience with the new employees.
examples.hi: उसने नए कर्मचारियों के साथ अपना अनुभव साझा किया।

examples.en: Let's share the cost of the taxi.
examples.hi: चलो टैक्सी का खर्च बाँट लेते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Please share me the photos.
common_mistake.right: Please share the photos with me.
common_mistake.why: 'share' takes the thing first, then 'with + person'.

cloze.sentence: He never ____ his notes with anyone.

en_def: to become a member of a group, or to come together with someone
hi_nuance: 'join a club/company' (no preposition); 'join in' an activity. Indian English says 'join with' or 'I will join the company from Monday' — say 'I start on Monday'.

examples.en: I joined the company in 2021.
examples.hi: मैं 2021 में कंपनी में शामिल हुआ।

examples.en: Why don't you join us for dinner?
examples.hi: आप हमारे साथ रात के खाने में क्यों नहीं शामिल होते?

examples.en: She joined a gym near her office.
examples.hi: उसने अपने ऑफ़िस के पास एक जिम जॉइन किया।

examples.en: The two roads join near the temple.
examples.hi: दोनों सड़कें मंदिर के पास मिलती हैं।

examples.en: Everyone joined in the singing.
examples.hi: सब लोग गाने में शामिल हो गए।

common_mistake.wrong: I will join with your team next week.
common_mistake.right: I will join your team next week.
common_mistake.why: 'join' takes a direct object; no 'with' for groups.

cloze.sentence: Would you like to ____ our study group?

en_def: to ask someone to come to an event or to do something
hi_nuance: 'invite someone TO an event' or 'invite someone to do something'. Noun: 'invitation' (formal), 'invite' (informal). Don't say 'invite for a party'.

examples.en: They invited us to their wedding.
examples.hi: उन्होंने हमें अपनी शादी में आमंत्रित किया।

examples.en: I've been invited to give a talk next month.
examples.hi: मुझे अगले महीने भाषण देने के लिए बुलाया गया है।

examples.en: Why don't you invite your colleagues over for dinner?
examples.hi: तुम अपने सहकर्मियों को रात के खाने पर घर क्यों नहीं बुलाते?

examples.en: She wasn't invited to the meeting.
examples.hi: उसे मीटिंग में नहीं बुलाया गया था।

examples.en: We invited everyone from the office.
examples.hi: हमने ऑफ़िस के सभी लोगों को बुलाया।

common_mistake.wrong: He invited me for his birthday party.
common_mistake.right: He invited me to his birthday party.
common_mistake.why: 'invite' is followed by 'to' before the event.

cloze.sentence: Did you ____ Priya to the picnic?

en_def: to do something enjoyable because of a special occasion
hi_nuance: 'celebrate a birthday/festival/success'. Indian English often uses 'celebrate' with 'do' ('do the celebration'); just say 'celebrate'.

examples.en: We celebrated Diwali with the whole family.
examples.hi: हमने पूरे परिवार के साथ दिवाली मनाई।

examples.en: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
examples.hi: आप आम तौर पर अपना जन्मदिन कैसे मनाते हैं?

examples.en: The team celebrated the win with a dinner.
examples.hi: टीम ने जीत का जश्न रात के खाने के साथ मनाया।

examples.en: Let's celebrate! You passed the exam!
examples.hi: चलो जश्न मनाते हैं! तुम परीक्षा में पास हो गए!

examples.en: They are celebrating their tenth anniversary.
examples.hi: वे अपनी दसवीं सालगिरह मना रहे हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We did celebration of his promotion.
common_mistake.right: We celebrated his promotion.
common_mistake.why: Use the verb 'celebrate' rather than 'do celebration'.

cloze.sentence: Many Indians ____ Holi with colours and music.

en_def: to cause pain or injury, or to feel pain
hi_nuance: 'hurt' is irregular: hurt – hurt – hurt. Hindi speakers often say 'I got hurt' correctly but also 'my leg is paining' — say 'my leg hurts'. 'hurt' also means emotional pain.

examples.en: My back hurts after sitting all day.
examples.hi: पूरा दिन बैठने के बाद मेरी पीठ में दर्द होता है।

examples.en: She hurt her ankle playing badminton.
examples.hi: बैडमिंटन खेलते हुए उसके टखने में चोट लग गई।

examples.en: Careful! You'll hurt yourself.
examples.hi: सावधान! तुम्हें चोट लग जाएगी।

examples.en: His words really hurt me.
examples.hi: उसकी बातों से मुझे सचमुच दुख पहुँचा।

examples.en: Does it hurt when I press here?
examples.hi: जब मैं यहाँ दबाता हूँ तो क्या दर्द होता है?

common_mistake.wrong: My head is paining since morning.
common_mistake.right: My head has been hurting since morning. / I've had a headache since morning.
common_mistake.why: 'paining' is not used in native English; use 'hurts' or 'aches'.

cloze.sentence: He ____ his knee when he fell off the bike.

en_def: the act of travelling from one place to another, especially a long distance
hi_nuance: 'journey' is the travelling itself; 'trip' is the whole visit including the stay; 'travel' is the general activity. Indian English overuses 'journey' for short trips ('office journey'); say 'commute'.

examples.en: The journey from Delhi to Jaipur takes about five hours.
examples.hi: दिल्ली से जयपुर का सफ़र लगभग पाँच घंटे का है।

examples.en: Have a safe journey!
examples.hi: आपकी यात्रा सुरक्षित हो!

examples.en: It was a long and tiring journey.
examples.hi: यह एक लंबा और थकाऊ सफ़र था।

examples.en: We broke the journey in Nashik for lunch.
examples.hi: हमने दोपहर के खाने के लिए नासिक में यात्रा रोकी।

examples.en: Learning a language is a journey, not a race.
examples.hi: भाषा सीखना एक सफ़र है, दौड़ नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: My daily journey to office is one hour.
common_mistake.right: My daily commute to the office is one hour.
common_mistake.why: For regular travel to work use 'commute'; 'journey' is for longer or one-off travel.

cloze.sentence: The bus ____ took nearly ten hours.

en_def: a visit to a place, usually short, and back again
hi_nuance: 'go on a trip', 'business trip', 'day trip'. Indian English often says 'tour' for a holiday ('we went on a tour to Goa'); 'trip' is the everyday word. 'trip' as a verb means to fall over something.

examples.en: We're going on a trip to Ooty next month.
examples.hi: हम अगले महीने ऊटी की यात्रा पर जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: He's away on a business trip until Friday.
examples.hi: वह शुक्रवार तक बिज़नेस ट्रिप पर है।

examples.en: How was your trip?
examples.hi: आपकी यात्रा कैसी रही?

examples.en: It's only a short trip to the market.
examples.hi: बाज़ार तक बस थोड़ी ही दूरी है।

examples.en: The school organised a day trip to the museum.
examples.hi: स्कूल ने संग्रहालय की एक दिन की सैर आयोजित की।

common_mistake.wrong: We went to Goa for a tour.
common_mistake.right: We went on a trip to Goa.
common_mistake.why: 'tour' implies a guided visit to many places; a holiday visit is a 'trip'.

cloze.sentence: She's planning a ____ to Ladakh in July.

en_def: a journey in an aircraft
hi_nuance: 'catch/miss/board a flight'. Indian English says 'my flight is at 6' (correct) but also 'I have a flight to catch tomorrow' (fine). 'flight' also means a set of stairs.

examples.en: My flight leaves at seven in the morning.
examples.hi: मेरी उड़ान सुबह सात बजे रवाना होती है।

examples.en: We nearly missed our flight because of the traffic.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक की वजह से हम अपनी उड़ान लगभग चूक गए थे।

examples.en: Is there a direct flight to Singapore?
examples.hi: क्या सिंगापुर के लिए सीधी उड़ान है?

examples.en: The flight was delayed by two hours.
examples.hi: उड़ान दो घंटे देर से थी।

examples.en: It's a three-hour flight to Dubai.
examples.hi: दुबई की उड़ान तीन घंटे की है।

common_mistake.wrong: I will take flight to Chennai tomorrow.
common_mistake.right: I will take a flight to Chennai tomorrow.
common_mistake.why: 'flight' is countable and needs an article.

cloze.sentence: Our ____ to London was cancelled.

en_def: a piece of paper or a digital pass that shows you have paid to travel or enter
hi_nuance: 'buy/book a ticket', 'ticket for the concert', 'ticket to Mumbai'. A 'ticket' can also be a fine from the police ('parking ticket'). Plural 'tickets' — Indian English sometimes drops the -s.

examples.en: I bought two tickets for the concert.
examples.hi: मैंने कॉन्सर्ट के लिए दो टिकट खरीदे।

examples.en: Can I see your ticket, please?
examples.hi: क्या मैं आपका टिकट देख सकता हूँ?

examples.en: Train tickets are cheaper if you book early.
examples.hi: जल्दी बुक करने पर ट्रेन के टिकट सस्ते मिलते हैं।

examples.en: He got a parking ticket outside the mall.
examples.hi: मॉल के बाहर उसे पार्किंग का चालान मिला।

examples.en: A return ticket costs eight hundred rupees.
examples.hi: आने-जाने का टिकट आठ सौ रुपये का है।

common_mistake.wrong: I booked three ticket for the show.
common_mistake.right: I booked three tickets for the show.
common_mistake.why: 'ticket' is countable; use the plural after a number.

cloze.sentence: Please keep your ____ until the end of the journey.

en_def: the bags and suitcases you take when you travel
hi_nuance: 'luggage' is uncountable: 'a piece of luggage', 'some luggage', never 'luggages' or 'a luggage'. 'baggage' is the same and is used at airports.

examples.en: How much luggage are you taking?
examples.hi: आप कितना सामान ले जा रहे हैं?

examples.en: You can leave your luggage at the hotel reception.
examples.hi: आप अपना सामान होटल के रिसेप्शन पर छोड़ सकते हैं।

examples.en: My luggage didn't arrive with the flight.
examples.hi: मेरा सामान उड़ान के साथ नहीं पहुँचा।

examples.en: Each passenger is allowed one piece of hand luggage.
examples.hi: हर यात्री को हाथ का एक सामान ले जाने की अनुमति है।

examples.en: The luggage was too heavy to carry.
examples.hi: सामान उठाने के लिए बहुत भारी था।

common_mistake.wrong: We have three luggages.
common_mistake.right: We have three pieces of luggage. / We have three bags.
common_mistake.why: 'luggage' is uncountable and has no plural form.

cloze.sentence: Please don't leave your ____ unattended.

en_def: an official document that shows who you are and lets you travel to other countries
hi_nuance: 'renew a passport', 'passport expires', 'valid passport'. Indian English says 'passport size photo' — the standard term is 'passport photo'.

examples.en: Don't forget your passport at the airport.
examples.hi: हवाई अड्डे पर अपना पासपोर्ट मत भूलना।

examples.en: My passport expires next year.
examples.hi: मेरा पासपोर्ट अगले साल समाप्त हो रहा है।

examples.en: You need a valid passport to travel abroad.
examples.hi: विदेश यात्रा के लिए आपको वैध पासपोर्ट चाहिए।

examples.en: She applied for a new passport last week.
examples.hi: उसने पिछले हफ़्ते नए पासपोर्ट के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: The officer checked our passports carefully.
examples.hi: अधिकारी ने हमारे पासपोर्ट ध्यान से जाँचे।

common_mistake.wrong: I need two passport size photos.
common_mistake.right: I need two passport photos.
common_mistake.why: 'passport-size' is understood but 'passport photo' is the standard native term.

cloze.sentence: Please have your ____ ready for inspection.

en_def: the place someone or something is going to
hi_nuance: 'reach your destination', 'holiday destination'. Don't confuse with 'destiny' (fate). Stress is on the third syllable: des-ti-NA-tion.

examples.en: We finally reached our destination after eight hours.
examples.hi: आठ घंटे बाद हम आखिरकार अपनी मंज़िल पर पहुँचे।

examples.en: Goa is a popular holiday destination.
examples.hi: गोवा एक लोकप्रिय पर्यटन स्थल है।

examples.en: What's your final destination?
examples.hi: आपका अंतिम गंतव्य क्या है?

examples.en: The parcel is on its way to its destination.
examples.hi: पार्सल अपने गंतव्य की ओर जा रहा है।

examples.en: Please enter your destination in the app.
examples.hi: कृपया ऐप में अपना गंतव्य दर्ज करें।

common_mistake.wrong: It was my destiny to go to Manali.
common_mistake.right: Manali was my destination.
common_mistake.why: 'destiny' means fate; the place you are travelling to is your 'destination'.

cloze.sentence: The train's final ____ is Howrah.

en_def: a time when you do not go to work or school, or a period of travel for pleasure
hi_nuance: British 'holiday' = American 'vacation'. 'on holiday', not 'in holiday'. 'holidays' plural for the whole period. Indian English uses 'leave' for days off from work — that's correct too.

examples.en: We're going on holiday to Kerala in December.
examples.hi: हम दिसंबर में केरल में छुट्टियाँ मनाने जा रहे हैं।

examples.en: Monday is a public holiday.
examples.hi: सोमवार को सार्वजनिक अवकाश है।

examples.en: I haven't had a proper holiday in two years.
examples.hi: मुझे दो साल से ठीक से छुट्टी नहीं मिली है।

examples.en: The office is closed for the holidays.
examples.hi: छुट्टियों के लिए ऑफ़िस बंद है।

examples.en: Are you working or on holiday this week?
examples.hi: क्या आप इस हफ़्ते काम कर रहे हैं या छुट्टी पर हैं?

common_mistake.wrong: She is in holiday this week.
common_mistake.right: She is on holiday this week.
common_mistake.why: The fixed phrase is 'on holiday'.

cloze.sentence: Where did you go for your summer ____?

en_def: a place to live or stay
hi_nuance: Uncountable in British English: 'accommodation', not 'accommodations' (US uses plural). Spelling trap: double c, double m. Indian English often uses 'stay' as a noun ('arrange my stay') — 'accommodation' is the standard word.

examples.en: The company provides free accommodation for new staff.
examples.hi: कंपनी नए कर्मचारियों को मुफ़्त आवास देती है।

examples.en: We're looking for cheap accommodation near the university.
examples.hi: हम विश्वविद्यालय के पास सस्ता आवास ढूँढ रहे हैं।

examples.en: Is accommodation included in the price?
examples.hi: क्या कीमत में रहने की व्यवस्था शामिल है?

examples.en: Hotel accommodation is expensive in peak season.
examples.hi: पीक सीज़न में होटल में रहना महँगा है।

examples.en: Have you found accommodation yet?
examples.hi: क्या आपको रहने की जगह मिल गई?

common_mistake.wrong: They arranged our accomodation.
common_mistake.right: They arranged our accommodation.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: two c's and two m's.

cloze.sentence: The university helps students find ____.

en_def: a person who lives next to or near you
hi_nuance: British spelling 'neighbour', US 'neighbor'. 'next-door neighbour'. The area is a 'neighbourhood'. Hindi speakers sometimes say 'neighbours' when they mean 'neighbourhood' (the area).

examples.en: Our neighbours are very friendly.
examples.hi: हमारे पड़ोसी बहुत मिलनसार हैं।

examples.en: I borrowed some sugar from my next-door neighbour.
examples.hi: मैंने अपने बगल वाले पड़ोसी से थोड़ी चीनी माँगी।

examples.en: The neighbours complained about the noise.
examples.hi: पड़ोसियों ने शोर की शिकायत की।

examples.en: She waved to her neighbour across the street.
examples.hi: उसने सड़क के पार अपनी पड़ोसन को हाथ हिलाया।

examples.en: We live in a quiet neighbourhood.
examples.hi: हम एक शांत मोहल्ले में रहते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: There are many shops in my neighbours.
common_mistake.right: There are many shops in my neighbourhood.
common_mistake.why: 'neighbours' are people; the area is the 'neighbourhood'.

cloze.sentence: Our new ____ moved in last week.

en_def: a person you work with
hi_nuance: Indian English often says 'office friend' or 'my company person'; the natural word is 'colleague' (formal) or 'co-worker' (US). Spelling: colleague, not 'collegue'. Not related to 'college'.

examples.en: I'm having lunch with a colleague.
examples.hi: मैं एक सहकर्मी के साथ दोपहर का खाना खा रहा हूँ।

examples.en: My colleagues gave me a farewell gift.
examples.hi: मेरे सहकर्मियों ने मुझे विदाई का तोहफ़ा दिया।

examples.en: She gets on well with her colleagues.
examples.hi: वह अपने सहकर्मियों के साथ अच्छे से घुल-मिल जाती है।

examples.en: A former colleague recommended me for the job.
examples.hi: एक पूर्व सहकर्मी ने मुझे इस नौकरी के लिए सिफ़ारिश की।

examples.en: Let me introduce you to my colleague, Rahul.
examples.hi: मैं आपको अपने सहकर्मी राहुल से मिलवाता हूँ।

common_mistake.wrong: He is my office friend.
common_mistake.right: He is my colleague. / He is a friend from work.
common_mistake.why: 'office friend' is Indian English; use 'colleague' or 'friend from work'.
