cloze.sentence: A ____ helped me finish the report on time.

en_def: a person who buys goods or services from a shop or business
hi_nuance: 'customer' buys from a shop; 'client' uses a professional service (lawyer, consultant); 'guest' stays at a hotel. Indian English often uses 'customer' for all three.

examples.en: The shop was full of customers on Saturday.
examples.hi: शनिवार को दुकान ग्राहकों से भरी थी।

examples.en: The customer is always right.
examples.hi: ग्राहक हमेशा सही होता है।

examples.en: We need to improve our customer service.
examples.hi: हमें अपनी ग्राहक सेवा में सुधार करना होगा।

examples.en: A regular customer asked for a discount.
examples.hi: एक नियमित ग्राहक ने छूट माँगी।

examples.en: Please call customer support for help.
examples.hi: मदद के लिए कृपया ग्राहक सहायता को फ़ोन करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Our lawyer has many customers.
common_mistake.right: Our lawyer has many clients.
common_mistake.why: Professionals like lawyers have 'clients'; shops have 'customers'.

cloze.sentence: The waiter apologised to the angry ____.

en_def: a person who is in charge of a business, department, or team
hi_nuance: Indian English often uses 'boss' or 'my senior'; 'my manager' is neutral and professional. Also 'line manager' (UK) = the person you report to directly. Stress on the first syllable: MAN-a-ger.

examples.en: I need to ask my manager for leave.
examples.hi: मुझे छुट्टी के लिए अपने मैनेजर से पूछना होगा।

examples.en: She was promoted to project manager last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल उसे प्रोजेक्ट मैनेजर के पद पर पदोन्नत किया गया।

examples.en: The hotel manager apologised for the mistake.
examples.hi: होटल मैनेजर ने गलती के लिए माफ़ी माँगी।

examples.en: Can I speak to the manager, please?
examples.hi: क्या मैं मैनेजर से बात कर सकता हूँ?

examples.en: A good manager listens to the team.
examples.hi: एक अच्छा मैनेजर टीम की बात सुनता है।

common_mistake.wrong: My senior told me to finish it today.
common_mistake.right: My manager told me to finish it today.
common_mistake.why: 'my senior' is Indian English; use 'manager', 'boss', or 'team lead'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ called a meeting to discuss the delay.

en_def: a fixed amount of money paid to an employee every month or year
hi_nuance: 'salary' is monthly/annual for professionals; 'wages' are hourly/daily; 'pay' is general. Indian English 'CTC' and 'package' are not understood abroad; say 'salary'.

examples.en: My salary is paid on the last day of the month.
examples.hi: मेरा वेतन महीने के आखिरी दिन दिया जाता है।

examples.en: She asked for a higher salary.
examples.hi: उसने ज़्यादा वेतन माँगा।

examples.en: The job comes with a good salary and benefits.
examples.hi: इस नौकरी में अच्छा वेतन और सुविधाएँ मिलती हैं।

examples.en: Half my salary goes on rent.
examples.hi: मेरी आधी तनख़्वाह किराये में चली जाती है।

examples.en: They haven't paid our salaries for two months.
examples.hi: उन्होंने दो महीने से हमारा वेतन नहीं दिया है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is your CTC?
common_mistake.right: What is your salary?
common_mistake.why: 'CTC' (cost to company) is Indian HR jargon; internationally people say 'salary'.

cloze.sentence: He received a 10% ____ increase this year.

en_def: a formal meeting where someone is asked questions, especially for a job
hi_nuance: 'have/attend an interview', 'interview for a job'. Indian English says 'give an interview' when you are the candidate; native speakers say 'have an interview' or 'go for an interview'. The interviewer 'conducts' it.

examples.en: I have a job interview on Thursday.
examples.hi: गुरुवार को मेरा नौकरी का इंटरव्यू है।

examples.en: She was nervous before the interview.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू से पहले वह घबराई हुई थी।

examples.en: The interview lasted forty-five minutes.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू पैंतालीस मिनट चला।

examples.en: They interviewed ten candidates for the post.
examples.hi: उन्होंने पद के लिए दस उम्मीदवारों का इंटरव्यू लिया।

examples.en: Prepare some questions to ask at the end of the interview.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू के अंत में पूछने के लिए कुछ सवाल तैयार रखें।

common_mistake.wrong: I gave an interview at Infosys yesterday.
common_mistake.right: I had an interview at Infosys yesterday.
common_mistake.why: 'give an interview' means to be interviewed by a journalist; for jobs say 'have an interview'.

cloze.sentence: Wear formal clothes to the ____.

en_def: an arrangement to meet someone at a particular time, especially a doctor or professional
hi_nuance: 'make/book an appointment WITH the doctor', 'have an appointment AT three'. Don't use 'appointment' for social meetings with friends — that's 'meet up' or 'plans'.

examples.en: I have a dentist appointment at four.
examples.hi: चार बजे मेरा डेंटिस्ट के साथ अपॉइंटमेंट है।

examples.en: Can I make an appointment with Dr Mehta?
examples.hi: क्या मैं डॉ. मेहता के साथ अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकता हूँ?

examples.en: She missed her appointment because of the traffic.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक की वजह से वह अपना अपॉइंटमेंट चूक गई।

examples.en: Please arrive ten minutes before your appointment.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने अपॉइंटमेंट से दस मिनट पहले पहुँचें।

examples.en: Visits are by appointment only.
examples.hi: मुलाक़ात केवल पूर्व-निर्धारित समय पर ही होती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have an appointment with my friend for coffee.
common_mistake.right: I'm meeting my friend for coffee.
common_mistake.why: 'appointment' is for professional or medical meetings, not casual social plans.

cloze.sentence: I need to book an ____ with the eye doctor.

en_def: an event where people come together to discuss something
hi_nuance: 'have/hold/attend a meeting', 'in a meeting'. Indian English says 'I am in a meeting' correctly but also 'take a meeting' (US business slang, avoid). Don't say 'do a meeting'.

examples.en: We have a team meeting every Monday morning.
examples.hi: हर सोमवार सुबह हमारी टीम मीटिंग होती है।

examples.en: Sorry, she's in a meeting right now.
examples.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, वह अभी मीटिंग में हैं।

examples.en: The meeting was postponed until Friday.
examples.hi: मीटिंग शुक्रवार तक के लिए टाल दी गई।

examples.en: Can you take notes during the meeting?
examples.hi: क्या आप मीटिंग के दौरान नोट्स ले सकते हैं?

examples.en: Let's set up a meeting with the client.
examples.hi: चलिए क्लाइंट के साथ मीटिंग तय करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: We did a meeting with the vendor.
common_mistake.right: We had a meeting with the vendor.
common_mistake.why: Use 'have' or 'hold' with 'meeting', not 'do'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ starts at ten sharp.

en_def: the latest time or date by which something must be finished
hi_nuance: 'meet a deadline' (finish on time), 'miss a deadline', 'tight deadline'. Indian English sometimes says 'last date' — that's fine for forms, but at work use 'deadline'.

examples.en: The deadline for the report is Friday at five.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट की अंतिम तिथि शुक्रवार पाँच बजे है।

examples.en: We worked all night to meet the deadline.
examples.hi: समय-सीमा पूरी करने के लिए हमने पूरी रात काम किया।

examples.en: I missed the deadline by one day.
examples.hi: मैं समय-सीमा से एक दिन चूक गया।

examples.en: Can we extend the deadline by a week?
examples.hi: क्या हम समय-सीमा एक हफ़्ता बढ़ा सकते हैं?

examples.en: She always works better under a tight deadline.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा कम समय-सीमा में बेहतर काम करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: What is the last date for the project?
common_mistake.right: What is the deadline for the project?
common_mistake.why: 'last date' is used for applications; for work tasks say 'deadline'.

cloze.sentence: We have a strict ____ for this task.

en_def: a plan that shows when things will happen or be done
hi_nuance: UK pronunciation 'SHED-yool', US 'SKED-jool'; both are fine. 'on schedule' = on time; 'behind schedule' = late; 'ahead of schedule' = early. As a verb: 'schedule a meeting'.

examples.en: What's your schedule like next week?
examples.hi: अगले हफ़्ते आपका कार्यक्रम कैसा है?

examples.en: The project is running behind schedule.
examples.hi: परियोजना तय समय से पीछे चल रही है।

examples.en: The train arrived on schedule.
examples.hi: ट्रेन तय समय पर पहुँची।

examples.en: Let's schedule the call for Tuesday afternoon.
examples.hi: चलिए कॉल मंगलवार दोपहर के लिए तय करते हैं।

examples.en: I have a very busy schedule this month.
examples.hi: इस महीने मेरा कार्यक्रम बहुत व्यस्त है।

common_mistake.wrong: The meeting is preponed to Monday.
common_mistake.right: The meeting has been moved forward to Monday. / The meeting has been rescheduled for Monday.
common_mistake.why: 'prepone' is Indian English; native speakers say 'bring forward' or 'move up'.

cloze.sentence: Can you send me the training ____?

en_def: knowledge or skill from doing something; or an event that affects you
hi_nuance: Two meanings: uncountable 'work experience' (no plural) and countable 'an experience' (an event). 'I have five years' experience', not 'five years of experiences'. Indian English says 'I am having experience' — use 'I have'.

examples.en: I have three years' experience in software testing.
examples.hi: मुझे सॉफ़्टवेयर टेस्टिंग में तीन साल का अनुभव है।

examples.en: The trip to Ladakh was an amazing experience.
examples.hi: लद्दाख की यात्रा एक अद्भुत अनुभव थी।

examples.en: You'll gain a lot of experience in this role.
examples.hi: इस भूमिका में आपको बहुत अनुभव मिलेगा।

examples.en: She has no experience of working abroad.
examples.hi: उसे विदेश में काम करने का कोई अनुभव नहीं है।

examples.en: Learn from your experiences.
examples.hi: अपने अनुभवों से सीखो।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having five years experience in sales.
common_mistake.right: I have five years' experience in sales.
common_mistake.why: 'have' for possession is not used in the continuous form; also note 'years'' (possessive).

cloze.sentence: This job requires at least two years' ____.

en_def: a chance to do something good or useful
hi_nuance: 'opportunity to do', 'opportunity for'. Countable: 'an opportunity', 'many opportunities'. Indian English often uses 'chance' and 'opportunity' interchangeably; 'opportunity' is more formal and positive.

examples.en: This job is a great opportunity for you.
examples.hi: यह नौकरी आपके लिए एक बेहतरीन अवसर है।

examples.en: I never had the opportunity to study abroad.
examples.hi: मुझे कभी विदेश में पढ़ने का मौका नहीं मिला।

examples.en: There are many opportunities in the IT sector.
examples.hi: आईटी क्षेत्र में बहुत सारे अवसर हैं।

examples.en: Don't miss this opportunity.
examples.hi: इस मौके को हाथ से मत जाने दो।

examples.en: Thank you for giving me this opportunity.
examples.hi: मुझे यह अवसर देने के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: It is a good opportunity for learn new things.
common_mistake.right: It is a good opportunity to learn new things.
common_mistake.why: 'opportunity' is followed by a to-infinitive.

cloze.sentence: The internship is a good ____ to gain experience.

en_def: an opinion about what someone should do
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'some advice', 'a piece of advice', never 'an advice' or 'advices'. Verb is 'advise' (with s, pronounced /z/). Hindi 'सलाह' is countable, which causes the error.

examples.en: Can I give you some advice?
examples.hi: क्या मैं आपको कुछ सलाह दे सकता हूँ?

examples.en: My father gave me a useful piece of advice.
examples.hi: मेरे पिता ने मुझे एक उपयोगी सलाह दी।

examples.en: I took her advice and applied for the job.
examples.hi: मैंने उसकी सलाह मानी और नौकरी के लिए आवेदन किया।

examples.en: Ask the doctor for advice about your diet.
examples.hi: अपने आहार के बारे में डॉक्टर से सलाह लें।

examples.en: Thanks for the advice; it really helped.
examples.hi: सलाह के लिए धन्यवाद; इससे सचमुच मदद मिली।

common_mistake.wrong: He gave me many advices.
common_mistake.right: He gave me a lot of advice.
common_mistake.why: 'advice' is uncountable and has no plural.

cloze.sentence: Let me give you a piece of ____.

en_def: facts or details about something
hi_nuance: Uncountable: never 'informations' or 'an information'. Say 'some information', 'a piece of information', 'a lot of information'. Hindi 'जानकारियाँ' is plural, which causes this classic error.

examples.en: I need more information about the course.
examples.hi: मुझे कोर्स के बारे में और जानकारी चाहिए।

examples.en: The website has a lot of useful information.
examples.hi: वेबसाइट पर बहुत सारी उपयोगी जानकारी है।

examples.en: Where can I get information about visas?
examples.hi: मुझे वीज़ा के बारे में जानकारी कहाँ मिल सकती है?

examples.en: This information is confidential.
examples.hi: यह जानकारी गोपनीय है।

examples.en: Thank you for the information.
examples.hi: जानकारी के लिए धन्यवाद।

common_mistake.wrong: Please send me the informations.
common_mistake.right: Please send me the information.
common_mistake.why: 'information' is uncountable; it has no plural form.

cloze.sentence: For more ____, visit our website.

en_def: large objects such as tables, chairs, and beds used in a room
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'a piece of furniture', 'some furniture', never 'furnitures'. Same rule as 'luggage', 'equipment', 'information'.

examples.en: We bought new furniture for the living room.
examples.hi: हमने बैठक के लिए नया फ़र्नीचर खरीदा।

examples.en: The flat comes with furniture.
examples.hi: फ़्लैट फ़र्नीचर के साथ आता है।

examples.en: That old table is my favourite piece of furniture.
examples.hi: वह पुरानी मेज़ मेरा पसंदीदा फ़र्नीचर है।

examples.en: The furniture shop is having a sale.
examples.hi: फ़र्नीचर की दुकान पर सेल चल रही है।

examples.en: Moving all this furniture will take hours.
examples.hi: यह सारा फ़र्नीचर ले जाने में घंटों लगेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: They sell good furnitures.
common_mistake.right: They sell good furniture.
common_mistake.why: 'furniture' is uncountable; it has no plural.

cloze.sentence: The room was empty except for a few pieces of ____.

en_def: the tools or machines needed for a particular activity
hi_nuance: Uncountable: 'a piece of equipment', not 'equipments'. Indian technical English very often writes 'equipments' — avoid it in reports.

examples.en: The gym has modern equipment.
examples.hi: जिम में आधुनिक उपकरण हैं।

examples.en: We need new equipment for the lab.
examples.hi: हमें प्रयोगशाला के लिए नए उपकरण चाहिए।

examples.en: Please switch off all electrical equipment.
examples.hi: कृपया सभी बिजली के उपकरण बंद कर दें।

examples.en: A camera is an expensive piece of equipment.
examples.hi: कैमरा एक महँगा उपकरण है।

examples.en: The office equipment was delivered yesterday.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस के उपकरण कल पहुँचा दिए गए।

common_mistake.wrong: All the equipments are ready.
common_mistake.right: All the equipment is ready.
common_mistake.why: 'equipment' is uncountable and takes a singular verb.

cloze.sentence: Divers need special ____ to breathe underwater.

en_def: a piece of paper that shows you have paid for something
hi_nuance: The 'p' is silent: /rɪˈsiːt/. Indian English often says 'bill' for a receipt; a 'bill' is what you must pay, a 'receipt' is proof you paid. 'Keep the receipt' for returns.

examples.en: Can I have a receipt, please?
examples.hi: क्या मुझे रसीद मिल सकती है?

examples.en: Keep your receipt in case you want to return it.
examples.hi: रसीद रखें, कहीं आपको इसे लौटाना पड़े।

examples.en: I lost the receipt, so they wouldn't give me a refund.
examples.hi: मैंने रसीद खो दी, इसलिए उन्होंने पैसे वापस नहीं दिए।

examples.en: The receipt shows the date of purchase.
examples.hi: रसीद पर खरीद की तारीख़ लिखी है।

examples.en: Please attach the receipts to your expense claim.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने खर्च के दावे के साथ रसीदें संलग्न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: Please give me the bill after payment.
common_mistake.right: Please give me the receipt after payment.
common_mistake.why: The 'bill' comes before you pay; the 'receipt' is what you get after.

cloze.sentence: You'll need the ____ to exchange the shirt.

en_def: a reduction in the usual price
hi_nuance: 'a 20% discount ON something', 'get/give a discount'. Don't say 'discount of 20%' — 'a 20% discount' is more natural. Indian English: 'What is the best price?' — natural: 'Can you give me a discount?'

examples.en: Students get a ten per cent discount.
examples.hi: छात्रों को दस प्रतिशत की छूट मिलती है।

examples.en: Is there any discount on this laptop?
examples.hi: क्या इस लैपटॉप पर कोई छूट है?

examples.en: They're offering big discounts during the festival.
examples.hi: वे त्योहार के दौरान बड़ी छूट दे रहे हैं।

examples.en: I got the shoes at a discount.
examples.hi: मुझे जूते छूट पर मिले।

examples.en: Can you give me a discount if I buy two?
examples.hi: अगर मैं दो खरीदूँ तो क्या आप मुझे छूट देंगे?

common_mistake.wrong: They gave discount of 20% on shoes.
common_mistake.right: They gave a 20% discount on shoes.
common_mistake.why: 'discount' is countable; use 'a' and put the percentage before it.

cloze.sentence: The shop offers a ____ to regular customers.

en_def: money that is given back to you because you are not satisfied or something was cancelled
hi_nuance: Noun stress: RE-fund; verb stress: re-FUND. 'get/ask for/give a refund', 'full refund'. Indian English says 'return the money' — 'refund' is the precise word.

examples.en: I asked for a refund because the shirt was damaged.
examples.hi: शर्ट खराब होने के कारण मैंने पैसे वापस माँगे।

examples.en: The airline gave us a full refund.
examples.hi: एयरलाइन ने हमें पूरा रिफ़ंड दिया।

examples.en: You can get a refund within fourteen days.
examples.hi: आप चौदह दिनों के भीतर पैसे वापस पा सकते हैं।

examples.en: They refunded the money to my card.
examples.hi: उन्होंने पैसे मेरे कार्ड में वापस कर दिए।

examples.en: No refunds on sale items.
examples.hi: सेल के सामान पर कोई रिफ़ंड नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to return back my money.
common_mistake.right: I want a refund.
common_mistake.why: 'refund' is the specific word for money returned; 'return back' is redundant.

cloze.sentence: The ticket is non-refundable, so you can't get a ____.

en_def: how good or bad something is
hi_nuance: 'good/high/poor quality'. Indian English says 'quality is good' — fine. As an adjective in 'quality products' it means 'high quality'. Don't confuse with 'quantity' (amount).

examples.en: The quality of the food was excellent.
examples.hi: खाने की गुणवत्ता बहुत अच्छी थी।

examples.en: We sell only high-quality products.
examples.hi: हम केवल उच्च गुणवत्ता वाले उत्पाद बेचते हैं।

examples.en: The photo is poor quality; I can't read the text.
examples.hi: फ़ोटो की गुणवत्ता खराब है; मैं पाठ नहीं पढ़ सकता।

examples.en: Quality matters more than quantity.
examples.hi: मात्रा से ज़्यादा गुणवत्ता मायने रखती है।

examples.en: Honesty is her best quality.
examples.hi: ईमानदारी उसका सबसे अच्छा गुण है।

common_mistake.wrong: This cloth is very good quality material.
common_mistake.right: This is very good-quality material.
common_mistake.why: 'quality' modifies 'material' directly; 'cloth' and 'material' repeat the same idea.

cloze.sentence: The ____ of this phone camera is impressive.

en_def: a type of product made by a particular company
hi_nuance: 'brand' is the company name (Nike); 'make' is used for cars ('What make is it?'); 'model' is the specific version. Indian English says 'branded clothes' for expensive labels — native speakers say 'designer clothes'.

examples.en: Which brand of phone do you use?
examples.hi: आप कौन-से ब्रांड का फ़ोन इस्तेमाल करते हैं?

examples.en: It's a well-known brand of coffee.
examples.hi: यह कॉफ़ी का एक जाना-माना ब्रांड है।

examples.en: I don't care about brands; I just want it to work.
examples.hi: मुझे ब्रांड की परवाह नहीं; बस काम करना चाहिए।

examples.en: The company launched a new brand of soap.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने साबुन का नया ब्रांड लॉन्च किया।

examples.en: Brand-new means completely new and unused.
examples.hi: 'ब्रांड-न्यू' का मतलब है बिल्कुल नया और अप्रयुक्त।

common_mistake.wrong: He only wears branded clothes.
common_mistake.right: He only wears designer clothes.
common_mistake.why: 'branded' in native English means marked with a brand logo; for expensive labels say 'designer'.

cloze.sentence: This ____ of shoes is very popular with runners.

en_def: the act of bringing goods or letters to a place
hi_nuance: 'free delivery', 'home delivery', 'delivery charge'. Indian English says 'delivery boy'; more neutral is 'delivery driver' or 'courier'. 'take delivery of' means receive.

examples.en: Delivery usually takes three to five days.
examples.hi: डिलीवरी में आम तौर पर तीन से पाँच दिन लगते हैं।

examples.en: Is there a charge for home delivery?
examples.hi: क्या होम डिलीवरी के लिए कोई शुल्क है?

examples.en: We offer free delivery on orders over five hundred rupees.
examples.hi: हम पाँच सौ रुपये से ऊपर के ऑर्डर पर मुफ़्त डिलीवरी देते हैं।

examples.en: The delivery driver left the parcel with my neighbour.
examples.hi: डिलीवरी ड्राइवर पार्सल मेरे पड़ोसी के पास छोड़ गया।

examples.en: You'll get a message when your delivery is on its way.
examples.hi: जब आपकी डिलीवरी रास्ते में होगी तो आपको संदेश मिलेगा।

common_mistake.wrong: The delivery boy came at nine.
common_mistake.right: The delivery driver came at nine.
common_mistake.why: 'boy' sounds disrespectful in native English; use 'delivery driver' or 'courier'.

cloze.sentence: Same-day ____ is available in most cities.

en_def: a substance used to treat illness; also the science of treating illness
hi_nuance: 'take medicine', not 'eat medicine' or 'have medicine'. Usually uncountable ('some medicine'); countable when talking about different types. Hindi 'दवा खाना' causes 'eat medicine'.

examples.en: Take this medicine twice a day after meals.
examples.hi: यह दवा दिन में दो बार खाने के बाद लें।

examples.en: Did you take your medicine this morning?
examples.hi: क्या आपने आज सुबह अपनी दवा ली?

examples.en: She's studying medicine at university.
examples.hi: वह विश्वविद्यालय में चिकित्सा की पढ़ाई कर रही है।

examples.en: Keep all medicines away from children.
examples.hi: सभी दवाएँ बच्चों की पहुँच से दूर रखें।

examples.en: The medicine made me feel sleepy.
examples.hi: दवा से मुझे नींद आने लगी।

common_mistake.wrong: I ate the medicine after lunch.
common_mistake.right: I took the medicine after lunch.
common_mistake.why: In English you 'take' medicine; 'eat' is only for food.

cloze.sentence: The doctor gave me some ____ for the cough.

en_def: a pain in your head
hi_nuance: Countable: 'I have a headache' (with 'a'). Never 'my head is paining'. Similarly: 'a stomach ache', 'toothache' (usually no article in UK), 'backache'. 'ache' is pronounced /eɪk/.

examples.en: I have a terrible headache.
examples.hi: मुझे बहुत तेज़ सिरदर्द है।

examples.en: Too much screen time gives me a headache.
examples.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा स्क्रीन देखने से मुझे सिरदर्द हो जाता है।

examples.en: She took a tablet for her headache.
examples.hi: उसने सिरदर्द के लिए एक गोली ली।

examples.en: The noise is giving me a headache.
examples.hi: शोर से मेरा सिर दुख रहा है।

examples.en: Organising the trip was a real headache.
examples.hi: यात्रा का आयोजन करना सचमुच सिरदर्द था।

common_mistake.wrong: I have headache since morning.
common_mistake.right: I've had a headache since this morning.
common_mistake.why: 'headache' is countable and needs 'a'; also use present perfect with 'since'.

cloze.sentence: Do you have anything for a ____?

en_def: a body temperature that is higher than normal because of illness
hi_nuance: 'have a fever' (US) or 'have a temperature' (UK). Indian English 'I am having fever' should be 'I have a fever'. 'high fever', 'run a fever'. 'viral fever' is Indian usage; say 'a viral infection'.

examples.en: He has a high fever and needs to rest.
examples.hi: उसे तेज़ बुख़ार है और उसे आराम की ज़रूरत है।

examples.en: The child's fever went down after the medicine.
examples.hi: दवा के बाद बच्चे का बुख़ार उतर गया।

examples.en: I stayed home because I had a fever.
examples.hi: बुख़ार होने की वजह से मैं घर पर रहा।

examples.en: A fever is a sign that your body is fighting infection.
examples.hi: बुख़ार इस बात का संकेत है कि आपका शरीर संक्रमण से लड़ रहा है।

examples.en: Call the doctor if the fever lasts more than two days.
examples.hi: अगर बुख़ार दो दिन से ज़्यादा रहे तो डॉक्टर को बुलाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: I am having fever since two days.
common_mistake.right: I have had a fever for two days.
common_mistake.why: Use 'have' (not continuous), add 'a', and use 'for' with a period of time.

cloze.sentence: She couldn't come to work because of a ____.

en_def: physical harm or damage to someone's body
hi_nuance: Countable: 'an injury', 'serious injuries'. Verb: 'injure', adjective: 'injured'. 'wound' is usually from a weapon; 'injury' is general (sport, accidents).

examples.en: He suffered a serious injury in the accident.
examples.hi: दुर्घटना में उसे गंभीर चोट लगी।

examples.en: Luckily, nobody had any injuries.
examples.hi: सौभाग्य से, किसी को चोट नहीं आई।

examples.en: The player is out for a month with a knee injury.
examples.hi: घुटने की चोट के कारण खिलाड़ी एक महीने के लिए बाहर है।

examples.en: Wear a helmet to prevent head injuries.
examples.hi: सिर की चोट से बचने के लिए हेलमेट पहनें।

examples.en: She was injured while cycling.
examples.hi: साइकिल चलाते समय उसे चोट लग गई।

common_mistake.wrong: He got injury on his leg.
common_mistake.right: He got an injury to his leg. / He injured his leg.
common_mistake.why: 'injury' is countable and needs 'an'; the preposition is 'to'.

cloze.sentence: The doctor said the ____ would heal in two weeks.

en_def: a disease or period of being unwell
hi_nuance: 'illness' is the general state or period ('after a long illness'); 'disease' is a specific medical condition ('heart disease'). Adjective 'ill' (UK) = 'sick' (US). 'I am ill' not 'I am illness'.

examples.en: She missed a week of work because of illness.
examples.hi: बीमारी की वजह से उसने एक हफ़्ते का काम छोड़ा।

examples.en: He died after a long illness.
examples.hi: लंबी बीमारी के बाद उसकी मृत्यु हो गई।

examples.en: Mental illness is often misunderstood.
examples.hi: मानसिक बीमारी को अक्सर गलत समझा जाता है।

examples.en: Regular exercise can prevent many illnesses.
examples.hi: नियमित व्यायाम से कई बीमारियाँ रोकी जा सकती हैं।

examples.en: Is it a serious illness?
examples.hi: क्या यह कोई गंभीर बीमारी है?

common_mistake.wrong: He has a heart illness.
common_mistake.right: He has heart disease.
common_mistake.why: For a specific medical condition use 'disease'; 'illness' is the general state.

cloze.sentence: The company gives paid leave for ____.

en_def: a shop where medicines are prepared and sold
hi_nuance: Indian English says 'medical shop' or 'medical store'; native speakers say 'pharmacy' or 'chemist's' (UK) or 'drugstore' (US). The person is a 'pharmacist'.

examples.en: Is there a pharmacy near here?
examples.hi: क्या यहाँ पास में कोई दवाखाना है?

examples.en: You can buy painkillers at any pharmacy.
examples.hi: आप किसी भी दवा की दुकान से दर्द निवारक खरीद सकते हैं।

examples.en: The pharmacy is open twenty-four hours.
examples.hi: दवाखाना चौबीस घंटे खुला रहता है।

examples.en: Take this prescription to the pharmacy.
examples.hi: यह पर्ची दवाखाने ले जाएँ।

examples.en: The pharmacist explained how to take the tablets.
examples.hi: फ़ार्मासिस्ट ने बताया कि गोलियाँ कैसे लेनी हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I went to the medical shop to buy tablets.
common_mistake.right: I went to the pharmacy to buy tablets.
common_mistake.why: 'medical shop' is Indian English; the international word is 'pharmacy' or 'chemist's'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ closes at nine, so hurry.

en_def: physical activity to stay healthy; or a task to practise a skill
hi_nuance: 'do exercise' (uncountable, physical) vs 'do an exercise' (countable, a task). Indian English says 'go for exercise' or 'do exercises daily' — say 'exercise every day' (verb) or 'get some exercise'.

examples.en: I try to do thirty minutes of exercise every day.
examples.hi: मैं हर दिन तीस मिनट व्यायाम करने की कोशिश करता हूँ।

examples.en: Regular exercise is good for your heart.
examples.hi: नियमित व्यायाम आपके दिल के लिए अच्छा है।

examples.en: Please complete exercises one to five for homework.
examples.hi: कृपया गृहकार्य के लिए अभ्यास एक से पाँच पूरे करें।

examples.en: Swimming is excellent exercise.
examples.hi: तैराकी एक बेहतरीन व्यायाम है।

examples.en: She exercises at the gym before work.
examples.hi: वह काम से पहले जिम में व्यायाम करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: I go for exercise every morning.
common_mistake.right: I exercise every morning. / I go for a run every morning.
common_mistake.why: Use 'exercise' as a verb, or name the specific activity.

cloze.sentence: Doctors recommend at least 150 minutes of ____ a week.

en_def: feeling fear or worry
hi_nuance: 'afraid' is only used after a verb ('I am afraid'), never before a noun ('an afraid child' is wrong — say 'a frightened child'). 'afraid of' + noun/-ing; 'afraid to do'. 'I'm afraid...' is also a polite way to give bad news.

examples.en: I'm afraid of dogs.
examples.hi: मुझे कुत्तों से डर लगता है।

examples.en: Don't be afraid to ask questions.
examples.hi: सवाल पूछने से मत डरो।

examples.en: She was afraid that she would fail.
examples.hi: उसे डर था कि वह फ़ेल हो जाएगी।

examples.en: I'm afraid the manager isn't available right now.
examples.hi: माफ़ कीजिए, मैनेजर अभी उपलब्ध नहीं हैं।

examples.en: He's afraid of flying.
examples.hi: उसे हवाई जहाज़ से उड़ने में डर लगता है।

common_mistake.wrong: The afraid boy ran away.
common_mistake.right: The frightened boy ran away.
common_mistake.why: 'afraid' cannot come before a noun; use 'frightened' or 'scared' there.

cloze.sentence: Many people are ____ of speaking in public.

en_def: feeling strong displeasure
hi_nuance: 'angry WITH a person', 'angry ABOUT a thing', 'angry AT a situation'. Hindi 'गुस्सा आना' becomes 'get angry'. Indian English says 'angry on me' — that's wrong.

examples.en: My boss was angry with me for being late.
examples.hi: देर से आने के कारण मेरे बॉस मुझसे नाराज़ थे।

examples.en: She gets angry very easily.
examples.hi: उसे बहुत जल्दी गुस्सा आ जाता है।

examples.en: They were angry about the price increase.
examples.hi: वे कीमत बढ़ने से नाराज़ थे।

examples.en: Don't be angry; it was an accident.
examples.hi: गुस्सा मत करो; यह एक दुर्घटना थी।

examples.en: He sent an angry email to the company.
examples.hi: उसने कंपनी को गुस्से भरा ईमेल भेजा।

common_mistake.wrong: She was angry on her brother.
common_mistake.right: She was angry with her brother.
common_mistake.why: Use 'with' for people; 'on' is never used with 'angry'.

cloze.sentence: Why are you so ____ today?

en_def: worried and nervous about something that might happen
hi_nuance: 'anxious about' something. Also 'anxious to do' means eager. Indian English uses 'tensed' ('I am very tensed'); native speakers say 'anxious', 'stressed', or 'tense' (no -d).

examples.en: I'm anxious about my exam results.
examples.hi: मैं अपने परीक्षा परिणामों को लेकर चिंतित हूँ।

examples.en: She felt anxious before the presentation.
examples.hi: प्रस्तुति से पहले वह बेचैन महसूस कर रही थी।

examples.en: Parents are naturally anxious about their children.
examples.hi: माता-पिता स्वाभाविक रूप से अपने बच्चों को लेकर चिंतित रहते हैं।

examples.en: He was anxious to get home before dark.
examples.hi: वह अँधेरा होने से पहले घर पहुँचने को उत्सुक था।

examples.en: Try not to look anxious in the interview.
examples.hi: इंटरव्यू में चिंतित दिखने की कोशिश न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very tensed about the interview.
common_mistake.right: I am very anxious about the interview.
common_mistake.why: 'tensed' is not an adjective in English; use 'anxious', 'tense', or 'stressed'.

cloze.sentence: He was ____ about the results of the blood test.

en_def: feeling guilty or embarrassed about something you did
hi_nuance: 'ashamed OF' something. Only after a verb, never before a noun. 'ashamed' is about guilt for your own actions; 'embarrassed' is about looking silly; 'shy' is a personality trait. Hindi 'शर्म' covers all three.

examples.en: I'm ashamed of the way I behaved.
examples.hi: मुझे अपने व्यवहार पर शर्म आती है।

examples.en: He was ashamed to admit he had lied.
examples.hi: उसे यह मानने में शर्म आई कि उसने झूठ बोला था।

examples.en: You should be ashamed of yourself!
examples.hi: तुम्हें खुद पर शर्म आनी चाहिए!

examples.en: There's nothing to be ashamed of.
examples.hi: इसमें शर्मिंदा होने की कोई बात नहीं है।

examples.en: She felt ashamed of her poor English.
examples.hi: उसे अपनी कमज़ोर अंग्रेज़ी पर शर्म आती थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I felt ashamed for my mistake.
common_mistake.right: I felt ashamed of my mistake.
common_mistake.why: 'ashamed' is followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: He was ____ of having lost his temper.

en_def: feeling tired and unhappy because something is not interesting
hi_nuance: Classic -ed/-ing confusion: 'I am bored' (my feeling) vs 'I am boring' (I make others bored). 'bored WITH' something. Hindi speakers also say 'I got bore' — say 'I got bored'.

examples.en: I'm bored; let's go out somewhere.
examples.hi: मैं ऊब गया हूँ; चलो कहीं बाहर चलते हैं।

examples.en: The students looked bored during the lecture.
examples.hi: व्याख्यान के दौरान छात्र ऊबे हुए लग रहे थे।

examples.en: She got bored with the film and switched it off.
examples.hi: वह फ़िल्म से ऊब गई और उसने उसे बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: I'm bored of eating the same food every day.
examples.hi: मैं रोज़ एक जैसा खाना खाकर ऊब गया हूँ।

examples.en: He was bored stiff at the wedding.
examples.hi: शादी में वह बुरी तरह ऊब गया था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am boring in this class.
common_mistake.right: I am bored in this class.
common_mistake.why: 'bored' describes how you feel; 'boring' describes something that causes boredom.

cloze.sentence: The children got ____ after an hour of waiting.

en_def: not interesting
hi_nuance: The thing is 'boring'; the person who feels it is 'bored'. Saying 'I am boring' tells people YOU are dull. Same pattern: interesting/interested, exciting/excited, tiring/tired.

examples.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म इतनी उबाऊ थी कि मुझे नींद आ गई।

examples.en: His speech was long and boring.
examples.hi: उसका भाषण लंबा और नीरस था।

examples.en: Is your job boring or interesting?
examples.hi: आपका काम उबाऊ है या दिलचस्प?

examples.en: It's a boring little town with nothing to do.
examples.hi: यह एक उबाऊ छोटा शहर है जहाँ करने को कुछ नहीं है।

examples.en: Data entry is boring but necessary.
examples.hi: डेटा एंट्री उबाऊ है लेकिन ज़रूरी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I was very boring at the party.
common_mistake.right: I was very bored at the party.
common_mistake.why: 'boring' means you make others bored; 'bored' is what you felt.

cloze.sentence: The lecture was so ____ that half the class left.

en_def: unable to think clearly or understand something
hi_nuance: 'confused ABOUT' something. Indian English often uses 'confuse' as an adjective ('I am confuse'); the adjective is 'confused'. Also 'confusing' = something that causes confusion.

examples.en: I'm confused about the new tax rules.
examples.hi: मैं नए कर नियमों को लेकर उलझन में हूँ।

examples.en: The instructions were confusing, so I got confused.
examples.hi: निर्देश भ्रमित करने वाले थे, इसलिए मैं उलझ गया।

examples.en: She looked confused when I explained the plan.
examples.hi: जब मैंने योजना समझाई तो वह उलझन में दिखी।

examples.en: Don't get confused between 'lend' and 'borrow'.
examples.hi: 'lend' और 'borrow' के बीच भ्रमित न हों।

examples.en: I was confused by all the different options.
examples.hi: मैं सारे अलग-अलग विकल्पों से भ्रमित हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I am confuse about which course to choose.
common_mistake.right: I am confused about which course to choose.
common_mistake.why: The adjective is 'confused'; 'confuse' is the verb.

cloze.sentence: The map was so bad that we got completely ____.

en_def: wanting to know or learn about something
hi_nuance: 'curious ABOUT' something; 'curious to know'. Also means 'strange' ('a curious smell'). Don't confuse with 'careful' or 'cautious'.

examples.en: Children are naturally curious about everything.
examples.hi: बच्चे स्वाभाविक रूप से हर चीज़ के बारे में जिज्ञासु होते हैं।

examples.en: I'm curious to know how the story ends.
examples.hi: मैं जानने को उत्सुक हूँ कि कहानी का अंत कैसे होता है।

examples.en: She was curious about my job.
examples.hi: वह मेरे काम के बारे में जानने को उत्सुक थी।

examples.en: Just curious — where did you buy that bag?
examples.hi: बस जिज्ञासावश — वह बैग आपने कहाँ से खरीदा?

examples.en: There was a curious smell in the kitchen.
examples.hi: रसोई में एक अजीब-सी गंध थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am curious for knowing the result.
common_mistake.right: I am curious to know the result.
common_mistake.why: 'curious' + to-infinitive, or 'curious about' + noun.

cloze.sentence: He was ____ about how the machine worked.

en_def: very pleased
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'happy' and common in formal emails: 'I'd be delighted to attend'. 'delighted with/by/at' something, 'delighted to do'. Not 'very delighted' — it is already strong.

examples.en: We were delighted with the results.
examples.hi: हम परिणामों से बहुत प्रसन्न थे।

examples.en: I'd be delighted to join you for dinner.
examples.hi: मुझे आपके साथ रात के खाने में शामिल होकर बहुत खुशी होगी।

examples.en: She was delighted to hear the news.
examples.hi: खबर सुनकर वह बहुत खुश हुई।

examples.en: The children were delighted by the fireworks.
examples.hi: बच्चे आतिशबाज़ी देखकर बहुत खुश हुए।

examples.en: He was delighted that his team had won.
examples.hi: वह बहुत खुश था कि उसकी टीम जीत गई।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very delighted to meet you.
common_mistake.right: I am delighted to meet you.
common_mistake.why: 'delighted' is already a strong word; 'very' is unnecessary (use 'absolutely' if you need emphasis).

cloze.sentence: They were ____ with their new flat.

en_def: unhappy because something was not as good as you hoped
hi_nuance: 'disappointed WITH a thing/person', 'disappointed IN a person' (their character), 'disappointed BY a result', 'disappointed THAT'. Spelling: one s, two p's.

examples.en: I was disappointed with the hotel.
examples.hi: मैं होटल से निराश था।

examples.en: She was disappointed that she didn't get the job.
examples.hi: वह निराश थी कि उसे नौकरी नहीं मिली।

examples.en: My parents were disappointed in me.
examples.hi: मेरे माता-पिता मुझसे निराश थे।

examples.en: Don't be disappointed; you can try again next year.
examples.hi: निराश मत हो; तुम अगले साल फिर कोशिश कर सकते हो।

examples.en: The fans were disappointed by the team's performance.
examples.hi: प्रशंसक टीम के प्रदर्शन से निराश थे।

common_mistake.wrong: I was very dissapointed with the service.
common_mistake.right: I was very disappointed with the service.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: one 's' and two 'p's — disappointed.

cloze.sentence: He was ____ when the match was cancelled.

en_def: feeling shy, ashamed, or uncomfortable in front of other people
hi_nuance: 'embarrassed ABOUT/BY' something. Spelling trap: two r's, two s's. 'embarrassing' = the situation; 'embarrassed' = the feeling. Hindi speakers often use 'ashamed' where 'embarrassed' is the natural choice.

examples.en: I was so embarrassed when I forgot her name.
examples.hi: जब मैं उसका नाम भूल गया तो मुझे बहुत शर्मिंदगी हुई।

examples.en: He felt embarrassed about his old car.
examples.hi: उसे अपनी पुरानी कार को लेकर शर्मिंदगी महसूस होती थी।

examples.en: It was an embarrassing moment for everyone.
examples.hi: यह सबके लिए एक शर्मनाक पल था।

examples.en: She was too embarrassed to ask for help.
examples.hi: वह मदद माँगने में बहुत झिझक रही थी।

examples.en: Don't be embarrassed; everyone makes mistakes.
examples.hi: शर्मिंदा मत हो; सब गलतियाँ करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I felt very embarassed in front of my friends.
common_mistake.right: I felt very embarrassed in front of my friends.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: two 'r's and two 's's.

cloze.sentence: She was ____ when her phone rang during the meeting.

en_def: very happy and enthusiastic about something that is going to happen
hi_nuance: 'excited ABOUT' something (not 'for', though 'excited for' is spreading in US English). 'exciting' = the event. Indian English says 'I am so excited for the trip' — safer to say 'about'.

examples.en: The kids are excited about the school trip.
examples.hi: बच्चे स्कूल की यात्रा को लेकर उत्साहित हैं।

examples.en: I'm really excited to start my new job.
examples.hi: मैं अपनी नई नौकरी शुरू करने को लेकर बहुत उत्साहित हूँ।

examples.en: She was too excited to sleep.
examples.hi: वह इतनी उत्साहित थी कि सो नहीं पाई।

examples.en: Everyone got excited when the band came on stage.
examples.hi: जब बैंड मंच पर आया तो सब उत्साहित हो गए।

examples.en: It was the most exciting match I've ever seen.
examples.hi: यह मेरा देखा हुआ सबसे रोमांचक मैच था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very exciting about the concert.
common_mistake.right: I am very excited about the concert.
common_mistake.why: 'excited' is your feeling; 'exciting' describes the thing.

cloze.sentence: We're so ____ about the wedding next month.

en_def: feeling fear
hi_nuance: Unlike 'afraid', 'frightened' can go before a noun ('a frightened child'). 'frightened OF' something, 'frightened BY' an event. 'frightening' = the thing that causes fear.

examples.en: The loud noise frightened the baby.
examples.hi: तेज़ आवाज़ से बच्चा डर गया।

examples.en: I was frightened by the thunder.
examples.hi: मैं गरज से डर गया था।

examples.en: She's frightened of spiders.
examples.hi: वह मकड़ियों से डरती है।

examples.en: The frightened dog hid under the bed.
examples.hi: डरा हुआ कुत्ता बिस्तर के नीचे छिप गया।

examples.en: It was a frightening experience.
examples.hi: यह एक डरावना अनुभव था।

common_mistake.wrong: I was frightening when I saw the snake.
common_mistake.right: I was frightened when I saw the snake.
common_mistake.why: 'frightened' is your feeling; 'frightening' describes the snake.

cloze.sentence: The children were ____ by the dark.

en_def: pleased and happy about something
hi_nuance: Only after a verb, never before a noun ('a glad person' is wrong). 'glad to do', 'glad that', 'glad about'. Very common in 'I'm glad to hear that' and 'Glad to help'.

examples.en: I'm glad you could come.
examples.hi: मुझे खुशी है कि आप आ सके।

examples.en: She was glad to be home again.
examples.hi: वह फिर से घर आकर खुश थी।

examples.en: I'm glad to hear you're feeling better.
examples.hi: यह सुनकर खुशी हुई कि आप बेहतर महसूस कर रहे हैं।

examples.en: We're glad that the project is finished.
examples.hi: हमें खुशी है कि परियोजना पूरी हो गई।

examples.en: Glad to help! Let me know if you need anything else.
examples.hi: मदद करके खुशी हुई! कुछ और चाहिए तो बताइए।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a glad man today.
common_mistake.right: He is a happy man today. / He is glad today.
common_mistake.why: 'glad' cannot be used before a noun.

cloze.sentence: I'm ____ we chose this restaurant.

en_def: unhappy because someone has something you want, or afraid of losing someone's love
hi_nuance: 'jealous OF' someone. In casual speech 'jealous' and 'envious' overlap, but 'jealous' also covers romantic insecurity. Indian English sometimes says 'I am feeling jealousy' — say 'I feel jealous'.

examples.en: He's jealous of his brother's success.
examples.hi: उसे अपने भाई की सफलता से जलन होती है।

examples.en: She gets jealous when I talk to other girls.
examples.hi: जब मैं दूसरी लड़कियों से बात करता हूँ तो उसे जलन होती है।

examples.en: I'm so jealous — you're going to Paris!
examples.hi: मुझे बहुत जलन हो रही है — तुम पेरिस जा रहे हो!

examples.en: Don't be jealous of other people's lives.
examples.hi: दूसरों की ज़िंदगी से जलन मत करो।

examples.en: A jealous colleague spread rumours about her.
examples.hi: एक ईर्ष्यालु सहकर्मी ने उसके बारे में अफ़वाहें फैलाईं।

common_mistake.wrong: She is jealous from her sister.
common_mistake.right: She is jealous of her sister.
common_mistake.why: 'jealous' is followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: He felt ____ when his friend got the promotion.

en_def: unhappy because you are alone or have no friends
hi_nuance: 'lonely' is the sad feeling; 'alone' is just the fact of being by yourself (can be positive). Indian English mixes them: 'I feel alone' should usually be 'I feel lonely'.

examples.en: She felt lonely after moving to a new city.
examples.hi: नए शहर में आने के बाद वह अकेलापन महसूस करने लगी।

examples.en: Many old people are lonely.
examples.hi: बहुत से बुज़ुर्ग अकेलेपन से जूझते हैं।

examples.en: It's a lonely job, working night shifts.
examples.hi: रात की शिफ़्ट में काम करना एक एकाकी काम है।

examples.en: I was lonely, so I called an old friend.
examples.hi: मुझे अकेलापन लग रहा था, इसलिए मैंने एक पुराने दोस्त को फ़ोन किया।

examples.en: He lives alone but he isn't lonely.
examples.hi: वह अकेला रहता है लेकिन उसे अकेलापन नहीं लगता।

common_mistake.wrong: I feel very alone since my friends left.
common_mistake.right: I feel very lonely since my friends left.
common_mistake.why: 'alone' is a fact (nobody with you); 'lonely' is the sad feeling.

cloze.sentence: Working from home can be ____ sometimes.

en_def: worried and slightly afraid about something that is going to happen
hi_nuance: 'nervous ABOUT' something. Indian English uses 'tension' as the feeling ('I have tension'); say 'I feel nervous'. 'nervous' is temporary; 'anxious' can be a long-term condition.

examples.en: I always get nervous before an exam.
examples.hi: परीक्षा से पहले मैं हमेशा घबरा जाता हूँ।

examples.en: She was nervous about meeting his parents.
examples.hi: वह उसके माता-पिता से मिलने को लेकर घबराई हुई थी।

examples.en: He gave a nervous laugh.
examples.hi: उसने घबराहट भरी हँसी हँसी।

examples.en: Don't be nervous; you've prepared well.
examples.hi: घबराओ मत; तुमने अच्छी तैयारी की है।

examples.en: My hands shake when I'm nervous.
examples.hi: जब मैं घबराता हूँ तो मेरे हाथ काँपते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I have a lot of tension about the exam.
common_mistake.right: I feel very nervous about the exam.
common_mistake.why: 'tension' is Indian English for the feeling; native speakers say 'nervous' or 'stressed'.

cloze.sentence: She felt ____ before her first day at work.

en_def: happy or satisfied
hi_nuance: 'pleased WITH' something, 'pleased TO do', 'pleased THAT'. 'Pleased to meet you' is the standard greeting. Only used after a verb.

examples.en: Pleased to meet you, Mr Sharma.
examples.hi: आपसे मिलकर खुशी हुई, श्री शर्मा।

examples.en: I'm very pleased with my new phone.
examples.hi: मैं अपने नए फ़ोन से बहुत खुश हूँ।

examples.en: She was pleased that everyone liked the food.
examples.hi: वह खुश थी कि सबको खाना पसंद आया।

examples.en: The boss was pleased with our work.
examples.hi: बॉस हमारे काम से खुश थे।

examples.en: We are pleased to inform you that you have been selected.
examples.hi: हमें आपको सूचित करते हुए खुशी हो रही है कि आपका चयन हो गया है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am pleased from the result.
common_mistake.right: I am pleased with the result.
common_mistake.why: 'pleased' is followed by 'with', not 'from'.

cloze.sentence: The teacher was ____ with the class's progress.

en_def: feeling pleased about something you or someone close to you has done
hi_nuance: 'proud OF' someone/something; 'proud TO do'. Indian English says 'I feel proud on you' or 'proud for you' — both wrong. 'proud' can also mean arrogant ('too proud to ask').

examples.en: I'm so proud of you.
examples.hi: मुझे तुम पर बहुत गर्व है।

examples.en: She is proud of her Indian heritage.
examples.hi: उसे अपनी भारतीय विरासत पर गर्व है।

examples.en: He was proud to represent his country.
examples.hi: उसे अपने देश का प्रतिनिधित्व करने पर गर्व था।

examples.en: They are proud parents of three doctors.
examples.hi: वे तीन डॉक्टरों के गर्वित माता-पिता हैं।

examples.en: He was too proud to admit he was wrong.
examples.hi: वह इतना घमंडी था कि यह नहीं मान सका कि वह गलत था।

common_mistake.wrong: I am very proud on my son.
common_mistake.right: I am very proud of my son.
common_mistake.why: 'proud' is followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: Her parents were ____ of her achievement.

en_def: pleased because you have what you wanted or need
hi_nuance: 'satisfied WITH' something. Indian English uses 'satisfied by' or 'satisfied from'. 'satisfactory' means acceptable, not excellent. 'satisfying' = the thing that gives satisfaction.

examples.en: Are you satisfied with the service?
examples.hi: क्या आप सेवा से संतुष्ट हैं?

examples.en: I'm not satisfied with this answer.
examples.hi: मैं इस जवाब से संतुष्ट नहीं हूँ।

examples.en: A satisfied customer will come back.
examples.hi: एक संतुष्ट ग्राहक वापस आएगा।

examples.en: She felt satisfied after finishing the project.
examples.hi: परियोजना पूरी करने के बाद उसे संतुष्टि महसूस हुई।

examples.en: He is never satisfied, no matter what you do.
examples.hi: आप चाहे कुछ भी करें, वह कभी संतुष्ट नहीं होता।

common_mistake.wrong: I am satisfied from my job.
common_mistake.right: I am satisfied with my job.
common_mistake.why: 'satisfied' is followed by 'with'.

cloze.sentence: The client was ____ with the final design.

en_def: frightened
hi_nuance: More informal than 'afraid' or 'frightened'. 'scared OF' something, 'scared TO do', 'scared stiff'. Verb: 'scare' (to frighten someone). 'scary' = frightening.

examples.en: I'm scared of the dark.
examples.hi: मुझे अँधेरे से डर लगता है।

examples.en: Don't be scared; the dog won't bite.
examples.hi: डरो मत; कुत्ता नहीं काटेगा।

examples.en: She was too scared to go in.
examples.hi: वह अंदर जाने में बहुत डर रही थी।

examples.en: You scared me! I didn't hear you come in.
examples.hi: तुमने मुझे डरा दिया! मैंने तुम्हें अंदर आते नहीं सुना।

examples.en: It was a really scary film.
examples.hi: यह सचमुच एक डरावनी फ़िल्म थी।

common_mistake.wrong: I am scared from heights.
common_mistake.right: I am scared of heights.
common_mistake.why: 'scared' is followed by 'of'.

cloze.sentence: The little boy was ____ of the loud fireworks.

en_def: feeling or showing surprise
hi_nuance: 'surprised AT/BY' something, 'surprised TO see', 'surprised THAT'. Indian English uses 'shocked' for mild surprise — 'shocked' is much stronger and negative. Pronounce the 'r' softly: /səˈpraɪzd/.

examples.en: I was surprised to see him at the party.
examples.hi: उसे पार्टी में देखकर मैं हैरान रह गया।

examples.en: She was surprised by how big the city was.
examples.hi: शहर कितना बड़ा है, यह देखकर वह हैरान थी।

examples.en: Don't be surprised if he says no.
examples.hi: अगर वह मना कर दे तो हैरान मत होना।

examples.en: We were pleasantly surprised by the food.
examples.hi: खाने से हमें सुखद आश्चर्य हुआ।

examples.en: He looked surprised when I told him.
examples.hi: जब मैंने उसे बताया तो वह हैरान लग रहा था।

common_mistake.wrong: I was shocked to see the small discount.
common_mistake.right: I was surprised to see the small discount.
common_mistake.why: 'shocked' is for very bad or upsetting news; ordinary surprise is 'surprised'.

cloze.sentence: I was ____ to get a reply so quickly.

en_def: unhappy or worried because something bad has happened
hi_nuance: 'upset ABOUT' something, 'upset WITH' a person. As a verb it means to make someone unhappy: 'upset – upset – upset'. 'an upset stomach' = stomach problem. Indian English says 'I got upset on him' — use 'with'.

examples.en: She was upset about losing her job.
examples.hi: वह अपनी नौकरी खोने से दुखी थी।

examples.en: Why are you so upset with me?
examples.hi: तुम मुझसे इतने नाराज़ क्यों हो?

examples.en: I didn't mean to upset you.
examples.hi: मेरा तुम्हें दुखी करने का इरादा नहीं था।

examples.en: He gets upset when people are late.
examples.hi: जब लोग देर से आते हैं तो वह परेशान हो जाता है।

examples.en: I have an upset stomach from the street food.
examples.hi: सड़क के खाने से मेरा पेट खराब है।

common_mistake.wrong: She was upset on her friend.
common_mistake.right: She was upset with her friend.
common_mistake.why: Use 'with' for the person you are upset about.

cloze.sentence: The children were ____ when the dog died.

en_def: showing no fear in a dangerous or difficult situation
hi_nuance: 'brave' is an ordinary adjective; 'bold' suggests confidence or risk-taking; 'courageous' is more formal. Indian English overuses 'daring'. Noun: 'bravery' or 'courage'.

examples.en: It was brave of you to speak up.
examples.hi: तुम्हारा बोलना बहादुरी का काम था।

examples.en: The brave firefighter saved the child.
examples.hi: बहादुर दमकलकर्मी ने बच्चे को बचाया।

examples.en: Be brave; the injection only takes a second.
examples.hi: हिम्मत रखो; इंजेक्शन में बस एक सेकंड लगता है।

examples.en: She made a brave decision to start her own business.
examples.hi: उसने अपना खुद का व्यवसाय शुरू करने का साहसी निर्णय लिया।

examples.en: He put on a brave face despite the bad news.
examples.hi: बुरी खबर के बावजूद उसने हिम्मत का चेहरा बनाए रखा।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very braveful person.
common_mistake.right: He is a very brave person.
common_mistake.why: 'braveful' does not exist; the adjective is simply 'brave'.

cloze.sentence: You have to be ____ to work as a firefighter.

en_def: giving attention to what you are doing so that you avoid mistakes or danger
hi_nuance: 'careful WITH' things, 'careful ABOUT' actions, 'careful TO do'. Indian English says 'be careful of' — that's for dangers only ('careful of the dog'). 'Take care' is a goodbye phrase.

examples.en: Be careful with that glass; it's expensive.
examples.hi: उस गिलास के साथ सावधान रहो; यह महँगा है।

examples.en: She's a very careful driver.
examples.hi: वह बहुत सावधान ड्राइवर है।

examples.en: Be careful not to spill the coffee.
examples.hi: ध्यान रखो कि कॉफ़ी गिर न जाए।

examples.en: Careful! The floor is wet.
examples.hi: सावधान! फ़र्श गीला है।

examples.en: You should be careful about what you post online.
examples.hi: आपको इस बारे में सावधान रहना चाहिए कि आप ऑनलाइन क्या पोस्ट करते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Be careful of your health.
common_mistake.right: Take care of your health. / Be careful about your health.
common_mistake.why: 'careful of' is used for dangers; for looking after something use 'take care of'.

cloze.sentence: Please be ____ when you cross the road.

en_def: not giving enough attention, so that you make mistakes
hi_nuance: 'a careless mistake' is a common collocation for silly errors. Do not confuse with 'carefree' (happy, without worries). 'careless WITH' things, 'careless ABOUT' actions.

examples.en: He lost marks for careless mistakes.
examples.hi: लापरवाही की गलतियों के कारण उसके अंक कटे।

examples.en: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
examples.hi: दरवाज़ा खुला छोड़ना तुम्हारी लापरवाही थी।

examples.en: She's careless with money.
examples.hi: वह पैसों के मामले में लापरवाह है।

examples.en: Careless driving causes many accidents.
examples.hi: लापरवाह ड्राइविंग से कई दुर्घटनाएँ होती हैं।

examples.en: Don't be so careless with your passwords.
examples.hi: अपने पासवर्ड को लेकर इतने लापरवाह मत बनो।

common_mistake.wrong: He lives a careless life without any worries.
common_mistake.right: He lives a carefree life without any worries.
common_mistake.why: 'careless' means not paying attention; 'carefree' means free of worries.

cloze.sentence: A ____ error in the code crashed the whole website.

en_def: happy and showing it by the way you behave
hi_nuance: Describes a person's usual mood or a bright place ('a cheerful room'). Indian English often uses 'jolly' — 'cheerful' is more common. 'Cheers!' is an informal thanks/goodbye/toast.

examples.en: She's always cheerful, even on Monday mornings.
examples.hi: वह हमेशा हँसमुख रहती है, सोमवार की सुबह भी।

examples.en: He greeted us with a cheerful smile.
examples.hi: उसने हमारा स्वागत एक प्रसन्न मुस्कान से किया।

examples.en: The room was painted in cheerful colours.
examples.hi: कमरे को खुशनुमा रंगों से रंगा गया था।

examples.en: Try to stay cheerful during difficult times.
examples.hi: कठिन समय में भी प्रसन्न रहने की कोशिश करो।

examples.en: The cheerful music lifted everyone's mood.
examples.hi: खुशनुमा संगीत ने सबका मूड अच्छा कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: He is very jolly-natured.
common_mistake.right: He is very cheerful.
common_mistake.why: 'jolly-natured' is Indian English; 'cheerful' is the natural word.

cloze.sentence: The nurse had a ____ manner that calmed the patients.

en_def: able to learn and understand things quickly
hi_nuance: British English uses 'clever' where Americans say 'smart'. 'clever' can be slightly negative (crafty). Indian English often says 'brilliant' for any good student — 'clever' or 'bright' is more measured.

examples.en: She's a very clever girl; she learns fast.
examples.hi: वह बहुत होशियार लड़की है; वह जल्दी सीखती है।

examples.en: That was a clever idea.
examples.hi: वह एक चतुर विचार था।

examples.en: He's clever at fixing things.
examples.hi: वह चीज़ें ठीक करने में माहिर है।

examples.en: It was clever of you to bring an umbrella.
examples.hi: छाता लाना तुम्हारी समझदारी थी।

examples.en: Don't try to be too clever with the boss.
examples.hi: बॉस के साथ ज़्यादा चालाकी करने की कोशिश मत करो।

common_mistake.wrong: He is clever in maths.
common_mistake.right: He is clever at maths. / He is good at maths.
common_mistake.why: 'clever' is followed by 'at' for skills.

cloze.sentence: The ____ dog opened the gate by itself.

en_def: sure about your own abilities or that something will happen
hi_nuance: 'confident ABOUT' something, 'confident THAT', 'confident OF' success. 'confidence' is the noun. Indian English says 'I am confident on this' — wrong. 'over-confident' is negative.

examples.en: She's confident about passing the exam.
examples.hi: उसे परीक्षा पास करने का पूरा भरोसा है।

examples.en: Speak slowly and you'll sound more confident.
examples.hi: धीरे बोलो और तुम ज़्यादा आत्मविश्वासी लगोगे।

examples.en: I'm confident that we'll finish on time.
examples.hi: मुझे विश्वास है कि हम समय पर पूरा कर लेंगे।

examples.en: He gave a confident answer.
examples.hi: उसने आत्मविश्वास से भरा जवाब दिया।

examples.en: Practice will make you more confident in English.
examples.hi: अभ्यास से आप अंग्रेज़ी में ज़्यादा आत्मविश्वासी बनेंगे।

common_mistake.wrong: I am confident on my English now.
common_mistake.right: I am confident in my English now.
common_mistake.why: Use 'confident in' for abilities and 'confident about' for outcomes; 'on' is wrong.

cloze.sentence: After a month of practice, she felt ____ speaking English.

en_def: kind and pleasant, behaving like a friend
hi_nuance: 'friendly' is an adjective, not an adverb (there is no 'friendlily'). Say 'in a friendly way'. 'friendly WITH' someone. Also used in compounds: 'user-friendly', 'eco-friendly'.

examples.en: The staff at the hotel were very friendly.
examples.hi: होटल के कर्मचारी बहुत मिलनसार थे।

examples.en: She gave me a friendly smile.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे एक दोस्ताना मुस्कान दी।

examples.en: He's friendly with everyone in the office.
examples.hi: वह ऑफ़िस में सबके साथ दोस्ताना है।

examples.en: This app is very user-friendly.
examples.hi: यह ऐप बहुत उपयोगकर्ता-अनुकूल है।

examples.en: Mumbai people are surprisingly friendly.
examples.hi: मुंबई के लोग आश्चर्यजनक रूप से मिलनसार हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: He talked to me very friendly.
common_mistake.right: He talked to me in a very friendly way.
common_mistake.why: 'friendly' is an adjective; it cannot be used as an adverb.

cloze.sentence: Our new neighbours seem very ____.

en_def: willing to give money, help, or time freely
hi_nuance: 'generous WITH' money/time, 'generous TO' people. Also 'a generous portion' (large). Indian English uses 'large-hearted' — 'generous' is the standard word.

examples.en: It was very generous of you to pay for dinner.
examples.hi: रात के खाने का बिल भरना आपकी बड़ी उदारता थी।

examples.en: She's generous with her time.
examples.hi: वह अपने समय के मामले में उदार है।

examples.en: The restaurant serves generous portions.
examples.hi: रेस्तराँ बड़ी मात्रा में खाना परोसता है।

examples.en: He made a generous donation to the school.
examples.hi: उसने स्कूल को उदारतापूर्वक दान दिया।

examples.en: My grandfather was generous to everyone.
examples.hi: मेरे दादाजी सबके प्रति उदार थे।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a large-hearted man.
common_mistake.right: He is a generous man.
common_mistake.why: 'large-hearted' is a direct translation; the natural English word is 'generous' (or 'big-hearted' informally).

cloze.sentence: Thank you for your ____ gift.

en_def: truthful and not likely to cheat or steal
hi_nuance: The 'h' is silent, so it takes 'an': 'an honest man'. 'honest WITH' someone, 'honest ABOUT' something. 'To be honest, ...' is a common phrase to introduce a frank opinion.

examples.en: He's an honest man; you can trust him.
examples.hi: वह एक ईमानदार आदमी है; आप उस पर भरोसा कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: To be honest, I didn't like the film.
examples.hi: सच कहूँ तो, मुझे फ़िल्म पसंद नहीं आई।

examples.en: Please be honest with me.
examples.hi: कृपया मेरे साथ ईमानदार रहो।

examples.en: She gave an honest answer about her mistakes.
examples.hi: उसने अपनी गलतियों के बारे में ईमानदार जवाब दिया।

examples.en: Honest feedback helps you improve.
examples.hi: ईमानदार प्रतिक्रिया आपको सुधरने में मदद करती है।

common_mistake.wrong: She is a honest person.
common_mistake.right: She is an honest person.
common_mistake.why: The 'h' in 'honest' is silent, so it takes 'an'.

cloze.sentence: I appreciate your ____ opinion about my work.

en_def: not willing to work or use effort
hi_nuance: 'lazy' describes a person or animal; a slow day can be 'a lazy afternoon' (relaxed, positive). Comparative 'lazier', superlative 'laziest'. Not 'more lazy'.

examples.en: He's too lazy to cook, so he orders food every night.
examples.hi: वह खाना बनाने में बहुत आलसी है, इसलिए वह हर रात खाना ऑर्डर करता है।

examples.en: Don't be lazy; go and do your homework.
examples.hi: आलसी मत बनो; जाकर अपना गृहकार्य करो।

examples.en: We spent a lazy Sunday at home.
examples.hi: हमने घर पर एक आरामदायक रविवार बिताया।

examples.en: I feel lazy in the afternoon heat.
examples.hi: दोपहर की गर्मी में मुझे आलस आता है।

examples.en: My cat is the laziest animal I know.
examples.hi: मेरी बिल्ली मेरी जानकारी में सबसे आलसी जानवर है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is more lazy than his brother.
common_mistake.right: He is lazier than his brother.
common_mistake.why: Two-syllable adjectives ending in -y take -ier, not 'more'.

cloze.sentence: I was too ____ to walk, so I took a taxi.

en_def: able to wait calmly without getting annoyed
hi_nuance: Same word as the noun 'patient' (sick person). 'patient WITH' someone. Noun: 'patience' (not 'patient'). Indian English says 'keep patience' — say 'be patient' or 'have patience'.

examples.en: Be patient; the bus will come soon.
examples.hi: धैर्य रखो; बस जल्दी आएगी।

examples.en: She's very patient with young children.
examples.hi: वह छोटे बच्चों के साथ बहुत धैर्यवान है।

examples.en: Thank you for being so patient.
examples.hi: इतना धैर्य रखने के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: You need to be patient when learning a language.
examples.hi: भाषा सीखते समय धैर्य रखना ज़रूरी है।

examples.en: The doctor saw twenty patients this morning.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने आज सुबह बीस मरीज़ देखे।

common_mistake.wrong: Please keep patience for two minutes.
common_mistake.right: Please be patient for two minutes.
common_mistake.why: 'keep patience' is a direct translation; English uses 'be patient' or 'have patience'.

cloze.sentence: A good teacher must be ____ with slow learners.

en_def: behaving in a way that shows respect for other people
hi_nuance: 'polite TO' someone. Note that 'kindly' in Indian English ('kindly do the needful') sounds bossy to native ears; real politeness uses 'please' and 'could you'. Opposite: 'rude' or 'impolite'.

examples.en: It's polite to say thank you.
examples.hi: धन्यवाद कहना शिष्टाचार है।

examples.en: She was very polite to the guests.
examples.hi: वह मेहमानों के साथ बहुत विनम्र थी।

examples.en: He gave a polite but firm refusal.
examples.hi: उसने विनम्र लेकिन दृढ़ इनकार किया।

examples.en: Try to be polite even when you're angry.
examples.hi: गुस्से में भी विनम्र रहने की कोशिश करो।

examples.en: It's not polite to interrupt.
examples.hi: बीच में टोकना शिष्ट नहीं है।

common_mistake.wrong: Kindly send me the file at the earliest.
common_mistake.right: Could you please send me the file as soon as possible?
common_mistake.why: 'Kindly... at the earliest' is Indian English and sounds like an order; 'Could you please' is the polite form.

cloze.sentence: Always be ____ to customers, even difficult ones.

en_def: not polite; showing no respect
hi_nuance: 'rude TO' someone, 'rude ABOUT' something. Indian English uses 'ill-mannered' or 'ill-behaved' formally; 'rude' is the everyday word. 'rude' also means slightly vulgar ('a rude joke').

examples.en: It's rude to talk with your mouth full.
examples.hi: मुँह भरकर बात करना अशिष्टता है।

examples.en: The waiter was very rude to us.
examples.hi: वेटर हमारे साथ बहुत बदतमीज़ी से पेश आया।

examples.en: I don't want to be rude, but I have to leave.
examples.hi: मैं अशिष्ट नहीं होना चाहता, लेकिन मुझे जाना होगा।

examples.en: He made a rude comment about her clothes.
examples.hi: उसने उसके कपड़ों पर एक अभद्र टिप्पणी की।

examples.en: Don't be rude to your elders.
examples.hi: अपने बड़ों से बदतमीज़ी मत करो।

common_mistake.wrong: The shopkeeper behaved rude with me.
common_mistake.right: The shopkeeper was rude to me.
common_mistake.why: 'rude' is an adjective, so use 'was rude to', not 'behaved rude with'.

cloze.sentence: It's ____ to ignore someone who is talking to you.

en_def: caring only about yourself and not about other people
hi_nuance: 'selfish' is always negative. 'self-centred' is similar. Don't confuse with 'self-confident' (positive) or 'independent'. Noun: 'selfishness'.

examples.en: It's selfish to take the last piece without asking.
examples.hi: बिना पूछे आखिरी टुकड़ा लेना स्वार्थ है।

examples.en: He's too selfish to share anything.
examples.hi: वह इतना स्वार्थी है कि कुछ भी नहीं बाँटता।

examples.en: Don't be selfish; let your sister play too.
examples.hi: स्वार्थी मत बनो; अपनी बहन को भी खेलने दो।

examples.en: That was a selfish decision that hurt the whole team.
examples.hi: वह एक स्वार्थी निर्णय था जिसने पूरी टीम को नुकसान पहुँचाया।

examples.en: I felt selfish for leaving her alone.
examples.hi: उसे अकेला छोड़ने पर मुझे खुद पर स्वार्थी होने का एहसास हुआ।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very selfish and self-made person.
common_mistake.right: He is a very selfish person.
common_mistake.why: 'self-made' means successful through your own effort — it is positive and unrelated to 'selfish'.

cloze.sentence: It was ____ of him to keep all the money.

en_def: showing good judgement; practical
hi_nuance: False friend alert: 'sensible' means practical and wise, NOT 'sensitive' (easily hurt, or reacting to small changes). Hindi speakers mix these up constantly.

examples.en: It was sensible to book the tickets early.
examples.hi: टिकट जल्दी बुक करना समझदारी थी।

examples.en: Wear sensible shoes for the trek.
examples.hi: ट्रेक के लिए व्यावहारिक जूते पहनो।

examples.en: She's a sensible girl; she won't waste the money.
examples.hi: वह समझदार लड़की है; वह पैसे बर्बाद नहीं करेगी।

examples.en: Be sensible and take an umbrella.
examples.hi: समझदारी दिखाओ और छाता ले लो।

examples.en: That seems like a sensible plan.
examples.hi: यह एक समझदारी भरी योजना लगती है।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very sensible boy; he cries easily.
common_mistake.right: He is a very sensitive boy; he cries easily.
common_mistake.why: 'sensible' means wise and practical; 'sensitive' means easily affected emotionally.

cloze.sentence: It would be ____ to save some money each month.

en_def: important, dangerous, or needing careful thought; not joking
hi_nuance: 'serious ABOUT' something. 'Are you serious?' = 'Are you joking?'. Indian English uses 'serious' for 'strict' ('a serious teacher') — say 'strict'. Also 'a serious illness/accident' = severe.

examples.en: This is a serious problem; we need to act now.
examples.hi: यह एक गंभीर समस्या है; हमें अभी कार्रवाई करनी होगी।

examples.en: Are you serious about moving to Canada?
examples.hi: क्या तुम कनाडा जाने को लेकर गंभीर हो?

examples.en: He had a serious accident last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल उसका एक गंभीर हादसा हुआ था।

examples.en: Don't look so serious; I was only joking.
examples.hi: इतने गंभीर मत दिखो; मैं तो मज़ाक कर रहा था।

examples.en: She's a serious student who studies every day.
examples.hi: वह एक गंभीर छात्रा है जो हर दिन पढ़ती है।

common_mistake.wrong: Our maths teacher is very serious; she punishes late students.
common_mistake.right: Our maths teacher is very strict; she punishes late students.
common_mistake.why: For someone who enforces rules, use 'strict'; 'serious' means not joking or important.

cloze.sentence: Climate change is a ____ threat to the planet.

en_def: nervous and uncomfortable about meeting or talking to people
hi_nuance: 'shy' is a personality trait; 'embarrassed' is a temporary feeling; 'ashamed' involves guilt. Hindi 'शर्म' maps to all three. Comparative: 'shyer' or 'shier'. 'shy away from' = avoid.

examples.en: She was too shy to speak in class.
examples.hi: वह कक्षा में बोलने में बहुत शर्माती थी।

examples.en: He's shy with strangers but fun with friends.
examples.hi: वह अजनबियों के साथ संकोची है लेकिन दोस्तों के साथ मज़ेदार।

examples.en: Don't be shy; help yourself to some food.
examples.hi: शर्माओ मत; खाना ले लो।

examples.en: I was a very shy child.
examples.hi: मैं बचपन में बहुत शर्मीला था।

examples.en: Some people shy away from public speaking.
examples.hi: कुछ लोग सार्वजनिक रूप से बोलने से कतराते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: I felt very shy when my phone rang in the meeting.
common_mistake.right: I felt very embarrassed when my phone rang in the meeting.
common_mistake.why: 'shy' is a personality trait; a moment of awkwardness is 'embarrassed'.

cloze.sentence: The ____ boy hid behind his mother.

en_def: demanding that rules are obeyed
hi_nuance: 'strict WITH' people, 'strict ABOUT' rules. Indian English often says 'strict teacher' correctly but uses 'strictly' oddly ('strictly follow'). 'a strict diet' = one you must follow exactly.

examples.en: My parents were very strict about bedtime.
examples.hi: मेरे माता-पिता सोने के समय को लेकर बहुत सख़्त थे।

examples.en: The school has strict rules on uniforms.
examples.hi: स्कूल में वर्दी को लेकर सख़्त नियम हैं।

examples.en: She's strict with her students but they respect her.
examples.hi: वह अपने छात्रों के साथ सख़्त है लेकिन वे उसका सम्मान करते हैं।

examples.en: He's on a strict diet for his health.
examples.hi: वह अपनी सेहत के लिए सख़्त आहार पर है।

examples.en: There's a strict deadline for the report.
examples.hi: रिपोर्ट के लिए सख़्त समय-सीमा है।

common_mistake.wrong: Our boss is very strict on us.
common_mistake.right: Our boss is very strict with us.
common_mistake.why: 'strict' is followed by 'with' for people.

cloze.sentence: The airline has ____ rules about hand luggage.

en_def: talking a lot
hi_nuance: Neutral to slightly negative. 'chatty' is the friendly informal version. Indian English says 'she is very talkative person' — remember the article: 'a very talkative person'.

examples.en: My aunt is very talkative; she never stops.
examples.hi: मेरी मौसी बहुत बातूनी हैं; वे कभी नहीं रुकतीं।

examples.en: He's not very talkative in the mornings.
examples.hi: वह सुबह के समय ज़्यादा बात नहीं करता।

examples.en: The talkative passenger kept me awake the whole flight.
examples.hi: बातूनी यात्री ने मुझे पूरी उड़ान के दौरान जगाए रखा।

examples.en: She became more talkative after a cup of coffee.
examples.hi: एक कप कॉफ़ी के बाद वह ज़्यादा बातूनी हो गई।

examples.en: Talkative students can disturb the class.
examples.hi: बातूनी छात्र कक्षा में बाधा डाल सकते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: She is very talkative person.
common_mistake.right: She is a very talkative person.
common_mistake.why: A singular countable noun ('person') needs an article.

cloze.sentence: The ____ driver told us his whole life story.

en_def: making you feel relaxed and free from pain; or feeling relaxed
hi_nuance: Pronounced with three syllables: 'KUMF-tuh-bul', not 'com-for-TA-ble'. 'comfortable WITH' a person/idea. Spelling: comfortable, not 'comfortible'.

examples.en: This chair is really comfortable.
examples.hi: यह कुर्सी सचमुच बहुत आरामदायक है।

examples.en: Make yourself comfortable; I'll bring some tea.
examples.hi: आराम से बैठिए; मैं चाय लाता हूँ।

examples.en: I don't feel comfortable talking about it.
examples.hi: मुझे इस बारे में बात करने में सहज नहीं लगता।

examples.en: Are you comfortable with the new plan?
examples.hi: क्या आप नई योजना से सहज हैं?

examples.en: We stayed in a small but comfortable hotel.
examples.hi: हम एक छोटे लेकिन आरामदायक होटल में रुके।

common_mistake.wrong: I am not comfortable to speak in English.
common_mistake.right: I am not comfortable speaking in English.
common_mistake.why: 'comfortable' is followed by the -ing form or 'with + noun'.

cloze.sentence: These shoes are very ____ for walking.

en_def: easy to use or suitable for your needs; not causing problems
hi_nuance: 'convenient FOR' someone/something. 'Is Monday convenient for you?' is a polite way to arrange meetings. Don't say 'I am convenient' — say 'It is convenient for me'.

examples.en: The flat is very convenient for the metro station.
examples.hi: फ़्लैट मेट्रो स्टेशन के लिए बहुत सुविधाजनक है।

examples.en: Is three o'clock convenient for you?
examples.hi: क्या तीन बजे आपके लिए सुविधाजनक है?

examples.en: Online shopping is more convenient than going to the mall.
examples.hi: मॉल जाने से ऑनलाइन खरीदारी ज़्यादा सुविधाजनक है।

examples.en: Let's meet at a convenient time for both of us.
examples.hi: चलिए हम दोनों के लिए सुविधाजनक समय पर मिलते हैं।

examples.en: It's convenient to have a shop next door.
examples.hi: बगल में दुकान होना सुविधाजनक है।

common_mistake.wrong: I am convenient on Friday.
common_mistake.right: Friday is convenient for me.
common_mistake.why: People are not 'convenient'; times and places are convenient FOR people.

cloze.sentence: Please choose a ____ time for the call.

en_def: full of people
hi_nuance: 'crowded WITH' people. Indian English often says 'there was so much rush' or 'a lot of crowd'; natural is 'it was very crowded' or 'there was a big crowd'. 'crowd' is a countable noun.

examples.en: The train was so crowded that I couldn't sit.
examples.hi: ट्रेन इतनी भीड़भाड़ वाली थी कि मैं बैठ नहीं सका।

examples.en: The market gets crowded on weekends.
examples.hi: सप्ताहांत पर बाज़ार में भीड़ हो जाती है।

examples.en: The beach was crowded with tourists.
examples.hi: समुद्र तट पर्यटकों से भरा हुआ था।

examples.en: Let's go early before it gets too crowded.
examples.hi: चलो जल्दी चलते हैं, इससे पहले कि बहुत भीड़ हो जाए।

examples.en: Mumbai is one of the most crowded cities in the world.
examples.hi: मुंबई दुनिया के सबसे भीड़भाड़ वाले शहरों में से एक है।

common_mistake.wrong: There was too much rush at the station.
common_mistake.right: The station was very crowded.
common_mistake.why: 'rush' for crowds is Indian English; use 'crowded' or 'a big crowd'.

cloze.sentence: The mall was ____ because of the sale.

en_def: likely to cause harm or injury
hi_nuance: 'dangerous FOR' people, 'dangerous TO do'. Noun: 'danger'. Indian English sometimes says 'risky' and 'dangerous' interchangeably — 'risky' is about chance of loss; 'dangerous' is about harm.

examples.en: It's dangerous to drive without a seatbelt.
examples.hi: बिना सीटबेल्ट के गाड़ी चलाना ख़तरनाक है।

examples.en: This road is dangerous at night.
examples.hi: यह सड़क रात में ख़तरनाक है।

examples.en: Smoking is dangerous for your health.
examples.hi: धूम्रपान आपकी सेहत के लिए ख़तरनाक है।

examples.en: The police caught a dangerous criminal.
examples.hi: पुलिस ने एक ख़तरनाक अपराधी को पकड़ा।

examples.en: Some chemicals are dangerous if mixed.
examples.hi: कुछ रसायन मिलाने पर ख़तरनाक हो जाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Swimming here is very danger.
common_mistake.right: Swimming here is very dangerous.
common_mistake.why: 'danger' is a noun; the adjective is 'dangerous'.

cloze.sentence: It's ____ to use your phone while driving.

en_def: having a very pleasant taste or smell
hi_nuance: 'delicious' is already strong, so 'very delicious' sounds odd; say 'absolutely delicious'. Indian English says 'tasty' a lot — fine, but 'delicious' is warmer. Not used for people.

examples.en: The biryani was absolutely delicious.
examples.hi: बिरयानी बिल्कुल स्वादिष्ट थी।

examples.en: Thank you for the delicious meal.
examples.hi: स्वादिष्ट भोजन के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: Something smells delicious in the kitchen.
examples.hi: रसोई में कुछ बहुत स्वादिष्ट महक रहा है।

examples.en: My grandmother makes delicious pickles.
examples.hi: मेरी दादी स्वादिष्ट अचार बनाती हैं।

examples.en: This mango is the most delicious I've ever eaten.
examples.hi: यह आम मेरा खाया हुआ सबसे स्वादिष्ट आम है।

common_mistake.wrong: The cake was very delicious.
common_mistake.right: The cake was delicious. / The cake was absolutely delicious.
common_mistake.why: 'delicious' is a strong adjective; use 'absolutely' rather than 'very'.

cloze.sentence: Everything at the wedding dinner was ____.

en_def: known about by many people
hi_nuance: 'famous FOR' something (the reason), 'famous AS' a role. Indian English says 'famous in' ('famous in cricket') — say 'famous for cricket'. 'well-known' is slightly weaker.

examples.en: Agra is famous for the Taj Mahal.
examples.hi: आगरा ताजमहल के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

examples.en: She became famous after her first film.
examples.hi: वह अपनी पहली फ़िल्म के बाद मशहूर हो गई।

examples.en: He's famous as a singer, but he also acts.
examples.hi: वह गायक के रूप में मशहूर है, लेकिन वह अभिनय भी करता है।

examples.en: This restaurant is famous for its dosas.
examples.hi: यह रेस्तराँ अपने डोसे के लिए मशहूर है।

examples.en: Many famous people live in this area.
examples.hi: इस इलाके में कई मशहूर लोग रहते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Sachin is famous in cricket.
common_mistake.right: Sachin is famous for cricket.
common_mistake.why: 'famous' is followed by 'for' + the reason for fame.

cloze.sentence: Darjeeling is ____ for its tea.

en_def: recently made, picked, or produced; not old or stale
hi_nuance: 'fresh' describes food, air, ideas, and starts ('a fresh start'). Indian English uses 'fresher' for a new employee/graduate — native speakers say 'new graduate' or 'entry-level'. 'freshly' + past participle: 'freshly baked'.

examples.en: I buy fresh vegetables every morning.
examples.hi: मैं हर सुबह ताज़ी सब्ज़ियाँ खरीदता हूँ।

examples.en: Let's open the window for some fresh air.
examples.hi: चलो थोड़ी ताज़ी हवा के लिए खिड़की खोलते हैं।

examples.en: The bread is fresh; it was baked an hour ago.
examples.hi: ब्रेड ताज़ी है; इसे एक घंटे पहले बनाया गया था।

examples.en: She had some fresh ideas for the project.
examples.hi: उसके पास परियोजना के लिए कुछ नए विचार थे।

examples.en: After the holiday I felt fresh and ready to work.
examples.hi: छुट्टी के बाद मैं तरोताज़ा और काम के लिए तैयार महसूस कर रहा था।

common_mistake.wrong: I joined the company as a fresher.
common_mistake.right: I joined the company as a new graduate.
common_mistake.why: 'fresher' is Indian English; internationally say 'new graduate', 'trainee', or 'entry-level'.

cloze.sentence: The fish at this market is always ____.

en_def: extremely large
hi_nuance: 'huge' is a strong adjective, so use 'absolutely huge', not 'very huge'. Pronounce the 'h': /hjuːdʒ/, not 'yooj'. Also used for amounts and success: 'a huge success', 'a huge difference'.

examples.en: They live in a huge house near the lake.
examples.hi: वे झील के पास एक विशाल घर में रहते हैं।

examples.en: The concert was a huge success.
examples.hi: कॉन्सर्ट एक बहुत बड़ी सफलता थी।

examples.en: There's a huge difference between the two phones.
examples.hi: दोनों फ़ोनों में बहुत बड़ा अंतर है।
