examples.en: We saw a huge elephant at the sanctuary.
examples.hi: हमने अभयारण्य में एक विशाल हाथी देखा।

examples.en: The company made a huge profit last year.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने पिछले साल बहुत बड़ा मुनाफ़ा कमाया।

common_mistake.wrong: The stadium was very huge.
common_mistake.right: The stadium was absolutely huge.
common_mistake.why: 'huge' is already extreme; use 'absolutely' or nothing, not 'very'.

cloze.sentence: A ____ crowd gathered to see the parade.

en_def: of the present time; using the newest ideas or technology
hi_nuance: Stress on the first syllable: MOD-ern, not mo-DERN. 'modern' describes style and technology; 'new' just means recently made. 'modern' can contrast with 'traditional'.

examples.en: The office has modern furniture and big windows.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस में आधुनिक फ़र्नीचर और बड़ी खिड़कियाँ हैं।

examples.en: Modern phones can do almost everything.
examples.hi: आधुनिक फ़ोन लगभग सब कुछ कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: She prefers modern art to traditional paintings.
examples.hi: उसे पारंपरिक चित्रों से ज़्यादा आधुनिक कला पसंद है।

examples.en: Life in a modern city is fast and busy.
examples.hi: आधुनिक शहर में जीवन तेज़ और व्यस्त है।

examples.en: The hospital uses modern equipment.
examples.hi: अस्पताल आधुनिक उपकरणों का उपयोग करता है।

common_mistake.wrong: We bought a very modern and latest phone.
common_mistake.right: We bought the latest phone.
common_mistake.why: 'modern' and 'latest' repeat the same idea; pick one.

cloze.sentence: The museum has a ____ building made of glass.

en_def: having a small distance from one side to the other
hi_nuance: 'narrow' is the opposite of 'wide', not of 'big'. Hindi 'छोटा' (small) leads learners to say 'small road'; the correct word for width is 'narrow'. 'a narrow escape' = almost failed.

examples.en: The streets in the old city are very narrow.
examples.hi: पुराने शहर की गलियाँ बहुत संकरी हैं।

examples.en: Two cars can't pass on this narrow road.
examples.hi: इस संकरी सड़क पर दो गाड़ियाँ नहीं निकल सकतीं।

examples.en: We walked along a narrow path by the river.
examples.hi: हम नदी किनारे एक संकरे रास्ते पर चले।

examples.en: The bridge is too narrow for trucks.
examples.hi: पुल ट्रकों के लिए बहुत संकरा है।

examples.en: He had a narrow escape from the accident.
examples.hi: वह दुर्घटना से बाल-बाल बचा।

common_mistake.wrong: The lane is very small, so the bus cannot enter.
common_mistake.right: The lane is very narrow, so the bus cannot enter.
common_mistake.why: For width use 'narrow'; 'small' describes overall size.

cloze.sentence: The ____ staircase led to the roof.

en_def: making a lot of noise
hi_nuance: 'noisy' describes a place or thing; 'loud' describes the sound itself. Indian English says 'the fan is making a big noise'; natural: 'the fan is noisy' or 'the fan is loud'.

examples.en: The restaurant was too noisy to talk.
examples.hi: रेस्तराँ में बात करने के लिए बहुत शोर था।

examples.en: Our neighbours are very noisy at night.
examples.hi: हमारे पड़ोसी रात में बहुत शोर करते हैं।

examples.en: I can't study in such a noisy room.
examples.hi: मैं इतने शोरगुल वाले कमरे में पढ़ नहीं सकता।

examples.en: The old washing machine is really noisy.
examples.hi: पुरानी वॉशिंग मशीन बहुत शोर करती है।

examples.en: The market was noisy and crowded.
examples.hi: बाज़ार शोरगुल और भीड़ से भरा था।

common_mistake.wrong: The AC is making very much noise.
common_mistake.right: The AC is very noisy.
common_mistake.why: 'very much noise' is unnatural; use the adjective 'noisy' or 'a lot of noise'.

cloze.sentence: It's too ____ here; let's go somewhere quieter.

en_def: making little or no noise; calm
hi_nuance: Spelling trap: 'quiet' (silent) vs 'quite' (fairly). Two syllables: KWY-ut. 'Be quiet' = stop talking; 'keep quiet about' = don't tell. A 'quiet person' is reserved.

examples.en: Please be quiet; the baby is sleeping.
examples.hi: कृपया चुप रहें; बच्चा सो रहा है।

examples.en: We live in a quiet village.
examples.hi: हम एक शांत गाँव में रहते हैं।

examples.en: He's a quiet boy who reads a lot.
examples.hi: वह एक शांत लड़का है जो बहुत पढ़ता है।

examples.en: It was a quiet day at the office.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस में शांत दिन था।

examples.en: Keep quiet about the surprise party.
examples.hi: सरप्राइज़ पार्टी के बारे में चुप रहना।

common_mistake.wrong: The library is very quite.
common_mistake.right: The library is very quiet.
common_mistake.why: 'quite' means 'fairly'; 'quiet' means silent.

cloze.sentence: The students went ____ when the teacher walked in.

en_def: normal; not special or different
hi_nuance: 'ordinary' = nothing special; 'normal' = as expected; 'common' = happens often. Indian English uses 'simple' for 'ordinary' ('a simple man'). 'out of the ordinary' = unusual.

examples.en: It was just an ordinary Tuesday.
examples.hi: यह बस एक साधारण मंगलवार था।

examples.en: He's an ordinary man with an extraordinary story.
examples.hi: वह एक साधारण आदमी है जिसकी कहानी असाधारण है।

examples.en: Ordinary people can't afford these prices.
examples.hi: आम लोग ये कीमतें नहीं चुका सकते।

examples.en: Nothing out of the ordinary happened.
examples.hi: कुछ भी असामान्य नहीं हुआ।

examples.en: She wore ordinary clothes to the party.
examples.hi: उसने पार्टी में साधारण कपड़े पहने।

common_mistake.wrong: He is a very simple man; he wears ordinary clothes.
common_mistake.right: He is a very ordinary man; he wears plain clothes.
common_mistake.why: 'simple' in English can mean 'not intelligent'; use 'ordinary' or 'modest' for a plain lifestyle.

cloze.sentence: For ____ people, the rent is too high.

en_def: liked by many people
hi_nuance: 'popular WITH' a group of people. Indian English says 'popular among' — also correct but 'with' is more common. Do not confuse with 'famous' (known) — a thing can be famous but not popular.

examples.en: Cricket is the most popular sport in India.
examples.hi: क्रिकेट भारत का सबसे लोकप्रिय खेल है।

examples.en: This café is popular with students.
examples.hi: यह कैफ़े छात्रों के बीच लोकप्रिय है।

examples.en: She's very popular at school.
examples.hi: वह स्कूल में बहुत लोकप्रिय है।

examples.en: The song became popular overnight.
examples.hi: गाना रातों-रात लोकप्रिय हो गया।

examples.en: Online classes are becoming more popular.
examples.hi: ऑनलाइन कक्षाएँ ज़्यादा लोकप्रिय हो रही हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: This dish is very popular in youngsters.
common_mistake.right: This dish is very popular with young people.
common_mistake.why: 'popular' takes 'with' (or 'among'), and 'youngsters' sounds dated.

cloze.sentence: Momos have become very ____ in Delhi.

en_def: belonging to one person or group and not for everyone; secret
hi_nuance: Pronounced 'PRY-vut', not 'pry-VATE'. 'private' = personal/not public; 'personal' = about a particular person. 'in private' = with nobody else present. Indian English uses 'private' for private-sector jobs too.

examples.en: This is a private road; you can't park here.
examples.hi: यह एक निजी सड़क है; आप यहाँ गाड़ी खड़ी नहीं कर सकते।

examples.en: Can we talk in private?
examples.hi: क्या हम अकेले में बात कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: She keeps her private life separate from work.
examples.hi: वह अपनी निजी ज़िंदगी को काम से अलग रखती है।

examples.en: He works for a private company.
examples.hi: वह एक निजी कंपनी में काम करता है।

examples.en: Please don't read my private messages.
examples.hi: कृपया मेरे निजी संदेश न पढ़ें।

common_mistake.wrong: I want to ask you a private question about your salary.
common_mistake.right: I want to ask you a personal question about your salary.
common_mistake.why: 'personal' fits questions about someone; 'private' is for things not open to others.

cloze.sentence: The hotel has a ____ beach for guests.

en_def: almost the same but not exactly
hi_nuance: 'similar TO', never 'similar with' or 'similar as'. 'same' needs 'the': 'the same as'. Indian English says 'same to same' — say 'exactly the same'.

examples.en: Your phone is similar to mine.
examples.hi: तुम्हारा फ़ोन मेरे फ़ोन से मिलता-जुलता है।

examples.en: The two brothers have similar interests.
examples.hi: दोनों भाइयों की रुचियाँ समान हैं।

examples.en: Hindi and Urdu are very similar when spoken.
examples.hi: बोलने में हिंदी और उर्दू बहुत मिलती-जुलती हैं।

examples.en: We had a similar problem last year.
examples.hi: पिछले साल हमें भी ऐसी ही समस्या हुई थी।

examples.en: The houses on this street all look similar.
examples.hi: इस सड़क के सभी घर एक जैसे दिखते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: My job is similar with yours.
common_mistake.right: My job is similar to yours.
common_mistake.why: 'similar' is always followed by 'to'.

cloze.sentence: The new model looks very ____ to the old one.

en_def: unusual or surprising; not familiar
hi_nuance: 'strange' = unusual; 'stranger' = an unknown person (noun). 'It's strange that...' is a common pattern. Indian English uses 'weird' and 'strange' the same way — 'weird' is more informal.

examples.en: There was a strange noise coming from the engine.
examples.hi: इंजन से एक अजीब आवाज़ आ रही थी।

examples.en: It's strange that he hasn't called.
examples.hi: अजीब है कि उसने फ़ोन नहीं किया।

examples.en: I felt strange in the new office at first.
examples.hi: नए ऑफ़िस में शुरू में मुझे अजीब लगा।

examples.en: She had a strange dream last night.
examples.hi: उसने कल रात एक अजीब सपना देखा।

examples.en: Don't talk to strange people online.
examples.hi: ऑनलाइन अनजान लोगों से बात मत करो।

common_mistake.wrong: A strange came to the door and asked for you.
common_mistake.right: A stranger came to the door and asked for you.
common_mistake.why: 'strange' is an adjective; the person is a 'stranger'.

cloze.sentence: It's ____ to see the streets so empty.

en_def: very bad
hi_nuance: Strong adjective, so 'absolutely terrible', not 'very terrible'. 'terrible' and 'terrific' look similar but 'terrific' means excellent! Also 'I feel terrible' = ill or guilty.

examples.en: The weather was terrible all week.
examples.hi: पूरे हफ़्ते मौसम बहुत खराब था।

examples.en: I feel terrible about forgetting your birthday.
examples.hi: तुम्हारा जन्मदिन भूलने पर मुझे बहुत बुरा लग रहा है।

examples.en: The food at that place was terrible.
examples.hi: उस जगह का खाना बहुत खराब था।

examples.en: He had a terrible headache.
examples.hi: उसे भयानक सिरदर्द था।

examples.en: It was a terrible mistake to trust him.
examples.hi: उस पर भरोसा करना एक भयानक गलती थी।

common_mistake.wrong: The party was terrific — nobody enjoyed it.
common_mistake.right: The party was terrible — nobody enjoyed it.
common_mistake.why: 'terrific' means very good; 'terrible' means very bad.

cloze.sentence: The traffic was ____ this morning.

en_def: extremely small
hi_nuance: Strong form of 'small': 'absolutely tiny', not 'very tiny'. Rhymes with 'shiny'. Indian English says 'very small small' for emphasis — use 'tiny'.

examples.en: The flat has a tiny kitchen.
examples.hi: फ़्लैट में बहुत छोटी रसोई है।

examples.en: A tiny insect landed on my arm.
examples.hi: एक नन्हा कीड़ा मेरी बाँह पर आ बैठा।

examples.en: Only a tiny number of people passed the test.
examples.hi: बहुत ही कम लोग परीक्षा में पास हुए।

examples.en: The baby's hands were so tiny.
examples.hi: बच्चे के हाथ बहुत नन्हे थे।

examples.en: There's a tiny mistake on page three.
examples.hi: पेज तीन पर एक छोटी-सी गलती है।

common_mistake.wrong: The room was very tiny.
common_mistake.right: The room was tiny. / The room was absolutely tiny.
common_mistake.why: 'tiny' is an extreme adjective; do not use 'very' with it.

cloze.sentence: He lives in a ____ village in the hills.

en_def: having the usual qualities of a particular thing or person
hi_def: विशिष्ट, आम तौर पर होने वाला
hi_nuance: 'typical OF' someone/something. 'Typical!' alone means 'that's what always happens' (annoyed). Adverb 'typically' = usually. Don't confuse with 'traditional'.

examples.en: A typical working day for me starts at nine.
examples.hi: मेरा एक आम कार्यदिवस नौ बजे शुरू होता है।

examples.en: It's typical of him to arrive late.
examples.hi: देर से आना उसकी आदत है।

examples.en: This is a typical Gujarati thali.
examples.hi: यह एक विशिष्ट गुजराती थाली है।

examples.en: Typical! The bus left just as I got there.
examples.hi: हमेशा की तरह! जैसे ही मैं पहुँचा, बस निकल गई।

examples.en: Typically, we have lunch at one o'clock.
examples.hi: आम तौर पर, हम एक बजे दोपहर का खाना खाते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: It is typical for him to be late.
common_mistake.right: It is typical of him to be late.
common_mistake.why: For a person's character, 'typical' takes 'of'.

cloze.sentence: Heavy rain is ____ in July here.

en_def: helpful for doing something
hi_nuance: 'useful FOR' a purpose, 'useful TO' a person. Spelling: one 'l' in 'useful', two in 'usefully'. Opposite is 'useless'. Indian English overuses 'helpful' for things — 'useful' is better for objects and information.

examples.en: This app is very useful for learning vocabulary.
examples.hi: यह ऐप शब्दावली सीखने के लिए बहुत उपयोगी है।

examples.en: Thanks, that's useful information.
examples.hi: धन्यवाद, यह उपयोगी जानकारी है।

examples.en: A torch is useful during power cuts.
examples.hi: बिजली जाने पर टॉर्च उपयोगी होती है।

examples.en: Your notes were really useful to me.
examples.hi: तुम्हारे नोट्स मेरे लिए सचमुच उपयोगी थे।

examples.en: It's useful to know some basic phrases when travelling.
examples.hi: यात्रा करते समय कुछ बुनियादी वाक्यांश जानना उपयोगी है।

common_mistake.wrong: This book is very usefull.
common_mistake.right: This book is very useful.
common_mistake.why: Spelling: 'useful' has one 'l'.

cloze.sentence: A dictionary is a ____ tool for any learner.

en_def: worth a lot of money, or very useful and important
hi_nuance: 'valuable' = worth a lot; 'invaluable' means EXTREMELY valuable (not 'not valuable'!). 'valuables' (noun) = expensive items. Indian English says 'costly' for expensive things — 'valuable' is about worth, not just price.

examples.en: This ring is very valuable; it was my grandmother's.
examples.hi: यह अँगूठी बहुत कीमती है; यह मेरी दादी की थी।

examples.en: Thank you for your valuable time.
examples.hi: आपके कीमती समय के लिए धन्यवाद।

examples.en: She gave me some valuable advice.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे कुछ मूल्यवान सलाह दी।

examples.en: Keep your valuables in the hotel safe.
examples.hi: अपना कीमती सामान होटल की तिजोरी में रखें।

examples.en: Experience is more valuable than a degree.
examples.hi: अनुभव डिग्री से ज़्यादा मूल्यवान है।

common_mistake.wrong: Your help was invaluable, so it was not worth much.
common_mistake.right: Your help was invaluable — I couldn't have done it without you.
common_mistake.why: 'invaluable' means extremely valuable, not 'without value'.

cloze.sentence: Water is a ____ resource in the desert.

en_def: extremely good
hi_nuance: Strong adjective: 'absolutely wonderful', not 'very wonderful'. Spelling: one 'l'. Indian English says 'too good' to mean 'very good' — use 'wonderful', 'great', or 'excellent'.

examples.en: We had a wonderful time in Kerala.
examples.hi: हमने केरल में शानदार समय बिताया।

examples.en: What a wonderful surprise!
examples.hi: क्या अद्भुत सरप्राइज़ है!

examples.en: She's a wonderful cook.
examples.hi: वह बहुत बढ़िया खाना बनाती है।

examples.en: It's wonderful to see you again.
examples.hi: तुम्हें फिर से देखकर बहुत अच्छा लगा।

examples.en: The view from the top was wonderful.
examples.hi: ऊपर से दृश्य अद्भुत था।

common_mistake.wrong: The film was too good!
common_mistake.right: The film was wonderful!
common_mistake.why: 'too good' in native English means 'better than is acceptable'; for praise use 'wonderful' or 'really good'.

cloze.sentence: Thank you for a ____ evening.

en_def: a secret word or set of characters used to get access to a computer or account
hi_nuance: 'enter/type/reset/change a password', 'forgot my password'. One word, not 'pass word'. Indian English says 'put the password' — say 'enter'.

examples.en: Please enter your password to log in.
examples.hi: लॉग इन करने के लिए कृपया अपना पासवर्ड दर्ज करें।

examples.en: I forgot my password again.
examples.hi: मैं फिर से अपना पासवर्ड भूल गया।

examples.en: Never share your password with anyone.
examples.hi: अपना पासवर्ड कभी किसी के साथ साझा न करें।

examples.en: You should change your password every few months.
examples.hi: आपको हर कुछ महीनों में अपना पासवर्ड बदलना चाहिए।

examples.en: A strong password has letters, numbers, and symbols.
examples.hi: एक मज़बूत पासवर्ड में अक्षर, अंक और चिह्न होते हैं।

common_mistake.wrong: Put your password and press enter.
common_mistake.right: Enter your password and press enter.
common_mistake.why: For typing into a field, English uses 'enter' or 'type', not 'put'.

cloze.sentence: Click here if you have forgotten your ____.

en_def: the flat surface of a phone, computer, or TV where images appear
hi_nuance: 'on the screen', 'screen time', 'touch screen'. Also a verb: 'screen a film' or 'screen calls'. Indian English says 'display' for the phone screen — 'screen' is the everyday word.

examples.en: My phone screen is cracked.
examples.hi: मेरे फ़ोन की स्क्रीन टूट गई है।

examples.en: Too much screen time is bad for your eyes.
examples.hi: बहुत ज़्यादा स्क्रीन देखना आँखों के लिए बुरा है।

examples.en: The error message appeared on the screen.
examples.hi: त्रुटि संदेश स्क्रीन पर दिखाई दिया।

examples.en: Can you share your screen in the meeting?
examples.hi: क्या आप मीटिंग में अपनी स्क्रीन साझा कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: The laptop has a fifteen-inch screen.
examples.hi: लैपटॉप में पंद्रह इंच की स्क्रीन है।

common_mistake.wrong: The display of my mobile is broken.
common_mistake.right: My phone screen is broken.
common_mistake.why: 'screen' is the natural everyday word; 'display' is technical.

cloze.sentence: Turn down the brightness of your ____ at night.

en_def: to copy a file or program from the internet onto your device
hi_nuance: 'download FROM' the internet 'ONTO/TO' your device. Opposite: 'upload'. As a noun the stress moves to the first syllable: DOWN-load. Indian English says 'download it in my phone' — use 'onto' or 'to'.

examples.en: I downloaded the app from the App Store.
examples.hi: मैंने ऐप स्टोर से ऐप डाउनलोड किया।

examples.en: It takes a minute to download the file.
examples.hi: फ़ाइल डाउनलोड करने में एक मिनट लगता है।

examples.en: You can download the form from our website.
examples.hi: आप हमारी वेबसाइट से फ़ॉर्म डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: Don't download attachments from unknown senders.
examples.hi: अनजान भेजने वालों के अटैचमेंट डाउनलोड न करें।

examples.en: The download failed because the wifi dropped.
examples.hi: वाईफ़ाई कट जाने से डाउनलोड विफल हो गया।

common_mistake.wrong: I downloaded the song in my phone.
common_mistake.right: I downloaded the song onto my phone.
common_mistake.why: Files are downloaded 'onto' or 'to' a device.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ the latest version before the meeting.

en_def: to copy a file from your device to the internet or another computer
hi_nuance: 'upload TO' a website/cloud. Opposite of 'download'. Indian English says 'upload on' — 'to' is more natural, though 'on' is heard for social media ('upload on Instagram').

examples.en: Upload your photo to the form.
examples.hi: फ़ॉर्म में अपनी फ़ोटो अपलोड करें।

examples.en: She uploaded the video to YouTube.
examples.hi: उसने वीडियो यूट्यूब पर अपलोड किया।

examples.en: It took an hour to upload all the files.
examples.hi: सारी फ़ाइलें अपलोड करने में एक घंटा लगा।

examples.en: Please upload a copy of your ID.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने पहचान पत्र की एक प्रति अपलोड करें।

examples.en: The upload speed here is very slow.
examples.hi: यहाँ अपलोड की गति बहुत धीमी है।

common_mistake.wrong: I have uploaded the document in the portal.
common_mistake.right: I have uploaded the document to the portal.
common_mistake.why: 'upload' is followed by 'to' for the destination.

cloze.sentence: You need to ____ your CV before applying.

en_def: to make something more modern or add the latest information
hi_nuance: Verb: up-DATE; noun: UP-date. 'update someone ON something' = give them the latest news. Indian English says 'update me the status' — say 'update me on the status'. 'keep someone updated'.

examples.en: I need to update the app to the latest version.
examples.hi: मुझे ऐप को नवीनतम संस्करण में अपडेट करना है।

examples.en: Can you update me on the project?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे परियोजना की ताज़ा जानकारी दे सकते हैं?

examples.en: Please update your address in the system.
examples.hi: कृपया सिस्टम में अपना पता अपडेट करें।

examples.en: The software updates automatically overnight.
examples.hi: सॉफ़्टवेयर रात भर में अपने आप अपडेट हो जाता है।

examples.en: I'll keep you updated.
examples.hi: मैं आपको जानकारी देता रहूँगा।

common_mistake.wrong: Please update me the status by evening.
common_mistake.right: Please update me on the status by this evening.
common_mistake.why: 'update someone ON something' is the correct pattern.

cloze.sentence: Don't forget to ____ your phone's software.

en_def: to put software onto a computer, or to put equipment in place and make it ready to use
hi_nuance: 'install software ON a device', 'install a fan IN a room'. Noun: 'installation'. Indian English says 'fit' for equipment ('get the AC fitted') — 'install' is standard. Opposite: 'uninstall'.

examples.en: Install the app and create an account.
examples.hi: ऐप इंस्टॉल करें और खाता बनाएँ।

examples.en: We had a new water heater installed yesterday.
examples.hi: हमने कल एक नया वॉटर हीटर लगवाया।

examples.en: The update won't install on my old phone.
examples.hi: मेरे पुराने फ़ोन पर अपडेट इंस्टॉल नहीं हो रहा।

examples.en: The company installed cameras in the car park.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने पार्किंग में कैमरे लगाए।

examples.en: It took ten minutes to install the printer.
examples.hi: प्रिंटर इंस्टॉल करने में दस मिनट लगे।

common_mistake.wrong: I installed the app in my laptop.
common_mistake.right: I installed the app on my laptop.
common_mistake.why: Software is installed 'on' a device.

cloze.sentence: You must ____ the update to fix the bug.

en_def: to join two things together, or to join a device to a network
hi_nuance: 'connect TO' wifi/a network, 'connect WITH' people. Indian English says 'connect the net' — say 'connect to the internet'. 'get connected', 'connection' (noun), 'stay connected'.

examples.en: I can't connect to the wifi.
examples.hi: मैं वाईफ़ाई से कनेक्ट नहीं हो पा रहा।

examples.en: Connect the cable to the back of the TV.
examples.hi: केबल को टीवी के पीछे जोड़ें।

examples.en: This bridge connects the two islands.
examples.hi: यह पुल दोनों द्वीपों को जोड़ता है।

examples.en: Social media helps me connect with old friends.
examples.hi: सोशल मीडिया मुझे पुराने दोस्तों से जुड़ने में मदद करता है।

examples.en: Your call could not be connected.
examples.hi: आपकी कॉल कनेक्ट नहीं हो सकी।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone is not connecting with the wifi.
common_mistake.right: My phone won't connect to the wifi.
common_mistake.why: For networks use 'connect to'; 'with' is for people.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ your laptop to the projector.

en_def: a device that puts electricity into a battery
hi_nuance: 'phone charger', 'charging cable', 'plug in the charger'. Indian English sometimes says 'charging pin' — the piece that goes into the socket is a 'plug', the wire is a 'cable'.

examples.en: Have you seen my phone charger?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने मेरा फ़ोन चार्जर देखा है?

examples.en: I forgot my charger at the hotel.
examples.hi: मैं होटल में अपना चार्जर छोड़ आया।

examples.en: Can I borrow your charger for a few minutes?
examples.hi: क्या मैं कुछ मिनट के लिए आपका चार्जर ले सकता हूँ?

examples.en: This charger works with any USB-C phone.
examples.hi: यह चार्जर किसी भी यूएसबी-सी फ़ोन के साथ काम करता है।

examples.en: Plug the charger into the wall socket.
examples.hi: चार्जर को दीवार के सॉकेट में लगाएँ।

common_mistake.wrong: My charging pin is broken.
common_mistake.right: My charging cable is broken.
common_mistake.why: 'charging pin' is Indian English; the wire is a 'cable' and the part in the wall is a 'plug'.

cloze.sentence: My battery is at 5% and I don't have my ____.

en_def: a device that stores electricity and powers a phone, car, or other equipment
hi_nuance: 'the battery is low/dead/flat', 'battery life', 'charge the battery'. Indian English says 'my battery is down' — natural is 'my battery is low' or 'my phone is dead'. Plural: 'batteries'.

examples.en: My battery is almost dead.
examples.hi: मेरी बैटरी लगभग खत्म हो गई है।

examples.en: This phone has excellent battery life.
examples.hi: इस फ़ोन की बैटरी लाइफ़ बहुत अच्छी है।

examples.en: The remote needs new batteries.
examples.hi: रिमोट को नई बैटरियाँ चाहिए।

examples.en: The car battery was flat this morning.
examples.hi: आज सुबह कार की बैटरी खत्म थी।

examples.en: Turn on battery saver mode.
examples.hi: बैटरी बचाने वाला मोड चालू करें।

common_mistake.wrong: My phone battery is down.
common_mistake.right: My phone battery is low. / My phone is dead.
common_mistake.why: 'down' is used for networks or systems, not batteries.

cloze.sentence: The ____ lasts about two days on one charge.

en_def: the radio waves that let a phone or device connect; or a sign or action that gives information
hi_nuance: 'no signal', 'weak/strong signal', 'lose the signal'. Indian English says 'network is not there' — natural is 'there's no signal' or 'I have no reception'. Also 'traffic signal' (UK: 'traffic lights').

examples.en: There's no signal in the basement.
examples.hi: तहखाने में सिग्नल नहीं आता।

examples.en: The signal is weak here; let me go outside.
examples.hi: यहाँ सिग्नल कमज़ोर है; मैं बाहर जाता हूँ।

examples.en: I lost the signal during the call.
examples.hi: कॉल के दौरान सिग्नल चला गया।

examples.en: The referee gave the signal to start.
examples.hi: रेफ़री ने शुरू करने का संकेत दिया।

examples.en: Stop at the red signal.
examples.hi: लाल सिग्नल पर रुकें।

common_mistake.wrong: Network is not coming in my room.
common_mistake.right: There's no signal in my room.
common_mistake.why: 'network is not coming' is a direct translation; English uses 'signal' or 'reception'.

cloze.sentence: The call dropped because the ____ was too weak.

en_def: a piece of written or spoken information sent to someone
hi_nuance: 'send/leave/get a message', 'text message', 'voice message'. Indian English says 'do message me' or 'message me on WhatsApp' — 'message me' (verb) is fine; 'do' is unnecessary. Also 'the message of the film' = main idea.

examples.en: I sent you a message this morning; did you get it?
examples.hi: मैंने आज सुबह तुम्हें संदेश भेजा था; क्या मिला?

examples.en: Leave a message after the tone.
examples.hi: टोन के बाद संदेश छोड़ें।

examples.en: She left me a voice message.
examples.hi: उसने मुझे एक वॉइस मैसेज छोड़ा।

examples.en: Message me when you reach home.
examples.hi: घर पहुँचकर मुझे मैसेज करना।

examples.en: The film has a strong message about friendship.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म में दोस्ती के बारे में एक मज़बूत संदेश है।

common_mistake.wrong: Do message me once you reach.
common_mistake.right: Message me once you get there.
common_mistake.why: 'do' before a verb is only for emphasis; a plain imperative is natural here.

cloze.sentence: I got your ____ but I was busy at work.

en_def: a message on a phone or computer telling you that something has happened
hi_nuance: 'get/receive a notification', 'turn off notifications', 'push notification'. Indian English uses 'notification' for government announcements too — that is formal usage, correct but different.

examples.en: I got a notification that my order has shipped.
examples.hi: मुझे सूचना मिली कि मेरा ऑर्डर भेज दिया गया है।

examples.en: Turn off notifications while you study.
examples.hi: पढ़ाई के समय नोटिफ़िकेशन बंद कर दो।

examples.en: My phone buzzes with notifications all day.
examples.hi: मेरा फ़ोन पूरे दिन नोटिफ़िकेशन से बजता रहता है।

examples.en: You'll receive a notification when the results are out.
examples.hi: परिणाम आने पर आपको सूचना मिलेगी।

examples.en: The app sends a notification every morning.
examples.hi: ऐप हर सुबह एक सूचना भेजता है।

common_mistake.wrong: I got a notification from the app that it is having an update.
common_mistake.right: I got a notification from the app that there is an update.
common_mistake.why: Use 'there is' for existence; 'having' is wrong here.

cloze.sentence: Please switch off ____ during the exam.

en_def: a set of connected pages on the internet belonging to one organisation or person
hi_nuance: One word: 'website'. 'visit/go to/check a website', 'ON a website'. Indian English says 'site' (fine) or 'web page' (a single page). 'log on to a website'.

examples.en: You can find the timetable on our website.
examples.hi: आप हमारी वेबसाइट पर समय-सारणी पा सकते हैं।

examples.en: The company launched a new website.
examples.hi: कंपनी ने एक नई वेबसाइट लॉन्च की।

examples.en: This website is not safe; don't enter your card details.
examples.hi: यह वेबसाइट सुरक्षित नहीं है; अपने कार्ड का विवरण दर्ज न करें।

examples.en: I read the news on several websites.
examples.hi: मैं कई वेबसाइटों पर खबरें पढ़ता हूँ।

examples.en: The website is down for maintenance.
examples.hi: वेबसाइट रखरखाव के लिए बंद है।

common_mistake.wrong: I saw the information in the website.
common_mistake.right: I saw the information on the website.
common_mistake.why: Things are 'on' a website, not 'in' it.

cloze.sentence: Apply through the university ____.

en_def: a connection; a clickable address that takes you to another web page
hi_nuance: 'click on a link', 'send a link', 'broken link'. Also a verb: 'link to'. Indian English says 'link is not opening' — natural is 'the link doesn't work' or 'won't open'.

examples.en: Click on the link to join the meeting.
examples.hi: मीटिंग में शामिल होने के लिए लिंक पर क्लिक करें।

examples.en: Can you send me the link to the video?
examples.hi: क्या आप मुझे वीडियो का लिंक भेज सकते हैं?

examples.en: The link doesn't work; it says page not found.
examples.hi: लिंक काम नहीं कर रहा; यह 'पेज नहीं मिला' दिखा रहा है।

examples.en: There's a strong link between diet and health.
examples.hi: आहार और स्वास्थ्य के बीच एक मज़बूत कड़ी है।

examples.en: Never click on links in suspicious emails.
examples.hi: संदिग्ध ईमेल के लिंक पर कभी क्लिक न करें।

common_mistake.wrong: The link is not opening.
common_mistake.right: The link doesn't work. / The link won't open.
common_mistake.why: 'is not opening' sounds unnatural; use 'doesn't work' or 'won't open'.

cloze.sentence: I'll share the ____ in the group chat.

en_def: to join or fasten one thing to another; to add a file to an email
hi_nuance: 'attach a file TO an email'. Noun: 'attachment'. Indian English writes 'Please find attached herewith' — simply say 'I've attached the report' or 'Please see the attached file'.

examples.en: I've attached the report to this email.
examples.hi: मैंने इस ईमेल के साथ रिपोर्ट संलग्न की है।

examples.en: Please attach a copy of your passport.
examples.hi: कृपया अपने पासपोर्ट की एक प्रति संलग्न करें।

examples.en: Attach the label to the parcel.
examples.hi: पार्सल पर लेबल लगाएँ।

examples.en: I forgot to attach the file. Here it is.
examples.hi: मैं फ़ाइल संलग्न करना भूल गया। यह रही।

examples.en: The strap attaches to the bag with a clip.
examples.hi: पट्टा एक क्लिप से बैग से जुड़ता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Please find attached herewith the invoice for your reference.
common_mistake.right: I've attached the invoice.
common_mistake.why: 'find attached herewith' is old-fashioned Indian business English; modern emails are direct.

cloze.sentence: Don't forget to ____ your CV to the application.

en_def: to remove something, especially from a computer or phone
hi_nuance: 'delete a file/message/account'. 'remove' is more general; 'delete' is for digital content and text. Indian English says 'delete it off' — just 'delete it'.

examples.en: I accidentally deleted all my photos.
examples.hi: मैंने गलती से अपनी सारी फ़ोटो डिलीट कर दीं।

examples.en: Delete any emails you don't need.
examples.hi: जो ईमेल आपको नहीं चाहिए उन्हें हटा दें।

examples.en: Can you delete my number from your phone?
examples.hi: क्या आप अपने फ़ोन से मेरा नंबर हटा सकते हैं?

examples.en: The message was deleted before I could read it.
examples.hi: संदेश मेरे पढ़ने से पहले हटा दिया गया।

examples.en: She deleted her social media account.
examples.hi: उसने अपना सोशल मीडिया खाता डिलीट कर दिया।

common_mistake.wrong: I deleted off the old files.
common_mistake.right: I deleted the old files.
common_mistake.why: 'delete' does not take 'off'.

cloze.sentence: Please ____ this message after reading it.

en_def: a piece of equipment made for a particular purpose, especially electronic
hi_nuance: Noun 'device' (/s/) vs verb 'devise' (/z/, to invent). 'mobile device', 'smart device'. Indian English uses 'gadget' — fine informally; 'device' is neutral and technical.

examples.en: This app works on any device.
examples.hi: यह ऐप किसी भी डिवाइस पर काम करता है।

examples.en: Please switch off all electronic devices during take-off.
examples.hi: उड़ान भरते समय कृपया सभी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक उपकरण बंद कर दें।

examples.en: You can log in from up to three devices.
examples.hi: आप तीन डिवाइस तक से लॉग इन कर सकते हैं।

examples.en: The device needs charging every night.
examples.hi: डिवाइस को हर रात चार्ज करना पड़ता है।

examples.en: A smoke detector is a simple safety device.
examples.hi: स्मोक डिटेक्टर एक साधारण सुरक्षा उपकरण है।

common_mistake.wrong: We need to device a new plan.
common_mistake.right: We need to devise a new plan.
common_mistake.why: 'device' is the noun; 'devise' is the verb meaning to invent or plan.

cloze.sentence: The app sends a code to your registered ____.

en_def: to produce words or pictures on paper using a machine
hi_nuance: 'print out' a document; 'printout' (noun); 'in print' = published. Indian English says 'take a print' or 'take out a print' — say 'print it' or 'print a copy'.

examples.en: Can you print this document for me?
examples.hi: क्या आप मेरे लिए यह दस्तावेज़ प्रिंट कर सकते हैं?

examples.en: I printed out the tickets just in case.
examples.hi: मैंने एहतियातन टिकट प्रिंट कर लिए।

examples.en: The printer is out of ink, so I can't print.
examples.hi: प्रिंटर में स्याही खत्म है, इसलिए मैं प्रिंट नहीं कर सकता।

examples.en: Please print your name in capital letters.
examples.hi: कृपया अपना नाम बड़े अक्षरों में लिखें।

examples.en: The book was first printed in 1985.
examples.hi: यह किताब पहली बार 1985 में छपी थी।

common_mistake.wrong: Please take a print of this form.
common_mistake.right: Please print this form.
common_mistake.why: 'take a print' is Indian English; 'print' is the verb.

cloze.sentence: Could you ____ two copies of the report?

en_def: now, without any delay
hi_nuance: Stronger than 'soon' or 'quickly'. Indian English overuses 'at the earliest' and 'urgently basis'; 'immediately' or 'right away' is natural. 'immediately after' = straight after.

examples.en: Call me immediately if there's a problem.
examples.hi: कोई समस्या हो तो मुझे तुरंत फ़ोन करना।

examples.en: She left immediately after the meeting.
examples.hi: वह मीटिंग के तुरंत बाद चली गई।

examples.en: The doctor said I should stop smoking immediately.
examples.hi: डॉक्टर ने कहा कि मुझे तुरंत धूम्रपान बंद कर देना चाहिए।

examples.en: I recognised her immediately.
examples.hi: मैंने उसे तुरंत पहचान लिया।

examples.en: The fire alarm went off and everyone left immediately.
examples.hi: फ़ायर अलार्म बजा और सब तुरंत बाहर चले गए।

common_mistake.wrong: Please do the needful on urgent basis.
common_mistake.right: Please deal with this immediately.
common_mistake.why: 'do the needful' and 'on urgent basis' are Indian English; use plain verbs plus 'immediately'.

cloze.sentence: If you smell gas, leave the building ____.

en_def: a short time ago
hi_nuance: Used with past simple ('I recently moved') or present perfect ('I've recently moved'). Hindi speakers sometimes say 'recently only' or 'just now recently' — one word is enough. 'lately' is similar but only with present perfect.

examples.en: I recently started learning Spanish.
examples.hi: मैंने हाल ही में स्पेनिश सीखना शुरू किया।

examples.en: Have you seen any good films recently?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने हाल ही में कोई अच्छी फ़िल्म देखी?

examples.en: She has recently been promoted.
examples.hi: उसे हाल ही में पदोन्नति मिली है।

examples.en: The shop opened recently, so it's still quiet.
examples.hi: दुकान हाल ही में खुली है, इसलिए अभी शांत है।

examples.en: Until recently, he lived in Chennai.
examples.hi: हाल तक, वह चेन्नई में रहता था।

common_mistake.wrong: I recently only joined this company.
common_mistake.right: I only recently joined this company. / I joined this company just recently.
common_mistake.why: 'recently only' is a Hindi-influenced word order; put 'only' before 'recently'.

cloze.sentence: We ____ moved to a bigger flat.

en_def: quickly and unexpectedly
hi_nuance: Usually goes before the verb or at the start of the sentence. 'all of a sudden' is the informal phrase. Indian English says 'suddenly only' — drop 'only'.

examples.en: Suddenly, the lights went out.
examples.hi: अचानक, बत्तियाँ बुझ गईं।

examples.en: He suddenly stopped talking.
examples.hi: वह अचानक बोलना बंद कर दिया।

examples.en: The weather changed suddenly.
examples.hi: मौसम अचानक बदल गया।

examples.en: I suddenly remembered I'd left the stove on.
examples.hi: मुझे अचानक याद आया कि मैंने चूल्हा चालू छोड़ दिया था।

examples.en: All of a sudden, everyone started laughing.
examples.hi: अचानक, सब हँसने लगे।

common_mistake.wrong: Suddenly only the car stopped.
common_mistake.right: Suddenly the car stopped.
common_mistake.why: 'only' after 'suddenly' is a Hindi-pattern filler and adds nothing in English.

cloze.sentence: The dog ____ ran across the road.

en_def: likely to be true or to happen
hi_nuance: 'probably' (about 70–80% sure) is stronger than 'maybe' or 'perhaps' (50%). Position: after 'be' or before the main verb: 'He is probably late', 'He'll probably come'. Indian English uses 'may be' as one word — 'maybe' is the adverb.

examples.en: It'll probably rain this evening.
examples.hi: शायद आज शाम बारिश होगी।

examples.en: She's probably still at work.
examples.hi: वह शायद अभी भी काम पर है।

examples.en: I'll probably take the train instead of driving.
examples.hi: मैं शायद गाड़ी चलाने के बजाय ट्रेन लूँगा।

examples.en: That's probably the best option.
examples.hi: वह शायद सबसे अच्छा विकल्प है।

examples.en: Are you coming? — Probably not.
examples.hi: क्या तुम आ रहे हो? — शायद नहीं।

common_mistake.wrong: He probably is at home.
common_mistake.right: He is probably at home.
common_mistake.why: 'probably' goes after the verb 'be'.

cloze.sentence: The shop is ____ closed by now.

en_def: more than usual, or more than others
hi_nuance: 'especially' = particularly; 'specially' = for a special purpose ('made specially for you'). Don't start a sentence with 'especially' in formal writing. Pronounce the first syllable: 'es-PESH-ally'.

examples.en: I love Indian food, especially dosas.
examples.hi: मुझे भारतीय खाना बहुत पसंद है, खासकर डोसा।

examples.en: It's cold here, especially at night.
examples.hi: यहाँ ठंड है, खासकर रात में।

examples.en: Be careful, especially when crossing the road.
examples.hi: सावधान रहो, खासकर सड़क पार करते समय।

examples.en: This book is especially useful for beginners.
examples.hi: यह किताब शुरुआती लोगों के लिए विशेष रूप से उपयोगी है।

examples.en: The traffic is bad, especially on Mondays.
examples.hi: ट्रैफ़िक खराब है, खासकर सोमवार को।

common_mistake.wrong: This cake was made especially for you.
common_mistake.right: This cake was made specially for you.
common_mistake.why: 'specially' = for a specific purpose; 'especially' = particularly.

cloze.sentence: I enjoy travelling, ____ by train.

en_def: in fact, really (often used to correct or surprise)
hi_nuance: Indian English overuses 'actually' as a filler at the start of every sentence. In native English it signals a correction or a surprising fact. It does NOT mean 'currently' (a false friend from many languages).

examples.en: I thought he was Indian, but actually he's Nepali.
examples.hi: मुझे लगा वह भारतीय है, लेकिन असल में वह नेपाली है।

examples.en: Actually, I've never been to Delhi.
examples.hi: असल में, मैं कभी दिल्ली नहीं गया।

examples.en: The film was actually quite good.
examples.hi: फ़िल्म वास्तव में काफ़ी अच्छी थी।

examples.en: Did you actually read the whole book?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने सचमुच पूरी किताब पढ़ी?

examples.en: It's actually cheaper to fly than to take the train.
examples.hi: असल में ट्रेन लेने से उड़ान भरना सस्ता है।

common_mistake.wrong: Actually I am working at TCS actually.
common_mistake.right: I work at TCS.
common_mistake.why: 'actually' is not a filler; use it only to correct or add a surprising fact.

cloze.sentence: It looks expensive, but it was ____ very cheap.

en_def: nearly; not quite
hi_nuance: 'almost' and 'nearly' are interchangeable in most cases. 'almost' goes before the word it modifies: 'almost finished', 'almost everyone'. Indian English says 'almost about' — pick one.

examples.en: I'm almost ready; give me two minutes.
examples.hi: मैं लगभग तैयार हूँ; मुझे दो मिनट दो।

examples.en: Almost everyone in the office has a laptop.
examples.hi: ऑफ़िस में लगभग सबके पास लैपटॉप है।

examples.en: We almost missed the train.
examples.hi: हम ट्रेन लगभग चूक ही गए थे।

examples.en: It's almost midnight; go to sleep.
examples.hi: लगभग आधी रात हो गई है; सो जाओ।

examples.en: He almost never eats meat.
examples.hi: वह लगभग कभी माँस नहीं खाता।

common_mistake.wrong: It costs almost about five thousand rupees.
common_mistake.right: It costs almost five thousand rupees.
common_mistake.why: 'almost' and 'about' both mean approximately; use only one.

cloze.sentence: The project is ____ complete.

en_def: precisely; used to emphasise that something is completely correct
hi_nuance: 'Exactly!' alone means 'I completely agree'. 'not exactly' = not really. Indian English says 'exact' as an adverb ('come exact at 5') — use 'exactly'.

examples.en: The train leaves at exactly 6.15.
examples.hi: ट्रेन ठीक 6.15 पर छूटती है।

examples.en: That's exactly what I meant.
examples.hi: मेरा बिल्कुल यही मतलब था।

examples.en: I don't know exactly where he lives.
examples.hi: मुझे ठीक-ठीक नहीं पता कि वह कहाँ रहता है।

examples.en: So you think we should wait? — Exactly.
examples.hi: तो आपको लगता है हमें इंतज़ार करना चाहिए? — बिल्कुल।

examples.en: It wasn't exactly cheap, but it was worth it.
examples.hi: यह वास्तव में सस्ता तो नहीं था, लेकिन इसके लायक था।

common_mistake.wrong: Please reach exact at nine.
common_mistake.right: Please arrive at exactly nine.
common_mistake.why: 'exact' is an adjective; the adverb is 'exactly'.

cloze.sentence: Tell me ____ what happened.

en_def: after a long time or a lot of effort; as the last point
hi_nuance: 'finally' = after a long wait; 'at last' is more emotional; 'in the end' = after considering everything; 'lastly' = last item in a list. Indian English uses 'at last' where 'finally' is more neutral.

examples.en: After three hours, the bus finally arrived.
examples.hi: तीन घंटे बाद, बस आखिरकार पहुँची।

examples.en: I finally passed my driving test!
examples.hi: मैंने आखिरकार अपना ड्राइविंग टेस्ट पास कर लिया!

examples.en: Finally, I'd like to thank everyone for coming.
examples.hi: अंत में, मैं सबका आने के लिए धन्यवाद करना चाहूँगा।

examples.en: They finally agreed on a price.
examples.hi: वे आखिरकार एक कीमत पर सहमत हो गए।

examples.en: She finally decided to quit her job.
examples.hi: उसने आखिरकार अपनी नौकरी छोड़ने का फ़ैसला किया।

common_mistake.wrong: At last, I want to thank the organisers.
common_mistake.right: Finally, I want to thank the organisers.
common_mistake.why: For the last point in a speech use 'finally' or 'lastly'; 'at last' means after a long wait.

cloze.sentence: After months of searching, he ____ found a job.

en_def: used to say that something is sad or disappointing
hi_nuance: Usually at the start of a sentence with a comma. Softens bad news in emails: 'Unfortunately, we cannot...'. Indian English writes 'sorry to say' — 'unfortunately' is more professional.

examples.en: Unfortunately, the flight has been cancelled.
examples.hi: दुर्भाग्य से, उड़ान रद्द कर दी गई है।

examples.en: I wanted to come, but unfortunately I was ill.
examples.hi: मैं आना चाहता था, लेकिन दुर्भाग्य से मैं बीमार था।

examples.en: Unfortunately, we don't have that size in stock.
examples.hi: दुर्भाग्य से, हमारे पास वह साइज़ स्टॉक में नहीं है।

examples.en: He applied for the job but unfortunately didn't get it.
examples.hi: उसने नौकरी के लिए आवेदन किया लेकिन दुर्भाग्य से नहीं मिली।

examples.en: Unfortunately, it rained all weekend.
examples.hi: दुर्भाग्य से, पूरे सप्ताहांत बारिश होती रही।

common_mistake.wrong: Sorry to say but the item is out of stock.
common_mistake.right: Unfortunately, the item is out of stock.
common_mistake.why: 'Sorry to say but' is Indian English; 'Unfortunately' is the professional form.

cloze.sentence: ____, the tickets are sold out.

en_def: fairly, to some degree; (with strong adjectives) completely
hi_nuance: Spelling: 'quite' (fairly) vs 'quiet' (silent). 'quite good' = fairly good (UK); 'quite right' = completely right. 'quite a' + noun: 'quite a long time'. Indian English uses 'quite' rarely, preferring 'very' — 'quite' is softer.

examples.en: The exam was quite difficult.
examples.hi: परीक्षा काफ़ी कठिन थी।

examples.en: I'm quite tired; let's go home.
examples.hi: मैं काफ़ी थका हुआ हूँ; चलो घर चलते हैं।

examples.en: It's quite a long way to the station.
examples.hi: स्टेशन तक काफ़ी लंबा रास्ता है।

examples.en: You're quite right; I made a mistake.
examples.hi: आप बिल्कुल सही हैं; मैंने गलती की।

examples.en: I haven't quite finished yet.
examples.hi: मैंने अभी पूरा खत्म नहीं किया है।

common_mistake.wrong: The room was quiet big.
common_mistake.right: The room was quite big.
common_mistake.why: 'quiet' means silent; 'quite' means fairly.

cloze.sentence: The restaurant was ____ expensive but worth it.

en_def: until now (in negatives and questions); as a conjunction, 'but'
hi_nuance: 'yet' goes at the END of negative sentences and questions with present perfect: 'I haven't finished yet', 'Have you eaten yet?'. Hindi speakers say 'still not finished' — 'still' is for something continuing; 'yet' is for something expected.

examples.en: I haven't received the parcel yet.
examples.hi: मुझे अभी तक पार्सल नहीं मिला है।

examples.en: Have you booked the tickets yet?
examples.hi: क्या तुमने अभी तक टिकट बुक किए?

examples.en: The results aren't out yet.
examples.hi: परिणाम अभी तक नहीं आए हैं।

examples.en: Don't start yet; wait for the signal.
examples.hi: अभी शुरू मत करो; संकेत का इंतज़ार करो।

examples.en: It's a small car, yet it's very comfortable.
examples.hi: यह छोटी कार है, फिर भी बहुत आरामदायक है।

common_mistake.wrong: I did not yet receive the email.
common_mistake.right: I haven't received the email yet.
common_mistake.why: 'yet' goes at the end and pairs with the present perfect.

cloze.sentence: Has the doctor called you back ____?

en_def: despite the fact that; used to show a contrast
hi_nuance: 'although' begins a clause with a subject and verb: 'Although it was raining, we went out.' Never use 'but' in the same sentence with 'although' — Hindi 'हालाँकि...लेकिन' causes this. 'though' is the informal form.

examples.en: Although it was late, she kept working.
examples.hi: हालाँकि देर हो चुकी थी, वह काम करती रही।

examples.en: He passed the exam although he hadn't studied much.
examples.hi: वह परीक्षा में पास हो गया हालाँकि उसने ज़्यादा पढ़ाई नहीं की थी।

examples.en: Although the hotel was cheap, it was very clean.
examples.hi: हालाँकि होटल सस्ता था, यह बहुत साफ़ था।

examples.en: I like him, although he can be annoying.
examples.hi: मुझे वह पसंद है, हालाँकि वह कभी-कभी परेशान कर देता है।

examples.en: Although I was tired, I couldn't sleep.
examples.hi: हालाँकि मैं थका हुआ था, मुझे नींद नहीं आई।

common_mistake.wrong: Although he is rich, but he is not happy.
common_mistake.right: Although he is rich, he is not happy.
common_mistake.why: 'although' and 'but' cannot be used together; one is enough to show the contrast.

cloze.sentence: ____ it was cold, we went swimming.

en_def: except if; if not
hi_nuance: 'unless' = 'if ... not', so never add another 'not' in the same clause. Hindi 'जब तक...नहीं' tempts learners to write 'unless you don't'. Use the present tense after 'unless' for the future.

examples.en: You won't pass unless you study.
examples.hi: जब तक तुम पढ़ाई नहीं करोगे, पास नहीं होगे।

examples.en: I'll be there at six unless the train is late.
examples.hi: मैं छह बजे वहाँ पहुँच जाऊँगा, जब तक ट्रेन देर न हो।

examples.en: Don't call me unless it's urgent.
examples.hi: जब तक ज़रूरी न हो, मुझे फ़ोन मत करना।

examples.en: Unless it rains, we'll have the party outside.
examples.hi: अगर बारिश नहीं हुई, तो हम पार्टी बाहर करेंगे।

examples.en: You can't enter unless you have a ticket.
examples.hi: बिना टिकट के आप अंदर नहीं जा सकते।

common_mistake.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
common_mistake.right: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
common_mistake.why: 'unless' already means 'if not', so a second 'not' reverses the meaning.

cloze.sentence: I won't go ____ you come with me.

en_def: throughout a period of time, or at some point in it
hi_nuance: 'during' + noun (during the meeting); 'while' + clause (while we were talking). 'during' answers 'when?'; 'for' answers 'how long?'. Hindi speakers say 'during two hours' — use 'for two hours'.

examples.en: Please don't use your phone during the lecture.
examples.hi: कृपया व्याख्यान के दौरान अपना फ़ोन इस्तेमाल न करें।

examples.en: It rained heavily during the night.
examples.hi: रात के दौरान भारी बारिश हुई।

examples.en: I met a lot of people during my trip.
examples.hi: अपनी यात्रा के दौरान मैं बहुत से लोगों से मिला।

examples.en: The shop is closed during lunch.
examples.hi: दोपहर के खाने के दौरान दुकान बंद रहती है।

examples.en: She fell asleep during the film.
examples.hi: वह फ़िल्म के दौरान सो गई।

common_mistake.wrong: I lived in Pune during three years.
common_mistake.right: I lived in Pune for three years.
common_mistake.why: 'during' says WHEN; 'for' says HOW LONG.

cloze.sentence: Many shops stay open late ____ Diwali.
